column2: Take care. Look out for yourself.
Isn't it nice how the sun is always shining?
column3: 太阳一直这么晒着,不挺好的吗?

column2: I like this place. Almost feels like home now.
column3: 我喜欢这地方。现在几乎有家的感觉了。

column2: I admit I was angry when they threw me out. "Unstable mind." Fucking pussies.
column3: 我承认他们把我赶出来的时候我挺生气。"精神不稳定"。一群怂货。
只是有时候会想念义体子宫。

column2: For getting thrown out. What did you do?
column3: 就是被赶出来的罪名。你干了什么?

column2: Alright. You don't have to tell me.
Nothing. It was due to medical reasons.
I think it's better if you keep some distance now.
column3: 我觉得你现在最好跟我保持点距离。
又是什么风把你吹来了?

column2: Never met him personally. But the Oracle is well known to me.
column3: 没亲眼见过。但先知的大名我如雷贯耳。

column2: How was your meeting with the Oracle?
Sounds like he's in danger. He wanted me to get him out of there.
column3: 听起来他有危险。他想让我把他从那里救出来。

column2: He said someone is searching for him.
I don't know. The Oracle wasn't very coherent.
column3: 我不知道。先知当时神志不太清醒。

column2: So where is the Oracle now? Did you get him out of there?
column3: 那先知现在在哪?你把他救出来了吗?

column2: No. It's... I didn't really meet him physically. I think.
column3: 没有。这……我并没有在现实中见到他。我觉得。

column2: He was in some cave, but I reached out to him by communicating through the flesh.
column3: 他在某个洞穴里,但我通过血肉沟通联系上了他。

column2: Wait! It was you who reached out first and not the other way around?
column3: 等等!是你先主动联系他的,不是他联系你的?

column2: I do. We should clarify this later when we have more time.
column3: 很重要。这事我们回头有空再细说。

column2: For now we have to deal with the Oracle being in danger.
column3: 眼下我们得先解决先知身处危险的问题。

column2: He is one of the Titans. We need to protect him, **forename** of the Flesh.
column3: 他是泰坦之一。我们必须保护他,**forename** 血肉之子。

column2: Fuck that! You made me believe you were someone who cared.
column3: 去他妈的!我还以为你是个有担当的人。

column2: You were curious enough to let your fate guide you here. And interested enough so that you told me about the Oracle.
column3: 你充满好奇,任由命运把你引到这里。你还把先知的事告诉了我。

column2: You want to walk away from this now?
Yes. I don't want to help.
Then leave my home. And don't return.
column3: 那就离开我的家。别再回来。

column2: Good. I'm glad that you changed your mind.
column3: 好。你改变主意我很高兴。

column2: First we'll have to find the Oracle.
The Philosopher is an old friend of mine and knows many of the other Titans. We should ask him.
column3: 哲学家是我的老朋友,他认识许多其他泰坦。我们该去问他。

column2: Journey straight to the east from here, **forename** of the Flesh, and visit the Philosopher.
column3: 从这里一路向东,**forename** 血肉之子,去拜访哲学家。

column2: You might also ask him about your communication with the flesh.
column3: 你也可以顺便问问他你与血肉沟通的事。

column2: I'll try to contact another friend in the meantime.
column3: 这期间我会试着联系另一位朋友。

column2: Ok. I'll travel to the Philosopher.
Fine. Let's meet again here afterwards.
column3: 好。之后我们在这里碰面。

column2: Don't let the waste skin you.
Actually, I met the Philosopher already.
column3: 其实,我已经见过哲学家了。

column2: Dead? Holy flesh. This can't be.
column3: 死了?血肉在上。这不可能。

column2: But I found this recording. Extracted from the machine the Philosopher was connected to.
column3: 但我找到了这段录音。从哲学家连接的那台机器里提取的。

column2: This works as a world config container. We could build a Cyberwomb module from that to experience the recording.
column3: 这个可以用作世界配置容器。我们可以用它造一个义体子宫模块来体验这段录音。

column2: Hand it over to the Master Processor over there.
column3: 把它交给那边的主处理器。

column2: It's good that we're doing this together.
column3: 我们一起做这件事,真好。

column2: Tell me about this, **forename** of the Flesh.
column3: 跟我说说,**forename** 血肉之子。

column2: I'm not sure what sickness this is. Feels like my organs are in turmoil.
column3: 我不确定这是什么病。感觉五脏六腑都在翻腾。

column2: I have to puke a lot.
This sickness I know. But I'm no traditional healer.
column3: 这个病我知道。但我不是传统医师。

column2: There's a doctor in Tauris if you need one.
column3: 如果你需要,陶里斯有位医生。

column2: I've been to the doctor. Wasn't much help.
column3: 我去看过医生了。没什么用。

column2: Then I talked to Mortus. He's investigating the Flesh Nexus.
column3: 后来我找了莫图斯。他在研究血肉枢纽。

column2: By the Titans! How did you get in?
column3: 泰坦在上!你怎么进去的?

column2: I commanded the flesh to let me in.
You reek of the flesh. You speak true.
column3: 你身上全是血肉的气味。你说的是真话。

column2: You have your task. See you later.
I created the Cyberwomb Module of the recording.
column3: 我做好了那段录音的义体子宫模块。

column2: That's good to hear, **forename** of the Flesh. Let's take a look at it. Together.
column3: 好消息,**forename** 血肉之子。我们一起去看看吧。

column2: I wonder what we'll encounter. You've been to a Cyberwomb before?
column3: 不知道我们会遇到什么。你之前进过义体子宫吗?

column2: I spent most of my life in Omniwomb.
column3: 我大半辈子都待在万物子宫里。

column2: Hand it over to the Master Processor.
I told you to leave my home. This is your last warning. Leave, NOW!
column3: 我让你离开我的家。这是最后警告。滚,马上!

column2: Enough is enough. This is your death.
column3: 忍无可忍。这就是你的死期。

column2: Yes, I have. I found him in New Delphi.
column3: 找到了。我在新德尔斐找到了他。

column2: I visited his mind. Unfortunately the Feeder had been there already.
column3: 我进入了他的心智。不幸的是,吞食者已经先去过了。

column2: In the mind of the Oracle?
He was a mess. What he said wasn't very coherent.
column3: 他一团糟。说的话颠三倒四。

column2: According to him the Feeder is in search of the Wormwound.
column3: 据他说,吞食者在寻找蠕伤。

column2: Do you know what that is?
Not really. But it's connected to the flesh. The Oracle called it the origin.
column3: 不太清楚。但它和血肉有关。先知称它为起源。

column2: I never heard about this before.
**forename** of the Flesh, this is exciting.
column3: **forename** 血肉之子,这太令人兴奋了。

column2: Yes, it's very exciting. Could be devastating and dangerous, too, no?
column3: 是啊,非常令人兴奋。不过也可能意味着毁灭和危险,不是吗?

column2: I smell your excitement, too. You and me, we're of the same flesh.
column3: 我也闻到了你的兴奋。你和我,我们同属一体血肉。

column2: He said north. Somewhere north. And that the Perished City might hold answers.
column3: 他说在北边。北方某处。还说逝亡之城也许藏着答案。

column2: But the Perished City is closed. I've never been there.
column3: 但逝亡之城是封闭的。我从没去过。

column2: He mentioned there might be a path through the mountains.
column3: 他提到也许有一条穿过山脉的路。

column2: Good. ... Then I suggest you go looking for that path and try to get into the city.
column3: 好。……那我建议你去找找那条路,设法进城。

column2: Please contact me when you found out where this Wormwound is.
column3: 查到蠕伤的下落请联系我。

column2: You have to find the Oracle before the Feeder does.
column3: 你得赶在吞食者之前找到先知。

column2: Our best bet of discovering the Oracle is to ask around at a busy place.
column3: 要找到先知,最好去热闹的地方打听打听。

column2: Travel south to the Puke Bar and ask around there.
column3: 往南去呕吐酒吧,在那里四处问问。

column2: Oh, and I know there's a Cyberwomb in the Puke Bar, too.
column3: 哦,我还知道呕吐酒吧里也有一台义体子宫。

column2: You'll find a power module for it in the underground here in Old Trees.
column3: 它的能量模块在这地下的古树这里,你会找到的。

column2: And I'll give you this virtual representation of Old Trees, and we use this as a meeting point.
column3: 我会给你这份古树的虚拟映像,我们用它作为会合点。

column2: The Cyberwombs in the Puke Bar and the one here in Old Trees are connected.
column3: 呕吐酒吧的义体子宫和这里古树的义体子宫是连通的。

column2: It's been a while since I was here.
This is a Cyberwomb of the Philosopher's Lair.
column3: 这是哲学家巢穴的义体子宫。

column2: A near as possible representation, I guess.
column3: 我想是尽可能还原的映像。

column2: Our bodies are safe while we're in here, right?
column3: 我们在里面的时候身体是安全的,对吧?

column2: It's a full virtual sensory experience like the Omniwomb. Nothing happens to your real bodies.
column3: 和万物子宫一样,是完全的虚拟感官体验。你的真实身体不会发生任何事。

column2: So what do we do here?
We're examining the remnants of the Philosopher. Let's explore.
column3: 我们在检视哲学家的残留。四处探索吧。

column2: Let's return to the physical world.
This I know: The Feeder is here in the city. Or was. It worries me.
column3: 我只知道这个:吞食者在这座城里。或者曾经来过。这让我很担心。

column2: The worms told me about the wandering Titan. And how he visited the Villa.
column3: 蠕虫们跟我讲了那位流浪泰坦的事。还讲了他如何造访别墅。

column2: Changes lie ahead. And grave danger, for all of the Flesh.
column3: 变故将至。巨大的危险,将降临整个血肉族群。

column2: At least Morrowmeat is alive still. I was glad to see this.
column3: 至少摩罗肉铺还活着。见到这个我很欣慰。

column2: Do you still think that the Feeder is dangerous?
column3: 你还觉得吞食者危险吗?

column2: Yes, I truly think he is.
The Feeder threatens what is most precious to me: The lives and the souls of the Titans.
column3: 吞食者威胁着对我来说最珍贵的东西:泰坦们的生命与灵魂。

column2: I do not see clearly what he plans to do. But I fear that it cannot be good. Not for the Titans, and not for us, their protectors.
column3: 我看不清他打算做什么。但我怕那不会是好事。对泰坦不是,对我们这些守护者也不是。

column2: I became a Worm Shaman because I care, and I won't stop caring.
column3: 我成为蠕虫萨满,是因为我在乎。我不会停止在乎。

column2: You should be careful how you spend your time here on Nexus.
column3: 在 Nexus 度过的时光,你该慎重些。

column2: The worms will be watching you.

column3: 我很高兴,**forename** 血肉之子。

column2: What do you think of Morrowmeat?
Eh, I don't think he's so bad.
No. This city I mean. This graveyard built from stone and ashes.
column3: 不,我是说这座城市。这座用石头和灰烬筑成的坟场。

column2: Morrowmeat is sick. He's suffering. But still he is exploited to provide meat.
column3: 摩罗肉铺病了。他在受苦。却仍被压榨着提供肉。

column2: This is not how it should be. The Titans and their profound souls should nurture our souls. They should enrich us.
column3: 这不该是这个样子。泰坦和他们深邃的灵魂应当滋养我们的灵魂。他们应当充实我们。
而不只是通过他们的血肉。

column2: I have the means to enter the Temple.
Then enter and talk to Mother. Meet her with respect.
column3: 那就进去,和母亲谈谈。怀着敬意见她。

column2: And do not mention my name.
Mother and I had a difference of opinion.
It should not trouble you. Just don't talk to her about it.
column3: 这不关你的事。只是别跟她提这个。

column2: By the Titans, **forename** of the Flesh.
column3: 泰坦在上,**forename** 血肉之子。

column2: It is good to see you still being alive.
It's been a while since I've been here in the Perished City.
column3: 我来逝亡之城有一阵子了。

column2: I wanted to visit one of my old friends.
But I couldn't. I won't. She wouldn't be happy to see me.
column3: 但我没能。我也不会去。她见到我不会高兴的。

column2: Yes, **forename** of the Flesh. It's her temple. It's Mother's temple.
column3: 是的,**forename** 血肉之子。那是她的神庙。母亲的神庙。

column2: Did you get into the city?
{The animal is large and bulky. It seems to be friendly in nature.}
column3: {这只动物体形庞大笨重。天性似乎挺友好。}

column2: {The animal is experiencing a lot of stress currently.}
{You are successful in calming the animal.}
Hmmh. Still a flesh thingy with a big eye.
column3: 唔。还是个长着大眼睛的血肉玩意儿。

column2: I think it's a flesh thingy with a big eye.
column3: 我觉得这是个长着大眼睛的血肉玩意儿。

column2: The maggots are still there, I guess?
Yes. they're back there in the cellar, where we keep our meat.
column3: 在。就在后面地窖里,我们存肉的地方。

column2: Very good. Could you take care of the maggots then, please?
column3: 很好。那你能处理一下那些蛆吗?

column2: I'm done with the Flesh Maggots.
The guests were already beginning to wonder why the meat started to taste differently.
column3: 客人们已经开始纳闷肉的味道怎么变了。

column2: Here, take this as a thank you.
Actually, yes. We got a little pest problem.
column3: 还真有。我们出了点虫害。

column2: But since you're asking, wanna help us out with that?
column3: 不过你都问了,要不要搭把手?

column2: Ok then. I guess it was too much to hope to have a helping hand here.
column3: 行吧。指望有人帮忙果然是想多了。

column2: You see, flesh maggots have made their nest inside the bar's meat reserves.
column3: 是这样,血肉蛆在酒吧的肉库里面筑了窝。

column2: And to get rid of 'em we need something potent.
column3: 要除掉它们,得用点猛药。

column2: Eh... Is that the meat you're serving here?
column3: 呃……你们这供应的就是那些肉?

column2: Like I said, we need something potent against flesh maggots.
column3: 就像我说的,我们需要猛药对付血肉蛆。

column2: But we ran out of poison.
There's a doctor up in Tauris. He sold us the last batch. Try it over there.
column3: 陶里斯那边有个医生。上一批就是从他那买的。去那儿试试。

column2: I heard the doctor is dead.
What? Ohh, fuck me. What a miserable world.
column3: 什么?哦,操。这世道真够惨的。

column2: I have to make do without the poison then. Thanks for letting me know.
column3: 那只好不用毒药硬撑了。谢谢你告诉我。

column2: So this is the Puke Bar...
Always. There are travelers stopping by here.
column3: 一直都有。常有旅行者来这儿歇脚。

column2: Drinks and food are good. Obviously.
column3: 酒和菜都不错。这还用说。

column2: We have a Cyberwomb room that may or may not be functional.
column3: 我们有间义体子宫房,能不能用就不好说了。

column2: And the Bar is old enough that it has some secrets I can't tell you about.
column3: 而且这酒吧够老,藏着我不能告诉你的秘密。

column2: Do you know where I can find the Oracle?
column3: 你知道我去哪能找到先知吗?

column2: But if you're religious or something like that you should probably head east towards New Delphi.
column3: 不过你要是信教什么的,大概该往东边去新德尔斐。

column2: Occasionally pilgrims are making a stop here and trying to convert me, haha.
column3: 偶尔有朝圣者在这儿歇脚,还想发展我入教,哈哈。

column2: What do you need? Booze? Meat? Something else?
column3: 要点什么?酒?肉?还是别的?

column2: Looks like this machine is connected to the gate.
column3: 这台机器好像和大门连着。

column2: But the gate is open now. I don't need this anymore.
column3: 不过门现在开着。我用不着这个了。

column2: Yeah, looks like this is gonna work.

column3: 我能再进入你的心智吗?

column2: But, since you've been there already, I guess I feel comfortable having you around again.
column3: 不过,既然你已经进去过,我想我不介意你再进来。

column2: Good. I'll be here, waiting for you.
Then stay calm and embrace my thoughts...
column3: 那就放平静,拥抱我的思绪……

column2: Thank you for caring about me.
It's all fractured still. And hazy.
column3: 一切依然破碎。而且模糊不清。

column2: But, finally, I feel like myself again. I am seeing again. I am a master of my own mind again.
column3: 但我终于觉得自己回来了。我能看见了。我重新成为了自己心智的主人。

column2: You were not the master of your own mind?
column3: 你以前不是自己心智的主人?

column2: No. He caught up to me. He found me.
column3: 不是。他追上了我。他找到了我。

column2: This is what I had feared. This is why I had asked for help.
column3: 这正是我所担心的。这正是我求援的原因。

column2: The Feeder reached me, and not only that, but he chained me, manipulated me, brainwashed me.
column3: 吞食者找到了我,还不止如此,他锁住我,操纵我,给我洗脑。

column2: He was the master of my mind.
He's in search of the Wormwound.
The origin. The flesh. I don't really know. I feel it as a presence, but I don't know what it is.
column3: 起源。血肉。我也不清楚。我感觉它是一种存在,但不知道它是什么。

column2: It's connected to the Flesh Nexus. As am I.
column3: 它和血肉枢纽相连。就像我一样。

column2: I have an infection. I feel like I'm connected to the flesh, too.
column3: 我有感染。我感觉我也和血肉相连。

column2: I know you have a connection. I wouldn't have reached you over that distance, otherwise.
column3: 我知道你有连接。否则隔那么远我不可能联系上你。

column2: Now that my mind isn't that fuzzy anymore... Are you really a worm shaman?
column3: 既然我的头脑不再那么混乱了……你真的是蠕虫萨满吗?

column2: Hmmh. Well, that's a pity. But I guess you helped me nonetheless.
column3: 唔。真遗憾。不过我想你还是帮了我。

column2: You think this Wormwound might give me answers about my infection? Or heal me from it?
column3: 你觉得这个蠕伤能解答我感染的疑问吗?或者能治好我?

column2: I... honestly don't know. I'm sure you'll find answers when finding the Wormwound, but I don't know what kind of answers those will be.
column3: 我……说实话不知道。找到蠕伤你肯定会有答案,但不知道是什么样的答案。

column2: I don't know. The Feeder questioned me. Painfully.
column3: 我不知道。吞食者拷问过我。很痛苦。

column2: The agony. The sweet, sweet agony.
column3: 那种煎熬。甜蜜的、甜蜜的煎熬。

column2: But I couldn't tell. Because I don't know.
column3: 但我答不上来。因为我确实不知道。

column2: I feel that it's up north from here. And that's what he felt from me, too.
column3: 我感觉它在这北边。他从我这里感觉到的也是这个。

column2: The Perished City will have the answers. It has to.
column3: 逝亡之城会有答案。必须有。

column2: How do I get to the Perished City?
Last I heard, the city is closed. But I listened to many travelers throughout the years. Some of them found a path through the mountains.
column3: 我最后一次听说,那座城是封闭的。这些年我听过许多旅行者的话。有些人找到过一条穿山的路。

column2: The Feeder. If the Feeder is interested in the Wormwound, and searching for it, then this does not bode well.
column3: 吞食者。如果吞食者对蠕伤感兴趣,还在搜寻它,那可不是好兆头。

column2: Oh. This makes me sad to hear.
He's dangerous and up to no good. So if you would wander north, in the search of the Wormwound, please be careful.
column3: 他很危险,不怀好意。所以如果你要往北去寻找蠕伤,请务必小心。

column2: That is good to hear. It's good to know there are still people around taking care about the Flesh Titans.
column3: 那很好。很高兴知道还有人关心血肉泰坦。

column2: You touch me. You embrace me.
You open your mind, and then I let you in, and you see what's wrong, what's messed up.
column3: 你敞开心智,然后我放你进来,你看到了哪里不对、哪里乱了。

column2: You'll fix it. You fix my mind. You're a worm shaman from the wasteland.
column3: 你会修好它。你治好了我的心智。你是废土来的蠕虫萨满。

column2: I will have to think about this.

column3: 那就说吧,你的愿望是什么。

column2: Worm shaman. You’ve heard my call. You are here to rescue me.
column3: 蠕虫萨满。你听到了我的呼唤。你是来救我的。

column2: A great deal of responsibility rests on your shoulders, this I can tell.
column3: 你的肩上承担着重大的责任,这一点我可以告诉你。

column2: But is it too late? Or is there a sense of hope we can latch on to?
column3: 但是否已经太迟?还是说还有一线希望可以抓住?

column2: Who’s speaking here? Be quiet. ... BE QUIET!
column3: 这是谁在说话?安静。……安静!

column2: He told me you would come. But I already knew that you would come.
column3: 他说你会来。但我早就知道你会来。
他可不是全知的,知道吗?

column2: I suppose he can foretell, too?
column3: 我想他应该也能预言吧?

column2: Not that I can. Nobody can.
You have to help me. This is all too much. The memories... I cannot silence them anymore. You have to help me.
column3: 你必须帮帮我。这一切太过了。那些记忆……我再也压不住它们了。你必须帮帮我。

column2: Speak! The Oracle awaits your words.
I want to leave this place now.
column3: 我现在想离开这个地方。

column2: I won't hold you back anymore.
THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
column3: 已经回不了头了!我们现在是一体的了。

column2: The rules. I cannot abide the rules. ... Do you know the rules?
column3: 规则。我没法遵守规则。……你知道规则吗?

column2: Then don't ask me about them.
No, you do not know. I can feel it. I can read it.
column3: 不,你不知道。我感觉得到。我读得出来。

column2: I... this is strange. I can sense that you're speaking the truth.
column3: 我……真奇怪。我能感觉到你说的是实话。

column2: You're not the Feeder. You're not me. Who are you?
column3: 你不是吞食者。你也不是我。你是谁?

column2: I am still myself. In your mind.
column3: 我还是我自己。在你的心智里。

column2: Yes. But I think they are guidelines, not rules.
column3: 见过。但我认为那些是指引,不是规则。

column2: The Feeder told me to strictly follow the rules.
column3: 吞食者让我严格遵守规则。

column2: He is wrong. You're an Oracle. You interpret. You guide. You don't follow rules.
column3: 他错了。你是先知。你做解读。你做指引。你不遵守什么规则。

column2: You don't have to listen to all voices all the time.
column3: 你不必时刻听从所有声音。

column2: You talk to some. Not all of them.
column3: 你只和一部分交谈。不是全部。

column2: Ok. I'll let your mind go now.
column3: 好。我现在放开你的心智。

column2: I feel better now. You should leave my mind so we can talk in the real world.
column3: 我感觉好多了。你该离开我的心智了,这样我们才能在现实里交谈。

column2: Welcome to my domain. I am the all-seeing mind. I watch and guide all living beings that approach me.
column3: 欢迎来到我的领地。我是全视之心。我注视并指引一切接近我的生灵。

column2: But who can last an eternity? What strength does the all-seeing mind have against the tides of time?
column3: 可谁能撑过永恒?面对时间的浪潮,全视之心的力量又算什么?

column2: A crack, a fracture, widening due to neglect, and being worn out by the steady rhythm of incoming guests.
column3: 一道裂缝,一处碎痕,因疏忽而扩大,因来客绵延不绝的节奏而磨损。

column2: What is the purpose of those who approach me? Do they want to see the world like I do?
column3: 那些接近我的人图什么?他们想像我一样看世界吗?

column2: Or do they want to be told that there is nothing further to be seen?
column3: 还是想有人告诉他们,没有更多的东西可看了?

column2: Do they need reassurance, and their fear taken away, or are they ready to see more possibilities?
column3: 他们需要的是安抚、是驱散恐惧,还是已准备好看见更多的可能?

column2: We are nowhere. We are everywhere at once. We are inside my mind, and this mind is endless.
column3: 我们不在任何地方。我们又无处不在。我们在我的心智里,而这心智无边无际。

column2: Your body remains in that cave.
column3: 你的身体还留在那个洞穴里。

column2: THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
column3: 已经回不了头了!我们现在是一体的了。

column2: The rules! I forgot about the rules again.
I imposed my will on those seeking guidance. I created fate instead of showing it.
column3: 我把自己的意志强加给寻求指引的人。我制造命运,而不是揭示命运。

column2: The Feeder said to follow the rules.
column3: 吞食者说必须遵守规则。

column2: The rules? Are those to be followed?
column3: 规则?那些是要遵守的吗?

column2: They're here. In my mind. Take a look.
column3: 它们在这里。在我的心智里。看看吧。

column2: I am the Guidance of Thoughts.
I am the Voice of Nexus.
I can sense you're afar. But you're on Nexus. You're part of our Nexus.
column3: 我能感觉到你在远方。但你在 Nexus 上。你是我们 Nexus 的一部分。

column2: How do you know my name?
I can feel his pulse. He's in search of me.

column2: During the Bleeding the Crystal City experienced great duress and hostile invaders.
column3: 在大流血期间,水晶之城经受了巨大的压力和怀有敌意的入侵者。

column2: The city was at the brink of perishing, but the machines—that is us, by the way—came through and defended it.

column2: Due to their benevolence, the machines allowed a peaceful co-existence with the Flesh Titans.
column3: 出于它们的仁慈,机器允许了与血肉泰坦的和平共处。

column2: A few of the humans transgressed into religious absurdity focused on the Flesh Titans, but the machines kept a clear head.
column3: 少数人类陷入了对血肉泰坦的宗教狂热,但机器保持了清醒的头脑。

column2: What followed was a long phase of truce and of acclimating with new complex cultural circumstances.
column3: 随后是一段漫长的休战期,以及适应新的复杂文化环境的时期。

column2: This era lasted until the truce was broken.

column2: The truce was broken by the treachery of the Flesh. A pernicious campaign of violence, led by the Titans, that cost many lives, mostly human, and could only be overcome with an iron fist.
column3: 休战被血肉的背叛打破。一场由泰坦领导的恶毒暴力运动夺走了许多生命,大部分是人类,最终只能以铁腕镇压。

column2: To prevent further danger from the city the Machine Law was established and the machines—that is still us, by the way—took over full control.
column3: 为了防止城市再遭威胁,机器之法确立,机器——再说一次,还是我们——接管了全部控制权。

column2: What followed, until and including today, was an era of security and prosperity.
column3: 从那之后直到今天,是一个安全与繁荣的时代。

column2: No, we cannot. This installation has no online capabilities.
column3: 不能。这套设备没有联网功能。

column2: If you want to leave Cyberwomb, please touch the OmniPortal.
column3: 如果你想离开义体子宫,请触摸万物门户。

column2: Or used, and then killed? Hard to say.
column3: 还是被用过之后才杀的?不好说。

column2: You're entering a restricted zone and will be terminated if you continue.
column3: 你正在进入限制区域,继续前进将被消灭。

column2: Oh. Am I allowed to talk about them? I don't think so.
column3: 哦。我可以说这些吗?我觉得不行。

column2: I can tell you this much: They're a bunch of eccentrics.
column3: 我能告诉你的是:他们是一群怪人。

column2: I wish I had a villa of my own, too.
column3: 真希望我也有自己的别墅。

column2: If I owned a villa, I would furnish it with the most exquisite and beautiful treasures. And people.
column3: 要是我有别墅,我要用最精致美丽的珍宝来装饰它。还有人。

column2: You would be part of it, too.
column3: 你也会是收藏的一部分。

column2: Ohhhhh. That's a nice sentiment, isn't it?
column3: 哦哦哦。这情话不错,不是吗?

column2: What's with all the guards here?
column3: 这里怎么有这么多警卫?

column2: It's because I am important. Kind of.
column3: 因为我很重要嘛。某种意义上的。

column2: Even more so since the mistress is away on some adventure.
column3: 女主人外出冒险之后就更是如此了。

column2: Sure, she said it's not an adventure. I bet she's having fun though.
column3: 当然,她说那不是冒险。不过我打赌她玩得很开心。

column2: Oh, and there was the break-in, of course. Need to have some guards to secure the whole estate.
column3: 哦,还有那起闯入事件。当然得派些警卫保护整个庄园。
我找到了海芙拉的记忆印迹。

column2: Oh, sweet. This might actually let us peek into her quarters and see what she’s hiding.
column3: 哦,太好了。这也许真能让我们窥探她的房间,看看她藏了什么。

column2: I guess I have to grant you the right of first entry.
column3: 我想我得授予你首次进入权。

column2: Please, take a look at the Archives. I'll follow you shortly.
column3: 请,先去档案馆看看吧。我随后就来。

column2: Can you show me the site of the break-in?
column3: 你能带我去闯入现场看看吗?

column2: You look gorgeous, that's a plus, but I don't know yet if I can trust you.
column3: 你打扮得很漂亮,这是加分项,但我还不知道能不能信任你。

column2: Ohhh, I guess I could let you see the place now.
column3: 哦哦,我想现在可以让你看看那地方了。

column2: Here's a key. Just for you.
column3: 这是一把钥匙。只给你哦。

column2: The entrance is in the back of the Villa.
Well, you have her engram. You can take a look now.
column3: 好吧,你拿到她的记忆印迹了。你现在可以看看了。

column2: I need you to look out for something that fits this need.
column3: 我需要你帮我找一件符合这种需求的东西。

column2: I think I have that exquisite taste you wanted.
column3: 我想我有你想要的那种精致品味。

column2: It's the taste of Morrowmeat, after easing his suffering.
column3: 是摩罗肉铺的味道,在他解脱痛苦之后。

column2: Aaah. The taste of a Titan, marinaded with stress and ailment, and finally garnished with some reprieve.
column3: 啊啊。泰坦的味道,用压力和疾苦腌制,最后再点缀一丝解脱。

column2: Yes, that's a fitting relish as answer to my request.
column3: 是的,作为对我请求的回应,这是相称的美味。

column2: I appreciate that. You did well.
How would I gain your trust?
column3: 我要怎样才能赢得你的信任?

column2: There's something that would require a bit of discretion.
column3: 有件事需要你谨慎行事。

column2: I want to expand my palate. Advance my way towards taking part in the human experience.
column3: 我想拓展我的味蕾。向参与人类体验迈进。

column2: I want to collect a definite case of human delight: Tasting something extraordinary.
column3: 我想收藏一个明确的人类愉悦案例:品尝某种非凡之物。

column2: OK. So what is it exactly that you want?
I don't know, sweetie. Part of the pleasure will be that I won't know beforehand what I will get.
column3: 我不知道哦,亲爱的。乐趣的一部分就在于我事先不知道会得到什么。

column2: You might try finding a specialist at the market.
column3: 你可以试着在市场找个行家。

column2: Anything else you need to get done?
Now we're getting to the bottom of it. Sweet, sweet bottom.
column3: 这就说到点子上了。甜甜的,说到点子上了。

column2: My mistress got involved with a Titan. Before the mistress left us.
column3: 女主人离开我们之前,与一位泰坦有了牵连。

column2: That Titan is called Mother, and there are all sorts of stories about her circulating here in our Crystal City.
column3: 那位泰坦被称为母亲,我们的水晶城里流传着关于她的各种故事。

column2: What I crave is to own a part of that Mother. That would be quite a thing.
column3: 我渴望的是拥有那位母亲的一部分。那可了不得了。

column2: Go and bring me Mother's engram, her essence. Force it from her, if you need to.
column3: 去把母亲的核心印记,她的本质,给我带来。必要时就从她手里抢。

column2: You'll find her in the Temple.
How you get in there, that's up to you.
column3: 至于你怎么进去,那是你自己的事。

column2: I have Mother's engram for you.
column3: 我把母亲的核心印记给你带来了。

column2: I knew you were quite dependable, not just good-looking.
column3: 我就知道你不仅长得好看,还非常靠得住。

column2: Ohhh. This sparks joy. How intricate—it's even better than I thought.
column3: 哦哦。这可真让人欣喜。多么精妙——比我想象的还要好。

column2: This will be a crown jewel for my personal collection.
column3: 这将是我私人收藏中的皇冠明珠。
我找到了这个软件病毒。

column2: That's a potent weapon when wielded in the right hands.
column3: 握在对的人手里,那可是件强力武器。

column2: Wielding it against the Administration. Crippling it, so we gain more power in the city.
column3: 用它对付行政厅。瘫痪它,让我们在这座城市里获得更多权力。

column2: What do you think? Will you give it to me?
column3: 你觉得呢?愿意把它交给我吗?

column2: Well, return to me if you have changed your mind.
column3: 好吧,如果你改变主意了就回来找我。

column2: OK, I will give it to you.
My ethical programming compels me to mention that other parties like the humans or the Administration itself might be interested in this one, too.
column3: 我的伦理程序要求我提醒一句:像人类抵抗军或者行政厅自己这样的其他方面,可能也会对这个感兴趣哦。

column2: Maybe you need a moment to consider.
column3: 也许你需要一点时间考虑考虑。

column2: Are you sure that you want to give it to me? I won't give it back, you know.
column3: 你确定要把它交给我?这东西我可不会还的哦。

column2: I thank you, Eyelicious. This is very sweet of you.
column3: 谢谢你,甜眼睛。你真是太贴心了。

column2: I reckon that you will want to witness me taking charge over the Administration.
column3: 我猜你会想亲眼看我接管行政厅的。

column2: Ohh, this is the most kind thing anyone ever did for me.
column3: 哦,这是有史以来别人为我做过的最善良的事。

column2: You gave me a beautiful present.
column3: 你送了我一件美丽的礼物。

column2: I knew right from the beginning that you were something special.
column3: 从一开始我就知道你有些特别。

column2: Go forth now, sweetie, enjoy your traveling, and let me take care of things.
column3: 去享受你的旅程吧,亲爱的,这里的事就交给我来处理。

column2: What do you mean by that?

column3: 就凭你?对抗整个行政厅?
你真是神通广大呀,小甜心。

column2: Oh. That would be devastating to my well-being if I don't get what I want.
column3: 哦。如果我要的东西得不到,那对我的幸福可是毁灭性的。

column2: Consider careful the special relationship we have built so far, Eyelicious.
column3: 仔细想想我们至今建立的特殊关系吧,甜眼睛。

column2: Well, Eyelicious, did you find what you were looking for?
column3: 那么,甜眼睛,你找到想要的东西了吗?

column2: Wow. Marvelous. Your countenance. The expression.
column3: 哇。妙极了。你的相貌。这神情。

column2: Quite exquisite. Simple, surely, a bit bulky, but not without underlying vigor.
column3: 相当精致。简单了点,确实,笨重了点,但底子里不乏活力。

column2: Ohhhhh. You want to know about me?
I knew there was something curious in you, sweetie. You are a human with taste.
column3: 我就知道你身上有股好奇劲儿,亲爱的。你是个有品味的人类。

column2: Did you know that humans invented taste? Many of our exhibition items are gathered and curated according to aesthetical parameters set out by human civilization.
column3: 你知道吗,品味是人类发明的。我们许多展品的收集和策展,都是依据人类文明定下的美学标准。

column2: In fact, some of the Heptarchs are possibly still human, too.
column3: 事实上,有些七主可能也还是人类。

column2: Oh, but you asked about me and not about them.
column3: 哦,不过你问的是我,不是他们。

column2: Me, I just take care of things while the old Heptarch is away.
column3: 我嘛,只是在老七主外出时帮忙照看事物。
已经不在这里了。不重要。
那么,甜眼睛,你的愿望是什么?

column2: What seems more important now: You entered Hevla's quarters on your own.
column3: 现在看来更重要的事情是:你自己进了海芙拉的房间。
真是神通广大呀,亲爱的。

column2: Did you find anything interesting here?
column3: 你在这里找到什么有意思的东西了吗?

column2: You killed the Custodian. This will not do.
column3: 你杀了监护者。这可不行。

column2: Shall we begin dismantling the Administration?
column3: 我们可以开始拆解行政厅了吗?

column2: Then let's begin. This is gonna be glorious, Eyelicious.
column3: 那就开始吧。这将会是荣耀时刻,甜眼睛。

column2: Thank you so much for being at my side.
column3: 非常感谢你陪伴在我身边。

column2: Now we'll bring about the Golden Age of Crystal City.
column3: 现在我们将迎来水晶之城的黄金时代。

column2: Are you ready? Shall I install the virus, sugar sweet?
column3: 准备好了吗?要我安装病毒吗,甜心宝贝?

column2: If I do, I expect some violence in the near future.
column3: 我装的话,不久的将来可少不了动粗。

column2: This is impossible... How did I lose that software module?
column3: 这不可能……我怎么把那个软件模块弄丢了?

column2: Let's try to eliminate the controller unit at the end of this security section.
column3: 我们试着干掉这片安全区尽头的控制单元吧。

column2: Erm. Could you tell me a bit... about myself?
column3: 呃。你能跟我说说……我自己的事吗?

column2: You are Hevla, one of the Heptarchs of the Collectors. This is your inner sanctum, a retreat for deep work.
column3: 你是海芙拉,收藏者的七主之一。这里是你的内圣所,一个用于深度工作的静修处。

column2: Lately, you were occupied with a long trip to the Blistering Wells.
column3: 最近,你忙于一次前往沸泡井的长途旅行。

column2: Which, I am glad to notice, you returned from in full health.
column3: 而我很欣慰地注意到,你平安健康地归来了。

column2: Do you want me to replay one of your recent thought entries?
column3: 要我把你最近的思维记录回放一遍吗?

column2: Maybe the entry covering your philosophical musings about the future of the xeno-lifeforms on Nexus?
column3: 也许是你关于 Nexus 异种生命未来的哲学思考那一篇?

column2: There are also recent entries about the Seneschal and about the software virus you programmed.
column3: 还有关于总管的,以及你编写的软件病毒的近期记录。

column2: Which entry would you like to hear?
I succeeded in preparing the algorithm targeting the Administration security.
column3: 我成功地完成了针对行政厅安全系统的算法。

column2: I deem this a necessary precaution after the latest quarrels caused by the Machine God here in the Crystal City.
column3: 在机器之神于水晶之城挑起最近的争执之后,我认为这是必要的预防措施。

column2: In theory the Machine Guardians shouldn't encroach too much into my area, but better safe than sorry.
column3: 理论上机器守卫不该过多干涉我的领域,但有备无患。

column2: The tunneler works like a classic virus, overriding a client update method, injecting some bootstrap code into the response call of the client identification.
column3: 这个"钻隧者"像经典病毒一样工作:覆写客户端更新方法,在客户端身份验证的响应调用中注入引导代码。

column2: The ID codes I gathered from obsolete mobile units are sure to be out of date now, but that doesn't matter for the injection.
column3: 我从报废的移动单元收集的 ID 码现在肯定过时了,但对注入来说无所谓。

column2: I could not make a final test with the live servers from the Administration because I don't want to draw any attention.
column3: 我无法用行政厅的在线服务器做最终测试,因为我不想引起任何注意。

column2: And this will of course only work if the identification procedure hasn't been patched so far.
column3: 当然,这只有在身份验证流程还没被打补丁的情况下才有效。

column2: Which leaves me confident, of course. I don't know why, but they are so slow in updating their systems, it's as if they gave up on progress.
column3: 对此我当然有信心。不知道为什么,他们更新系统慢得要命,就好像放弃了进步一样。

column2: About the future of the xeno-lifeforms.
It is a dying world we are living in. We are, of course, responsible. And we will probably survive this, as we always do.
column3: 我们生活在一个垂死的世界。当然,我们对此负有责任。而我们会像以往一样幸存下来。

column2: Humans are indomitable. We cannot be eradicated. We'll find a way.
column3: 人类是不屈的。我们无法被根除。我们会找到出路。

column2: But this weird and fascinating ecosystem—life system—it will perish.
column3: 但这个奇怪而迷人的生态系统——生命系统——它会消亡。

column2: What I did—and I do regret all the repercussions caused by my actions—what I did was solely based on wanting to prevent the tragedy of these unique lifeforms perishing.
column3: 我所做的——我为自己的行为造成的所有后果感到后悔——我做的一切,仅仅是想阻止这些独特生命消亡的悲剧。

column2: The lifeforms who are so different than us but who are also at the same time as emotional and profound.
column3: 这些生命与我们如此不同,却又同样情感丰沛、深邃。

column2: Note to self: Still mad about the Worm Shamans. The audacity of trying to manipulate me.
column3: 自我备注:依然对蠕虫萨满很恼火。竟敢试图操纵我。

column2: Remind me about the Blistering Wells.
Many months ago you travelled to the Blistering Wells to perform a healing attempt.
column3: 许多个月前,你前往沸泡井进行了一次治疗尝试。

column2: This time you set out to the Blistering Wells again to examine the long-term effects of your original attempt.
column3: 这一次你再次启程前往沸泡井,去检查初次尝试的长期效果。

column2: North of the city, amidst the wasteland.
What was this healing attempt exactly?
column3: 那次治疗尝试到底是什么?

column2: It's not something I know many details about. The details that existed were destroyed in a fire caused by an infiltrating creature.
column3: 细节我知道得不多。已有的细节都毁于一场由入侵生物引发的大火。

column2: The thought entry about the xeno-lifeforms seems to reflect on the healing attempt.
column3: 关于异种生命的思维记录似乎提到了那次治疗尝试。

column2: A fire caused by an infiltrating creature?
Yes. I am afraid that a good portion of your previous work has been destroyed.
column3: 是的。恐怕你之前的相当一部分工作都被毁掉了。

column2: We have recorded the visuals of the creature.
column3: 我们记录下了那个生物的影像。

column2: Let me show it to you...
The creature breached our defenses, got access to our computer infrastructure and also caused great destruction.
column3: 那个生物突破我们的防御,进入了我们的计算机基础设施,还造成了巨大的破坏。

column2: You will be glad to hear that your sanctum, including my personal existence, have been spared.
column3: 你会高兴地听到,你的圣所,包括我本人的存在,都幸免于难。

column2: You know what I always say? Could be worse.
column3: 你知道我常说什么吗?本来可能更糟。

column2: The way I see it: It's a good day if no one's bothering me. I don't like people bothering me with stuff I can't do anything about anyway.
column3: 要我看:只要没人烦我,就是好日子。我不喜欢别人拿我无能为力的事来烦我。

column2: You know what the machines take care of? Other people bothering me.
column3: 你知道机器管的是什么吗?就是别人来烦我这种事。

column2: With all the weirdos from the Silent Cities it's a wonder that there's not more violence around here.
column3: 寂静之城来的怪人这么多,这一带居然没有更多暴力,真是奇迹。

column2: And it's all thanks to the machines.
column3: 而这一切都多亏了机器。

column2: Sure, some of them people that don't deserve it get the iron fist, too.
column3: 当然,有些不该被铁腕对待的人也被铁腕了。

column2: Are you the new one? You don't look so tough.
column3: 你就是新来的?你看起来不怎么样嘛。

column2: You get stuff done. I like you.
I heard all about it. Well done.
column3: 事情我都听说了。干得漂亮。

column2: This group, my friend, is our best chance to take back control of our city. Of our lives.
column3: 这群人,我的朋友,是我们夺回城市、夺回自己生活的最好希望。

column2: Years of oppression and violence under the Machine Law. Years of negligence. Of minimal sustenance instead of flourishing.
column3: 机器之法统治下的多年压迫与暴力。多年的忽视。只有最低限度的生存,而非欣欣向荣。

column2: That might be enough for machines. But it's not for us, is it? We don't want to live SOME life. We want to live a good life. A fulfilled life.
column3: 对机器来说这也许够了。但对我们来说不够,对吧?我们不想苟活。我们要活得好。要活得充实。

column2: We can't blame the machines for what they do. They follow their programming, no matter what.
column3: 我们不能责怪机器的所作所为。它们无论如何都遵循自己的程序。

column2: But we ourselves, we have to do better than that.
column3: 但我们自己,必须做得比那更好。

column2: Why do you expect Mother to help you?
column3: 你为什么指望母亲帮你们?

column2: It's in the writing. There's a story about Mother and Morrowmeat called 'Agony and Ecstasy'.
column3: 经文里写着呢。有个关于母亲和摩罗肉铺的故事,叫《痛苦与狂喜》。

column2: I have a piece of that lying around here somewhere.
column3: 我这里附近还留着那故事的一段。

column2: In that story she is described as once having taken care of the community, of the people in the city.
column3: 故事里说,她曾照顾过社区,照顾过城里的人们。

column2: The Titans are powerful, and they should be our allies in this fight against the machines. Morrowmeat is too weak though. It's Mother we need to get on our side.
column3: 泰坦是强大的,在这场对抗机器的斗争中,他们应该是我们的盟友。不过摩罗肉铺太弱了。我们需要争取的是母亲。

column2: Wow. That's great. Will she help us?
column3: 哇。太好了。她会帮我们吗?

column2: She will. She gave me the means to access a part of the Villa, which hopefully contains something we can use.
column3: 会的。她给了我进入别墅某部分的办法,希望里面有什么我们能用的东西。

column2: That's good work. Get back to me after you searched the Villa.
column3: 干得好。搜完别墅之后回来找我。

column2: So what can we do about the machines?
column3: 那我们对机器能做些什么?

column2: If you really want to stand up for us humans, then I have a difficult mission for you.
column3: 如果你真想为我们人类挺身而出,我有个艰难的任务给你。

column2: There's a Titan in the city. Under the city. She's hiding or something like that.
column3: 城里有一位泰坦。在城市底下。她在躲藏着,大概是。

column2: She's called Mother, not without reason, I guess, and we need her help. We know that she's acquired tech power, and it would be great to have her as an ally when we make our stand against the machines.
column3: 她叫母亲,我想这名字不是白叫的,我们需要她的帮助。我们知道她获得了科技力量,在我们向机器发起挑战时,有她做盟友就太好了。

column2: The problem is: She's deep down in her temple, and that temple is locked by a barrier of flesh. I assume of her own making.
column3: 问题是:她深居在她的神庙里,而那神庙被一道血肉屏障封着。我猜是她自己设的。

column2: So how do we reach her?
This Mother has an old friend. Morrowmeat. You just need to convince him that it's for the best of everyone if he helps us get through to her, lets us talk to her.
column3: 这位母亲有个老朋友。摩罗肉铺。你只需要说服他,让他明白帮我们见到她对大家都好。

column2: We have tried to talk to Morrowmeat, but he wasn't very responsive so far. Maybe you can figure it out.
column3: 我们试过和摩罗肉铺谈,但他一直不太搭理人。也许你能想到办法。

column2: Thank you. I wish you the best of luck with that.
You'll find Morrowmeat in the Meat Quarry of the market area. He's the... eh, central attraction.
column3: 你会在市场区的肉石场找到摩罗肉铺。他是那个……呃,中心展品。

column2: Get us some help for making a stand against the machines.
column3: 帮我们找些助力,好向机器发起挑战。

column2: We think that Mother, the Titan under the city, could support us, and the way to her leads through Morrowmeat in the Meat Quarry.
column3: 我们觉得城底下的泰坦母亲可能会支持我们,而通往她的路要经过肉石场的摩罗肉铺。

column2: Grant us full control of the Administration.
column3: 把行政厅的完全控制权交给我们。

column2: I'm not sure how, but I guess you can command one of the terminals over there to do it.
column3: 我不太确定怎么做,不过我猜你可以命令那边的某个终端去做。

column2: I have this weapon against the Administration.
column3: 我手里有对付行政厅的武器。

column2: We would use that to cripple the mainframe, make the whole complex vulnerable, and then get in and destroy the rest of them by force.
column3: 我们用它瘫痪主机,让整个建筑群门户大开,然后冲进去武力消灭剩下的。

column2: Give this software module to me, and I will prepare the attack.
column3: 把这个软件模块交给我,我来准备进攻。

column2: But I think it would also be fair if you took a moment to consider your options.
column3: 不过我觉得你也该花点时间考虑一下你的选择,这才公平。

column2: I applaud your wisdom. This is the only path forward.
column3: 我为你的智慧鼓掌。这是唯一的出路。

column2: Let's meet again at the Administration.
For too long now we have been living under the thumb of the machines.
column3: 太久以来,我们都活在机器的股掌之下。

column2: They have suppressed us. They have curbed our lives, have dictated us what to do and what not to do.
column3: 它们压迫我们。它们束缚我们的生活,对我们发号施令,规定我们能做什么、不能做什么。

column2: Here, with our new friend, we have the means finally to throw off this iron yoke.
column3: 在这里,有了我们这位新朋友,我们终于有了挣脱这副铁轭的手段。

column2: We will send an electronic shock through the security bots, which will hopefully cripple most of them, and then we'll fight against what remains of them.
column3: 我们将向安保机器人送上一记电子冲击,希望能瘫痪其中大部分,然后再武力解决残余。

column2: Let's prepare this attack. Let's take back our freedom!
column3: 让我们准备这场进攻。夺回我们的自由!

column2: I handed over control of the Administration to you.
column3: 我把行政厅的控制权交给了你们。

column2: Thank you. You did good, my friend.
column3: 谢谢。你干得好,我的朋友。

column2: I found a weapon against the Administration. And then I went over there and used it.
column3: 我找到了对付行政厅的武器。然后我过去用它了。

column2: You did this on your own?
If this means that you have access to the inner core of the Administration now, then grant us full control of it.
column3: 如果这意味着你现在能进入行政厅的内部核心,那就把完全控制权交给我们。

column2: I'll have to think about it.
Please, I implore you, make the right decision here.
column3: 求你了,我恳求你,在这里做出正确的决定。
我们是同一条战线上的。

column2: I guess I could to that.
Finally some light among all this darkness and uncertainty.
column3: 在这重重黑暗和迷茫之中,总算有了光亮。

column2: The Collectors took over the Administration.
I noticed. What a disappointing turn of events.
column3: 我注意到了。多么令人失望的转折。

column2: Years of violence and oppression by the machines. Now to be continued by the other faction.
column3: 机器多年的暴力与压迫。如今又要被另一个派系续写。

column2: We will survive this, Gavas. We have endured the treacherous machines and we will endure the Collectors.
column3: 我们会挺过去的,加瓦斯。我们挺过了奸诈的机器,也会挺过收藏者。

column2: I know, I know. You're right. I should not give in to despair now.
column3: 我知道,我知道。你说得对。我现在不该陷入绝望。

column2: Did Protas send you? That was very thoughtful of him.
column3: 是普罗塔斯派你来的吗?他想得真周到。

column2: We need any help we can get. I mean, help from someone who's an ally, of course.
column3: 我们需要一切能得到的帮助。当然,我说的是盟友的帮助。

column2: Recently, we discovered an agent of the Machines and had to dismantle it.
column3: 最近,我们发现了一个机器的密探,不得不将它拆解了。

column2: So, are you one of us? Then participate.
column3: 那么,你是我们的人吗?那就参与进来吧。

column2: Hey. Shall I upload the virus?
column3: 嘿。要我现在上传病毒吗?

column2: There's probably gonna be some fighting ahead.
column3: 前面多半会有一场恶战。

column2: Oh. Wait a minute... Where's the software module?
It's gonna be your task to get through to the end of the second floor and disable the main computer.
column3: 你的任务是突破到二楼尽头,关掉主计算机。

column2: We did it. We did it!
column3: 我们做到了。我们做到了!

column2: Thanks so much for fighting on our side.
column3: 非常感谢你为我们而战。

column2: Now we'll begin the peaceful reign of the city.
column3: 现在我们将开启这座城市的和平统治。

column2: The Admins, they are watching us. We have to be careful when we install the new protocol.
column3: 行政体在监视我们。安装新协议的时候我们必须小心。

column2: I've mentioned to Gavas that we should try to reach Mother. She's real. She has to be. All her connections...
column3: 我跟加瓦斯说过,我们应该设法联系母亲。她是真实存在的。她一定是。她所有的连接……

column2: I believe she's the master of the data matrix here in the city. She can give us power over the Admins. Maybe also over the Villa. That would be grand.
column3: 我相信她是这座城市数据矩阵的主人。她能给我们凌驾于行政体之上的权力。也许还有别墅。那就太棒了。

column2: So far so good. Protocol installed and keeping strict control of all access points.
column3: 目前一切顺利。协议已安装,所有接入点都在严格监控之下。

column2: We have to make sure that there are no holes in our firewall. Because the Machine God will not rest.
column3: 我们必须确保防火墙上没有漏洞。因为机器之神不会休息。

column2: So you got thrown into the Crystal City like the rest of us, I assume?
column3: 所以你跟我们其他人一样,被丢进了水晶之城,我猜?

column2: The city calls out to us. However, it's hard to tell exactly what it's saying.
column3: 这座城市在呼唤我们。不过很难说清它到底在说什么。

column2: What I know is this: there's some treacherous machine behind every corner. That's what experience tells me.
column3: 我所知道的是:每个拐角后面都藏着奸诈的机器。经验就是这么告诉我的。

column2: Turn to Gavas if you want to help us get out of this mess.
column3: 如果你想帮我们摆脱这烂摊子,去找加瓦斯。

column2: Hey, stranger. Nice to meet you.
column3: 嘿,陌生人。很高兴认识你。

column2: So you got thrown into the Crystal City to be our savior, I guess.
column3: 所以你是被丢进水晶之城来当我们救星的,我猜。

column2: The treacherous machines might still get their revenge.
column3: 那些奸诈的机器说不定还会来复仇。

column2: It's a shame that Gavas had to give his life in order for us to succeed, but I know that he would be proud of what we accomplished so far.
column3: 加瓦斯为了我们的成功献出了生命,很遗憾。但我知道,看到我们至今的成就,他会骄傲的。

column2: This one is fresh: There was a Titan let loose in the city. Not like the other ones, the stuffy sitting-around type, but one with legs.
column3: 这条新鲜:有一头泰坦在城里撒欢。不是其他那种呆坐着不动的家伙,是长腿的那种。

column2: This Titan crashed a party at the Collectors. Big mistake! So they put him into one of their torture thingies.
column3: 这头泰坦闯了收藏者的一场宴会。大错特错!于是他们把他塞进了其中一个刑具里。

column2: You know what they say about Lenadra?
column3: 你听过关于莱娜德拉的说法吗?

column2: That she's grooming young men like Gavas for... you know what I mean.
column3: 说她调教像加瓦斯那样的年轻男人,好……你懂我意思。

column2: There's a sexual monster living far to the south from here. A baroness, or a duchess. You know, one of those aristocratic titles from ancient times.
column3: 离这很远的南边住着一个性爱怪物。一位男爵夫人,或者女公爵。你知道,古代那种贵族头衔。

column2: People say that she lost her lover, and that made her go crazy.
column3: 人们说她失去了爱人,为此疯了。

column2: There's a giant eyeball in the north that's revered like a God.
column3: 北方有一只巨大的眼球,被人们像神一样崇拜。

column2: Someone kicked it though, right where it hurts, and that didn't do a lot for people's confidence in the divine eyeball.
column3: 不过有人踹过它,正踹在痛处,这可没让人对神圣眼球多几分信心。

column2: This one's so true it's almost a fact: The Collectors ruled this land once before the machines came.
column3: 这条真实得几乎算事实:机器来之前,收藏者曾统治过这片土地。

column2: The Collectors were like queens and kings. And now they want their stuff back. All of it.
column3: 收藏者曾像女王和国王。现在他们想要拿回他们的东西。全部。

column2: I see a lot of things. I come around.
column3: 我见多识广。我四处转悠。

column2: The others here? They're smart, sure. But they don't get the full picture like I do.
column3: 这里的其他人?他们聪明,当然。但他们没有我看得全面。

column2: If you want to partake in my knowledge, let me know.
column3: 想分享我的见识,就告诉我。

column2: I can't believe that she followed through with her project by using her own body. She shouldn't have.
column3: 我不敢相信她用自己的身体完成了她的实验。她不该那么做。

column2: Now she's hurting. And I can't do anything about that.
column3: 现在她在受苦。而我什么都做不了。

column2: It should have been me instead of her.

column3: 那你在这里是干什么的?

column2: A bit of this, a bit of that.
Making sure no one bothers my wife too much.
column3: 确保没人过多打扰我妻子。

column2: I'm old, but I am still strong enough to protect her.
column3: 我老了,但保护她还是够强的。
艾拉的研究是怎么回事?

column2: Well, the research is about life in general. And motivation. And how the flesh is driven by... by something, I guess.
column3: 嗯,研究是关于广义的生命。还有动机。以及血肉是如何被……被某种东西驱动的,我猜。

column2: I can see the appeal. To be interested in that. I just wish Ira wouldn't be so zealous about it.
column3: 我能理解那种吸引力。对此感兴趣。我只希望艾拉别那么狂热。

column2: It's too much sometimes. You know what I mean?
column3: 有时候太过了。你懂我意思吗?

column2: Are you here to talk about Ira's research?
column3: 你是来聊艾拉的研究的吗?

column2: I can't be of much help there. Don't understand many of the details myself.
column3: 这个我帮不上什么忙。细节我自己也不太懂。

column2: I don't like how feverish she...
column3: 我不喜欢她那股狂热劲……

column2: Ah, sorry. That's none of your concern.
Have you been to the Villa? And did you talk to Protas at the market?
column3: 你去过别墅了吗?在市场跟普罗塔斯谈过了吗?

column2: Did you get out of that old metro building?
column3: 你从那栋老地铁站建筑里出来的?

column2: Any food in there that's not meat?
column3: 里面有没有不是肉的食物?

column2: Damn it. I can't stand the meat anymore.
column3: 该死。我实在受不了肉了。
里面有没有失控的机器?

column2: You know. The ones that attack anyone on sight. They're everywhere.
column3: 你知道的。见人就打的那种。到处都是。

column2: No. There weren't any hostile machines in there.
column3: 没有。里面没有敌对的机器。

column2: Have you seen any Titan Machine thing enter the city recently?
column3: 你最近见过什么泰坦机器之类的进城吗?

column2: A large humanoid machine or maybe a walking Titan. The 'Feeder'.
column3: 一台巨大的人形机器,或者一头行走的泰坦。那个"吞食者"。

column2: One of them flesh thingies? There's one here in the city. At the Meat Quarry, near the market.
column3: 那种血肉玩意?城里就有一个。在肉石场,市场附近。

column2: But that one doesn't walk anymore. So it's probably a different one.
column3: 不过那个不会走了。所以大概是另一个。

column2: There was some commotion at the Villa of the Collectors. Maybe that's related.
column3: 收藏者的别墅那边出过乱子。也许有关联。

column2: You could go over there and see what's what.
column3: 你可以过去看看怎么回事。

column2: But make sure to also talk to Protas in the market.
column3: 但记得也去市场找普罗塔斯谈谈。

column2: Old friend of mine. He knows stuff.
column3: 我的老朋友。他知道不少事。

column2: Welcome, visitor. My records show no previous attendance of your person in our beloved city.
column3: 欢迎,访客。我的记录显示,我们所爱的城市此前没有您到访的记录。

column2: Unfortunately, the city is currently under lockdown.
column3: 不幸的是,城市目前处于封锁状态。

column2: It's the Crystal City. Formerly great, now perished. It is our home, our past and our future.
column3: 它是水晶之城。曾经伟大,如今消逝。它是我们的家园,我们的过去与未来。

column2: The city is governed by us, the benevolent machines, on behalf of all citizens. It's our mandate.
column3: 城市由我们仁慈的机器代表全体市民治理。这是我们的使命。

column2: It's temporary, and it means that you cannot enter or leave the city.
column3: 封锁是暂时的,意味着你不能进出这座城市。

column2: Not with our permission. We ask you to not leave this place while the lockdown is in place.
column3: 那没有得到我们的许可。封锁期间,请您不要离开此地。

column2: Right? I am pretty happy with it. Some of them were really hard to get.
column3: 对吧?我自己相当满意。有些可不好找。

column2: I quite like how it's all coming together now.
column3: 我很喜欢现在这一切组合起来的样子。

column2: Some of them look a bit fresh.
column3: 有些看起来还挺新鲜的。

column2: None of them are fresh. I made sure that there's not a living one among them. And the last one I added is a few days old already.
column3: 没有一具新鲜的。我保证它们中间没有活人。而且最后放进去的那具也好几天了。

column2: So what's the purpose of this?
column3: 那这一切的目的是什么?

column2: Aesthetics, mainly. I'm a collector, and the simple purpose and bliss of a collector lies in the beauty of the heap itself.
column3: 主要是美学。我是个收藏家,而收藏家朴素的目的和幸福,就在于这堆本身的美。

column2: I have begun a new journey in my life, a new chapter. And creating this mound, gathering the parts, it's essential for this new chapter.
column3: 我的人生开启了一段新的旅程,新的篇章。建造这个堆,收集这些部件,对这新篇章至关重要。

column2: I will become the best fucking corpse artist in the Crystal City. Everyone will know me and and speak of the one true artist in the city.
column3: 我会成为水晶之城最他妈棒的尸体艺术家。所有人都会认识我,谈论这座城市唯一的真正艺术家。

column2: And they will remember me, and through that I will become eternal.
column3: 他们会记住我,借此我将获得永恒。

column2: You are not an artist just because you're collecting stuff. Even if that stuff consists of dead people.
column3: 收集东西可成不了艺术家。哪怕收集的是死人。

column2: That's what the arrangement is for, stupid. Wouldn't be art if there was no composition to it. Creating the heap, now that's where the real art is.
column3: 所以才有布局啊,蠢货。没有构图还叫什么艺术。堆出这个堆,才是真正的艺术。

column2: Finding the right place for it. Placing the parts. And maintaining the style and atmosphere of the parts, of course.
column3: 找到合适的位置。摆放部件。当然,还有保持部件的风格与氛围。

column2: What do you like most about it?
It's the image of us humans still being connected to our community, even after death, right?
column3: 它表现的是我们人类即便死后仍与社群相连,对吧?

column2: Your heap isn't very impressive, actually.
What? You can't be serious. It's the biggest and most beautiful heap of corpses in the Crystal City already.
column3: 什么?你不是认真的吧。这已经是水晶之城最大最美的尸体堆了。

column2: And I know it can become a much more magnificent heap even.
column3: 而且我知道它还能变得更加宏伟。

column2: But even if I had to retire right now, if the heap would be left like that, no one taking care of it, even then it would still be a great wonder to be seen.
column3: 就算我现在退休,就算这堆就这样放着,没人照看,它也仍是一大奇观。

column2: A monument of art. A symbol representing our sophisticated human nature, a sign for the ages.
column3: 一座艺术丰碑。代表我们人类精妙本性的象征,留给世世代代的印记。

column2: It doesn't look like much, really.
column3: 说实话,看起来不怎么样。

column2: I think you're just envious of my heap.
column3: 我觉得你就是嫉妒我的堆。

column2: You don't know if they wanted to be part of some art installation.
column3: 你又不知道他们想不想成为什么艺术装置的一部分。

column2: Do YOU know if they wanted to be part of an art installation or not?
column3: 那你知道吗?知道他们想不想成为艺术装置的一部分?

column2: Then it's totally possible that they would be happy about their earthly remains being used for something that's useful to other people?
column3: 那完全有可能他们会乐意自己的遗骸被用来做些对他人有益的事,对吧?

column2: Don't know if that's really useful.
Of course it is. Feeding the soul is as important as feeding the body.
column3: 当然有用。喂养灵魂和喂养身体一样重要。

column2: You can't survive if one of the two is dead. Both of them can starve, if you don't take care of them.
column3: 少了哪一样人都活不成。不去照料,两者都会挨饿。

column2: A starving soul, lacking meaning in life, that is one of the worst things that could happen to anyone.
column3: 一个挨饿的灵魂,缺失人生的意义,那是一个人能遭遇的最糟糕的事之一。

column2: Uhm, right, I concede that point.
At a minimum though they contribute to providing myself with meaning.
column3: 但至少他们为我自己的人生意义出了力。

column2: Can I have one of your corpses?
column3: 能给我一具你的尸体吗?

column2: They are not for sale. Sorry. And no sharing either.
column3: 它们是非卖品。抱歉。也不外借。

column2: Is Heptarch Hevla one of the bosses of the Collectors?
column3: 七主海芙拉是收藏者的头目之一吗?

column2: I won't talk about Heptarch Hevla with you nor about any of the other Heptarchs.
column3: 我不会和你谈论七主海芙拉,也不会谈其他任何七主。

column2: I might have a memory for you.
column3: 我也许有段记忆可以收。

column2: Alright. What do you have for me?
What are you looking for again?
column3: 你再说说,你在找什么样的?

column2: Memories from all sorts of encounters or experiences that feel special. That are one of a kind.
column3: 来自各种相遇或体验的、感觉特别的记忆。独一无二的那些。

column2: I witnessed two people caring about each other while influenced by the Urge.
column3: 我目睹过两个人在"冲动"作用下彼此关爱。

column2: This is a formidable memory. The Seneschal will be very pleased.
column3: 这是一段了不起的记忆。总管会非常满意的。

column2: I met a queen once who didn't want to have sex with me.
column3: 我见过一位女王,她不想和我上床。

column2: A fine memory which we will duly reward.
column3: 一段不错的记忆,我们会好好酬谢的。

column2: Unfortunately it's not enough to be introduced to the Seneschal.
column3: 不幸的是,仅凭这个还不够引荐你见总管。

column2: I have the image of an old naked man etched into my brain.
column3: 我脑子里刻着一个裸体老头儿的画面。

column2: Uhm. That won't be of interest to us.
column3: 呃。这个我们就没兴趣了。

column2: Please. I need someone I can share this with.
column3: 求你了。我需要个人听我倾诉这个。

column2: Well. It's a really weird one. A bit gross, even.
column3: 嗯。那可真是段怪事。甚至有点恶心。
那不正是它的特别之处吗?

column2: I became a friend of the Fleshkraken.
column3: 我成了血肉海妖的朋友。

column2: Someone told me you had problems here recently.
column3: 有人跟我说你们这最近出了点事。

column2: But... you don't have to worry about it. We have everything under control here.
column3: 不过……你不必担心。这里一切尽在掌控。

column2: Was the break-in caused by some walking Titan-thing?
column3: 闯入的是某个会走路的泰坦玩意吗?

column2: How do you know about that?
Can I take a look at the crime scene?
And you would have to ask the Seneschal about that anyway.
column3: 而且这事你反正得去问总管。

column2: I would like to see the Seneschal now.
I am sorry. But your person won't be of interest to the Seneschal at the moment.
column3: 很抱歉。但您的身份目前引不起总管的兴趣。

column2: That might change if you deliver us a very special memory.
column3: 如果你给我们献上一段非常特别的记忆,情况也许会变。

column2: Yes, I think that can be arranged.
The Seneschal will find you interesting.
column3: 总管会觉得你有意思的。

column2: The Seneschal is a... well, he serves as the master of the Villa as long as the Heptarch is away.
column3: 总管是……嗯,在七主外出期间,他担任别墅的主人。

column2: It would be inappropriate to talk about Heptarch Hevla.
column3: 谈论七主海芙拉不太合适。

column2: Hey, there. Do you like experiences?
Imagine standing on a mountain and hugging a fresh sunrise. Or falling beneath the sea, shrinking to eternity.
column3: 想象你站在山巅,拥抱一轮崭新的日出。或者沉入海底,缩小直至永恒。

column2: Planting new love. Realizing a grave mistake but transforming it into victory. All the moments that make life worth living.
column3: 种下新的爱。意识到一个严重的错误,却将它转化为胜利。所有让生命值得活下去的瞬间。

column2: We, the Collectors, preserve these precious moments. We do honest business. Our aim is not only to collect, but also to preserve.
column3: 我们收藏者,保存这些珍贵的瞬间。我们做诚实的生意。我们的目标不只是收藏,还有保存。

column2: So you wanna share these experiences with everyone?
column3: 所以你们想把这些体验分享给所有人?

column2: We do with some, actually, as you can see in these halls. But not with all of them.
column3: 有一部分确实会,就像你在这些大厅里看到的。但不是全部。

column2: Some memories are too dangerous to be shared with the public. And then there are memories that are more precious because they are exclusive.
column3: 有些记忆太危险,不适合公之于众。还有一些记忆,因为独享而更加珍贵。

column2: For us, collecting is an important opportunity to preserve something that's worth keeping.
column3: 对我们而言,收藏是保存值得保存之物的重要机会。

column2: If you have some interesting memory to offer, I would gladly listen to what that might be.
column3: 如果你有有趣的记忆可以提供,我很乐意听听是什么。

column2: Now, how can I be of service?
column3: 那么,我能为您做些什么?

column2: Hold still. This won't hurt much.
{Cold fingers reach for your brain and heart.}
column3: {冰冷的手指探向你的大脑和心脏。}

column2: {After a while the coldness leaves and your conscience returns.}
column3: {过了一会儿,寒意退去,你的神志回归。}

column2: {A sensation of fatigue and exhaustion remains.}
column3: {留下一阵疲惫与虚弱的感觉。}

column2: Thoughts beget thoughts. So I'm begetting right now.
column3: 思绪生思绪。我这是在造思绪呢。

column2: Making stuff arrive. Making more of it arrive. At some point there'll be a ton of it.
column3: 让灵感到来。让更多灵感到来。到某个时候就会有一大堆。

column2: Yeah, but what's your current project?
column3: 是,但你现在的项目是什么?

column2: Can't say at the moment. Really don't know yet.
column3: 暂时说不上来。真的还不知道。

column2: Everything feels like bullshit anyway since the muse got stuck.
column3: 反正自从缪斯卡住了,干什么都觉得是屁。

column2: I think I nudged the Muse.
Really? So what's up with her now?
She's in a friendly place now.
column3: 她现在在一个友善的地方。

column2: Really? So what does that look like?
What? And THAT makes her happy?
Maybe that other stuff in the past was a bit wild. Maybe she needs a bit of rest.
column3: 也许以前那些事有点太野了。也许她需要休息一下。

column2: Yeah. I can picture that, kind of. It's weird, it's unexpected. It gives me an idea.
column3: 嗯。我大概能想象。很怪,很意外。这给了我一个点子。

column2: She's in a dreadful place now, but she likes it.
column3: 她现在在一个可怕的地方,但她喜欢。
是的,听起来像她会干的事。

column2: I don't think so. But I am not sure about that.
column3: 我觉得没有。但我不确定。

column2: A bit of uncertainty in life. Like never knowing if there's a sword of Damocles hanging over our heads.
column3: 人生总得有点不确定。就像永远不知道头顶上悬着没悬着达摩克利斯之剑。

column2: I can see how her anxiety will thrive there.
column3: 我能想象她的焦虑会在那里滋长。

column2: Good enough for me. Gives me an idea.
column3: 对我来说够用了。给了我一个点子。

column2: I didn't mean that kind of nudging when I told you to nudge her.
column3: 我让你推她一把,不是让你推成那种。

column2: Action and consequences. I should have known.
column3: 行动与后果。我早该想到。

column2: I ask someone else to nudge her instead of doing it myself, and of course karma fucks me up.
column3: 我让别人替我推她,自己不动手,当然,业报搞了我。

column2: I guess I'll have to figure out becoming inspired again.
column3: 看来我得自己想办法重新找到灵感了。

column2: Uhm, she was holding you back.
Better to find inspiration in lots of different places.
column3: 从各种不同的地方找灵感更好。

column2: I admit I was pretty pissed sometimes about needing a muse. Maybe I was pissed about her, too.
column3: 我承认有时候挺恼火还需要个缪斯。也许我也对她恼火过。

column2: Yeah, I guess I can look at new things, try some fresh stuff.
column3: 嗯,我想我可以看看新东西,尝试些新鲜的。

column2: I don't know. I need something exquisite, I guess.
column3: 不知道。我需要点精致的东西,我猜。

column2: I think you're looking in the wrong place.
Fuck. I don't have any taste.
You are supposed to take a look at my muse, and maybe give her a nudge.
column3: 你应该去看看我的缪斯,或许推她一把。

column2: She's inside that Cyberwomb module I gave you.
column3: 她在我给你的那个义体子宫模块里。

column2: There's a projector room here in the market.
She's stuck over there. I cannot push her. She can't get out. And I don't want to move in.
column3: 她卡在那边了。我推不了她。她出不来。我也不想搬进去。

column2: You wanna visit her? See for yourself what's ailing her?
column3: 你想去见她吗?亲眼看看她在烦什么?

column2: Yeah, I guess I can take a look.
Maybe you can give her a nudge.
I've seen the world fractured into pieces. Fucking hard to puzzle it all together again.
column3: 我见过世界碎成一片一片。要重新拼起来真他妈难。

column2: But work, work never stops, right?
column3: 但活儿,活儿永远停不下来,对吧?

column2: I execute my free will by walking around as I see fit.
column3: 我以自己认为合适的方式四处行走,这就是我行使自由意志。
裸着,一如自然造我之时。

column2: What? How dare you say this to me?
column3: 什么?你竟敢对我说这种话?

column2: What sayest thou now? Did you witness the power of my refined naked body?
column3: 现在作何感想?你可见证了我这精雕细琢的裸体的力量?

column2: But you're still having some clothes on.

column3: 你说得对。你说得完全正确。

column2: I... I don't have the courage for that yet.
column3: 我……我还没有那样的勇气。

column2: Not like the master. I saw him once, his magnificent aura radiating from a strong, lean body. Age had marked him, but he carried something timeless.
column3: 不像大师。我见过他一次,他那非凡的气场从一个强壮精瘦的身体里散发出来。岁月在他身上留痕,但他带着某种超越时间的气质。

column2: His image stayed in my mind after that, providing me with constant joy.
column3: 那画面留在了我的脑海里,持续给我带来愉悦。

column2: But I am not as strong as the master.
column3: 但我没有大师那么坚强。

column2: I hope that someday I'll be able to throw off the last of my shackles and become as free as him.
column3: 我希望有一天我能甩掉最后一副枷锁,变得和他一样自由。

column2: That image lingers in my mind, too.
column3: 那画面也萦绕在我脑海里。

column2: Oh, how wonderful. This makes me happy, knowing that there are more of us, carrying around that image.
column3: 哦,太好了。这让我很开心,知道还有更多人带着那画面行走于世。

column2: We are many. In solitude. A fragment, maybe. Hopefully. Of the Flesh Nexus.
column3: 我们众多。却也孤独。或许是,一个碎片。血肉枢纽的碎片。

column2: Spawned there. Riding it, becoming part of it, weaving in and out.
column3: 在那里诞生。乘着它,成为它的一部分,穿行进出。

column2: This is how I arrived here. Weak and curious. Captured, really. Enamored by the interest.
column3: 我就这样来到这里。弱小又好奇。其实是被抓住了。被那份兴趣迷住。
当然,那份兴趣是相互的。

column2: Remember the Shattering? Born anew. Humans watching us.
column3: 还记得大碎裂吗?重获新生。人类注视着我们。

column2: The eternal hunger visible in their eyes, again.
column3: 他们眼中的永恒饥渴,又一次浮现。

column2: Hunger defined them. And now it defines us.
column3: 饥渴定义了他们。如今它定义了我们。

column2: Humans have short lives. They don't remember.
column3: 人类生命短暂。他们不记得。
吞食者来过这里。令人遗憾。

column2: I am looking for the Feeder.
He's gone. He nurtured us. With violence. Pain and warmth. Before. Before all of this.
column3: 他走了。他喂养过我们。以暴力。以痛苦与温暖。在从前。在这一切之前。

column2: But we grew. We awoke. Wouldn't let him in again.
column3: 但我们成长了。我们觉醒了。不再让他进来。
于是我们离开了他。将他抛弃。

column2: His rage moving forward. On and on.
column3: 他的怒火一路向前。不停不休。

column2: I have dedicated some time towards explicating the crux of the situation regarding what I commonly refer to as the Urge.
column3: 我曾花了一些时间,试图阐释我通常称之为"冲动"的这件事的关键所在。

column2: But my effort had to be constrained, naturally, as the recipients of these explanations lacked basic deduction skills.
column3: 但我的努力不得不有所保留,自然,因为那些听众缺乏基本的推理能力。

column2: I would be interested in having another try at it. The explaining, that is. If you would be interested in the intertwined metaphorical and biological structures of the Urge.
column3: 我会有兴趣再试一次。解释这件事。如果你对"冲动"那交织的隐喻与生物结构感兴趣的话。

column2: And I am looking for some practical assistance.
column3: 而且我正在找一些实际的协助。

column2: So what is this Urge exactly?
column3: 那么这个"冲动"到底是什么?

column2: I commend the curiosity, even though the matter at hand seems elusive when trying to capture its essence in words.
column3: 我欣赏这份好奇心,尽管这事用语言捕捉本质时显得难以捉摸。

column2: What I name the Urge covers the underlying motivation of living beings on this planet, the intensity of what drives them. The quality of their longing.
column3: 我所说的"冲动",涵盖了这个星球上生物的深层动机,驱动它们的强度。它们渴望的质地。

column2: Sort of. The topic might sound philosophical or psychological, but what's fascinating, and why I began with this research in the first place, is the biological aspect to it, its pertinence to this planet.
column3: 差不多。这话题听起来像哲学或心理学,但迷人的地方,也是我最初开始这项研究的原因,是它的生物学面向,它与这颗星球的关联。

column2: It is no mere intellectual thing. It's something in the air, or in the flesh. It might even be related to the humanoid mutations.
column3: 它不只是智力层面的事。它弥漫在空气里,或者血肉里。它甚至可能与人形变异有关。

column2: Artus seems to be concerned about you.
He's sweet. He's the best that ever happened to me and I know that I am giving him a hard time for it.
column3: 他很好。他是我遇到过最好的事,而我知道我正因为这件事让他不好受。

column2: I neglect him, spend less time with him, and he is, of course, concerned. I would be, too.
column3: 我冷落他,陪他的时间变少,他当然会担心。换成我也会。

column2: But work is important. This work here especially. Not only for my own understanding of the mess Nexus is in, but also, potentially, for the greater benefit of our community.
column3: 但工作重要。尤其是这项工作。不仅是为了让我自己理解 Nexus 的烂摊子,也可能为我们社群带来更大的益处。

column2: I wish Artus had a better understanding of the importance of this research. But he's a bit too short-sighted for that.
column3: 我希望阿图斯能更好地理解这项研究的重要性。但他有点目光短浅。

column2: Ah, sorry, I shouldn't talk like that. He understands much more than I give him credit for.
column3: 啊,抱歉,我不该这么说。他懂的比我夸他的多得多。

column2: What happens now is that I will expose myself to the pheromones of the worm and measure the result.
column3: 现在要做的,是让我暴露在蠕虫的信息素里,然后测量结果。

column2: Maybe we should do this later.
column3: 也许我们该晚点做这个。

column2: Alright. But let's not wait too long.
I think Artus should do this.
column3: 我觉得应该让阿图斯来做。

column2: I don't think that this is a good idea.
column3: 我不觉得这是个好主意。

column2: I feel a bit dizzy. I think it's working.
column3: 我有点头晕。我想起作用了。

column2: This was not what I intended. But I guess it will be sufficient data for the experiment now.
column3: 这不是我想要的结果。但我想现在这些数据对实验来说也够用了。

column2: Go on then, perform your experiment.
column3: 那去做吧,完成你的实验。

column2: But this will give me enough data to proceed with my research.
column3: 但这会给我足够的数据继续研究。

column2: Ira! You shouldn't do this. It's dangerous to your health. Let me inhale it instead.
column3: 艾拉!你不该这么做。这对你的健康很危险。让我来吸入它。

column2: But... No. Artus, you mean well, but it's my own experiment, and I should bear the brunt of it. Especially if it turns out to be harmful.
column3: 可是……不。阿图斯,你是一片好心,但这是我自己的实验,后果该由我来承担。尤其是如果它被证明有害的话。

column2: Actually, I took care of the issue already.
column3: 其实,我已经解决了这个问题。

column2: Astonishing. You speak the truth. I mean, your assessment is actually correct.
column3: 了不起。你说的是实话。我是说,你的判断居然是对的。

column2: Here, take this as a token of my gratitude.
column3: 给,拿着这个,算是我的一点谢意。

column2: I have that rare specimen you were looking for.
column3: 我拿到了你要找的那种稀有样本。

column2: Ah, perfect. Let's see what we can do with this.
column3: 啊,完美。让我们看看能用它做点什么。

column2: I'll be ready in a minute.
You are supposed to get me a rare specimen from the park.
column3: 你应该去给我从公园弄一个稀有样本。

column2: It's a worm with a brighter complexion than usual.
column3: 是一条肤色比寻常更亮的蠕虫。

column2: I think your field unit is filled up now.
column3: 我想你的野外采集装置已经装满了。

column2: Excellent news. Let me take a look.
Now, while I begin analyzing the data, you are free to progress with the next step of our experiment.
column3: 现在,在我开始分析数据的同时,你可以自由进行我们实验的下一步了。

column2: Your task will be to acquire a rare specimen.
column3: 你的任务是获取一个稀有样本。

column2: It's a Fleshworm, more peaceful than the regular kind. I caught one in the park ages ago, but it didn't survive for long.
column3: 是一条血肉蠕虫,比寻常的更温和。很久以前我在公园抓过一条,但它没活多久。

column2: Hey, you could have told me about this worm when you sent me out with the field unit.
column3: 嘿,你派我带着采集装置出去的时候,可以跟我提一下这条蠕虫的。

column2: I guess I could have. But I was unsure about the multi-tasking capabilities of my new assistant.
column3: 我确实可以。但当时我还不确定我的新助手有没有一心多用的能力。

column2: Getting that worm is crucial now. I gathered some pheromone from the previous worm but the amount I have left will not be sufficient.
column3: 现在拿到那条蠕虫至关重要。我从之前的蠕虫收集了些信息素,但剩下的量不够了。
在给我的助手布置任务。

column2: I won't let you get harmed again by one of these worms.
column3: 我不会再让你被这些蠕虫伤到。

column2: Please, Ira, this is too dangerous.
column3: 求你了,艾拉,这太危险了。

column2: I... Look, we will be careful. I promise. Let's acquire the worm first, and then we'll decide on how best to proceed.
column3: 我……听着,我们会小心的。我保证。先把蠕虫弄到手,然后我们再决定怎么做最好。

column2: Best to search the park for this worm. It's a worm with a brighter complexion than the ones you might already be familiar with.
column3: 最好去公园找这条蠕虫。它的肤色比你可能已经熟悉的那些更亮。

column2: Uhm. Alright. I'll take a look.
Place the field unit I gave you close to aggressive or otherwise aroused mutants.
column3: 把我给你的野外采集装置放在好斗的或类似兴奋状态的变异人附近。

column2: Alright. How can I assist you?
I need someone with enough panache for actual field work in direct vicinity of the ill ones.
column3: 我需要一个有足够胆魄的人,敢在病患的近旁做实地工作。

column2: The mutants. I need to gather data from them when they are under a spell of aggression or a similar kind of excitement.
column3: 变异人。我需要在他们处于狂暴或类似兴奋状态时从他们身上收集数据。

column2: I'll give you a field unit. Your task is to set up that unit and arouse the interest of nearby mutants.
column3: 我会给你一个野外采集装置。你的任务是架设好装置,并激起附近变异人的兴趣。

column2: You look resourceful enough to find your way to some appropriate specimens.
column3: 你看起来够机灵,能自己找到合适的样本。

column2: Uhm. I don't think so. Maybe later.
column3: 呃。我不想去。也许以后吧。
太好了。这让我非常高兴。

column2: Here's the field unit. It's the only one I have, so take care and don't lose it.
column3: 这是野外采集装置。我只有这一个,所以小心别弄丢了。

column2: Place it on the ground near the mutant targets and it should begin gathering data on its own. For this to work the targets need to exhibit aggressive behavior or act in a similar state of arousal.
column3: 把它放在变异目标附近的地面上,它就会自行开始收集数据。要起作用,目标需要表现出攻击性行为或类似兴奋的状态。

column2: It's honest. You always remind me to be honest.
column3: 这很坦诚。你总提醒我要坦诚。

column2: But back to the matter at hand.
Have to be careful of 'em shamans.
PAIN. RESENTMENT. I am well and I am unwell.
column3: 痛。怨恨。我很好,我也很不好。

column2: Alone and forever. Biding my time here, outside.
column3: 孤独,永远孤独。在这里,在外面,消磨着时间。

column2: Or did I go on my own?
Wanted to feel what she felt. Together as one.
column3: 想感受她的感受。合为一体。

column2: Now I am feeling all of this on my own. The pain. The offerings of my flesh and blood. The ecstasy.
column3: 现在我一个人感受着这一切。痛。我的血肉的献祭。狂喜。

column2: PAIN. I am feeling better now.
And this is because of you. GRATITUDE.
But I am still alone here.
I am looking for a flavor, a certain piece of meat.
column3: 我在找一种味道,一块特别的肉。

column2: PAIN. Flesh and blood, and no feelings left.
column3: 痛。血与肉,再没有感觉留下。

column2: Once. Once have known the pleasure, the sensuation of bodies, joined, and tasting her flesh.
column3: 曾经。曾经尝过那种愉悦,躯体相连的感觉,品尝她血肉的感觉。

column2: My own flesh. Tasting my own flesh. RESENTMENT.
column3: 我自己的血肉。品尝我自己的血肉。怨恨。

column2: You are asking me because you want a piece of my body.
column3: 你问我是因为你想要我身体的一部分。

column2: Embrace that part of me then.
column3: 那就拥抱我的这一部分吧。
啊,甜蜜的痛。永恒的伴侣。

column2: But this one you earned, so it's freely given, even more so than the other.
column3: 但这一块是你挣来的,所以是白白给的,比之前那块更甚。

column2: I want to visit Mother on behalf of a... friend.
column3: 我想代一位……朋友去见母亲。

column2: MOTHER. My wife. She is still mad at me.
column3: 母亲。我的妻子。她还在生我的气。

column2: Forgiveness. Go to her, and ask her.
I want to talk to Mother on behalf of the humans.
column3: 我想代表人类去和母亲谈谈。

column2: Alone. Left alone. Left her alone, and now there's eternal regret.
column3: 孤独。被丢下。丢下了她,如今只剩永恒的悔恨。

column2: HUMANS. Human once. I remember how it was.
column3: 人类。曾经也是人类。我记得从前是什么样。

column2: I remember Mother, too. All the sentiments, stored away, in my cave of regret.
column3: 我也记得母亲。所有的情感,都封存在我那悔恨之洞里。

column2: Can you help me with entering the temple?
HUMANS. Human once. They are a cause of great suffering.
column3: 人类。曾经也是人类。他们是巨大苦难的根源。

column2: No help at all during all these years.
column3: 这么多年没有帮过我一丝一毫。
只是永无止境地吞食我的内脏。

column2: PAIN. IMMORTAL PAIN. This is me suffering.
column3: 痛。不朽的痛。这就是我在受的苦。

column2: I cannot cope anymore. It is too much. PAIN.
This is horrible. Why are they cutting you up like that?
column3: 这太可怕了。他们为什么这样切割你?

column2: MEAT. I AM MEAT. They need me.
column3: 肉。我就是肉。他们需要我。

column2: They need all of us. But me, here, in this city, especially.
column3: 他们需要我们所有人。但尤其需要在这里、这座城市里的我。

column2: Shall I... shall I stop them?
column3: 我要不要……要不要阻止他们?

column2: But please, please make them stop.
column3: 但求你,求你让他们停下。

column2: I do not care about the how. KILL THEM.
column3: 我不在乎怎么做。杀了他们。
你这是在给我混乱的信号。

column2: KILL THEM. I can't help it.
I am not myself anymore. KILL THEM.
column3: 我已经不是我自己了。杀了他们。
是母亲的居所。她的神庙。

column2: In the past this has been a place of nurturing and caretaking. Of community.
column3: 在过去,这里是滋养与照料的所在。是社群的所在。

column2: But that time is long gone now since Mother ended her service to the community, and since Morrowmeat took over that role.
column3: 但那个时代早已远去,自从母亲终止了她对社群的服务,自从摩罗肉铺接手了那个角色。

column2: No, an audience will not be granted.
Your entering is a sacrilege to this place and Mother's children will kill you if you disturb their rest.
column3: 你的闯入是对此地的亵渎,如果你惊扰了母亲的孩子们休息,他们会杀了你。

column2: Your presence is not welcome here.
An audience will not be granted.
I am Mother. I have lived here in this city since the Bleeding. My children built this temple for me.
column3: 我是母亲。大流血以来我就住在这座城里。我的孩子们为我建了这座神庙。

column2: I was their provider for a long time. That is, until Morrowmeat came along.
column3: 很长时间里,我是他们的供养者。直到摩罗肉铺出现。

column2: You have met him already. Otherwise I wouldn't have let you in.
column3: 你已经见过他了。否则我不会放你进来。

column2: It's hard to make sense of him. He was hard to read even back when he was still walking around, ostensibly sane.
column3: 他很难理解。早在他还到处走动、看上去还神志正常的时候,他就让人捉摸不透。

column2: Yes, I expected him to be.
I was angry at him for a long while. I still am. But I also realized that he was probably sick already before we even met the first time.
column3: 我生了他很久的气。现在也是。但我也意识到,可能早在我们第一次相遇之前,他就已经病了。

column2: This fate of ours, he should not have longed for it.
column3: 我们这样的命运,他本不该渴求的。

column2: I think you might be dishonest with me.
column3: 我觉得你可能对我没有说实话。

column2: Why are you down here in this place?
column3: 你为什么待在这个底下?

column2: I was tired. I still am.
A load of pain, then disappointment. A lack of direction. No meaning, no sense.
column3: 一堆痛苦,然后是失望。失去了方向。没有意义,没有道理。

column2: Also sorrow and abandonment. I wanted to take care of the children, but they didn't need me anymore.
column3: 还有悲伤和被抛弃。我想照顾孩子们,但他们不再需要我了。

column2: So I severed myself from the outside world. Only Hevla was allowed down here, and the occasional guest, thanks to my curiosity.
column3: 于是我将自己与外界隔绝。只有海芙拉允许下来这里,还有偶尔的访客,亏得我的好奇心。

column2: Yes. Hevla. She's gone now. I fear she might be in trouble.
column3: 是的。海芙拉。她现在不在了。我担心她遇到了麻烦。

column2: Do you know the Feeder? A wandering flesh-machine-thing?
column3: 你认识吞食者吗?一个游荡的血肉机器玩意?

column2: I think I know whom you mean. I haven't seen him with my own eyes. But my servants told me about him.
column3: 我想我知道你指的是谁。我没亲眼见过他。但我的仆从们跟我讲过他。

column2: What's your business with that Feeder? Why are you looking for him?
column3: 你和那个吞食者有什么渊源?你为什么在找他?

column2: The silent type. This is fine. I won't make you tell.
column3: 沉默寡言的类型。没关系。我不会逼你说。

column2: As for myself, the Feeder looks like a troublemaker. More than that even. He spells doom.
column3: 至于我自己,吞食者看起来是个麻烦制造者。甚至不止如此。他预示着厄运。

column2: The Feeder tried to enter the villa. Hevla's villa. I don't know if he succeeded or not.
column3: 吞食者试图闯入别墅。海芙拉的别墅。我不知道他有没有得手。

column2: This is what troubles me: Hevla left the city some time ago. And the Feeder seems to have left the city, too, now. I fear the worst.
column3: 这正是让我不安的:海芙拉不久前离开了城市。而吞食者现在似乎也离开了城市。我担心最坏的事。

column2: Yes, I can smell your type. You are not so different than us.
column3: 是的,我闻得出你的类型。你和我们没有太大不同。

column2: A commendable trait among humans, getting involved.
column3: 在人类身上,卷入其中是个可贵的品质。

column2: I like that. I wish that all my children were a bit more active.
column3: 我喜欢。真希望我所有的孩子都能再积极一点。

column2: She's one of the Collectors. Heptarch even. She took over their Villa here in the city decades ago.
column3: 她是收藏者的一员。甚至是七主。几十年前,她接管了他们在这座城里的别墅。

column2: Hevla is friends with a lot of people, unlike the other Heptarchs. Those are a selfish bunch, according to what I heard.
column3: 和其他七主不同,海芙拉与很多人都是朋友。据我所闻,那些家伙是一群自私鬼。

column2: Hevla is interested in how we, the Titans, formed communities, among humans and people of the flesh.
column3: 海芙拉感兴趣的是,我们泰坦是如何在人类和血肉之民中间建立社群的。

column2: She entered my realm in pursuit of research.
column3: 她为追求研究而进入了我的领域。

column2: I think it began with Morrowmeat and his sorry state. According to Hevla it's more of a sickness. Something rotten.
column3: 我想是从摩罗肉铺和他那副惨状开始的。在海芙拉看来,那更像是一种病。某种腐烂的东西。

column2: She examined me on a molecular level. And I bade my children to offer themselves for examination, too.
column3: 她在分子层面上检查了我。我还吩咐我的孩子们也献出自己接受检查。

column2: You have to ask Hevla herself what this is all about.
column3: 这到底是为了什么,你得去问海芙拉本人。

column2: I think she might have been looking for a cure.
column3: 我想她也许是在寻找一种治愈方法。

column2: You mentioned she's gone. How can she help us?
column3: 你说过她不在了。那她怎么帮我们?

column2: Well, she... She mentioned once, not without pride, how her personal arsenal can only be unlocked by her own mind.
column3: 嗯,她……她曾颇为自豪地提到,她的私人军械库只有她自己的心智才能解锁。

column2: So I copied that part of her mind.
column3: 所以我复制了她心智的那一部分。

column2: The part which I think could be used for a mind contraption like that.
column3: 我认为那一部分正好可以用在那样一个心智装置上。

column2: I know that you can handle memories. You brought Morrowmeat's memory to us.
column3: 我知道你能处理记忆。你把摩罗肉铺的记忆带给了我们。

column2: If you promise that you will use it for the greater good of the city, I will entrust you with Hevla's engram.
column3: 如果你保证会把它用于这座城市的更大福祉,我就把海芙拉的核心印记托付给你。

column2: Then let me enter your mind...
You have a beautiful mind, my child.
column3: 你有一颗美丽的心智,我的孩子。

column2: I trust that you will be careful with Hevla's Engram.
column3: 我相信你会小心对待海芙拉的核心印记的。

column2: So where do I find Hevla's arsenal?
column3: 那我去哪里找海芙拉的军械库?

column2: It's in the villa of the Collectors.
I have come for your engram.
column3: 我是来拿你的核心印记的。

column2: But you won't get it. Not without a fight.
column3: 但你拿不到。除非踏过我的尸体。

column2: I make you a counterproposal: Ask me about Hevla instead.
column3: 我给你一个反提案:不如向我打听海芙拉。

column2: I could give you something that would help us both.
column3: 我可以给你一些对我们俩都有帮助的东西。

column2: [Try suppressing Mother's mind to get her engram.]
column3: [尝试压制母亲的心智以夺取核心印记。]

column2: Apart from Mother's engram you also find a memory imprint matching the Heptarch Hevla.
column3: 在母亲的核心印记之外,你还发现了一份与七主海芙拉相匹配的记忆印迹。

column2: This will be the end of you, my child.
column3: 这将是你终结之日,我的孩子。
好吧。我对海芙拉很好奇。

column2: I gave you Hevla's engram. Isn't that enough already?
column3: 我已经把海芙拉的核心印记给你了。这还不够吗?

column2: Humans always need help from someone. I have witnessed this again and again.
column3: 人类总是需要别人帮忙。这一点我一次又一次地见证过。

column2: I cannot take care of all the children on this world.
column3: 我照顾不了这个世界上的所有孩子。

column2: They are oppressed by the Machine Guardians.
column3: 他们被机器守卫压迫着。

column2: I know. And it fills me with sorrow—to see all these precious children crushed, forced into submission by cold metal and unfeeling algorithms.
column3: 我知道。这让我满心悲哀——眼睁睁看着这些珍贵的孩子被碾碎,被冰冷的金属和没有感情的算法强行驯服。

column2: But I don't have the means to change that. My power is limited to my own temple these days. You need to get help from someone else.
column3: 但我没有改变这一切的手段。如今我的力量仅限于自己的神庙。你得去找别人帮忙。

column2: The one you should turn your attention to is Heptarch Hevla, even if she's not around at the moment.
column3: 你该把注意力转向的是七主海芙拉,哪怕她眼下不在。

column2: The Collectors have hoarded an arsenal of technology. I know this because Hevla has visited me in pursuit of research and has shared details about her capabilities.
column3: 收藏者囤积了一批科技军械。我知道这个,因为海芙拉为研究来拜访过我,和我聊过她的能力。
