column2: Don't dawdle around there. Come and show me your face.
column3: 别在那边磨蹭。过来让我看看你的脸。

column2: I have watched your progress. Well done for a small one. Well done.
column3: 我一直在看着你的成长。对一个小的来说,干得不错。干得不错。

column2: But why are you doing this? Why all this effort?
column3: 可你为什么要这么做?为什么费这么大劲?

column2: Coming down here all this way. There's not much to see apart from grizzled old me.
column3: 大老远跑到这里来。除了灰头土脸的老我之外,这里也没什么好看的。

column2: I wonder about the purpose of your visit.
{She stares at you with vacant eyes.}
What else do you want to know about Hevla?
column3: 关于海芙拉你还想知道什么?

column2: Why are they cutting up the Titan like that?
column3: 他们为什么那样切割那头泰坦?

column2: Because of the meat. We eat meat. To survive. So we cut off a few pieces of that quarry guy. Simple.
column3: 为了肉啊。我们吃肉。为了活下去。所以从那家伙身上切几块下来。就这么简单。

column2: The machines won't provide us with anything else so we have to take care of it ourselves.
column3: 机器不会给我们别的东西,所以我们只能自己解决。

column2: Couldn't you get it somewhere else? There's a lot of meat in this world that's not part of some quarry guy.
column3: 你们不能从别处弄肉吗?这世界上有很多肉可不属于什么采石场家伙。

column2: But the meat from the quarry guy tastes great. I like it.
column3: 但采石场家伙的肉好吃啊。我喜欢。

column2: And I told you already: the machines won't come up with any other food. We are totally on our own here.
column3: 而且我跟你说过:机器不会弄来别的食物。在这里我们完全只能靠自己。

column2: Did you ever go out there and look for other food?
column3: 你出去找过别的食物吗?

column2: Us humans? Procuring our own food?
Haha. That's wild. Why would we though? The machines take care of us.
column3: 哈哈。太离谱了。不过为什么要呢?机器会照顾我们的。

column2: Well, it wasn't always like that.
Are you talking about human history or what?
column3: 你说的是人类历史还是什么?

column2: Where are you from? Did you grow up taking care of your own food?
column3: 你从哪里来?你是自己弄吃的长大的吗?

column2: No. I grew up in one of the Silent Cities.
column3: 不是。我在一座寂静之城里长大。

column2: And who took care of the food?
See, you're one of us, kind of.
column3: 看吧,你跟我们也算一路人。

column2: It's where we get our food.
You are new here, I guess. Well, watch out.
column3: 你是新来的,我猜。行,当心点。

column2: Be nice to the machines. I don't want any interruptions to my regular feedings.
column3: 对机器客气点。我可不想我的定期进食被打断。

column2: Do you know where to get a reflux filter?
column3: 你知道去哪弄一个回流过滤器吗?

column2: The Titan Support System over there needs a new one.
column3: 那边的泰坦支持系统需要一个新过滤器。

column2: Does this mean the Titan is experiencing some difficulties?
column3: 这是不是说那头泰坦遇到困难了?

column2: Oh, that's bad. Hopefully it doesn't affect the quality of the meat.
column3: 哦,那可糟了。希望不影响肉的品质。

column2: I don't know what a reflux filter is. But I guess the system here was installed by the Machines, same as the rest.
column3: 我不知道回流过滤器是什么。不过我猜这里这套系统也是机器装的,和其他地方一样。

column2: I've heard they get their parts at the Factory, in the north of the city.
column3: 我听说他们的零件从工厂弄,在城北边。

column2: But we're not allowed to walk around there.
column3: 但我们不允许在那边乱走。

column2: What's going on in this place?
It's a Cyberwomb. People of the city use it to get their fix.
column3: 是间义体子宫。城里的人用它过过瘾。

column2: This Cyberwomb stuff is nice... It's not like the real thing, of course.
column3: 这义体子宫的东西不错……当然,和真货没法比。

column2: I remember being connected to Omniwomb. THAT was real. Wow. The stuff of legends.
column3: 我记得连上万物子宫的日子。那才是真的。哇。传奇一般的存在。

column2: My friends and me diving through the planes of chaos, dancing on the fields of heaven. Living to the beat.
column3: 我和朋友们穿梭在混沌位面之间,在天堂的原野上跳舞。跟着节拍活着。

column2: Being awake all night until we passed out. At least you don't have to walk home if you're in the Omniwomb, haha.
column3: 通宵清醒直到断片。至少在万物子宫里你不用走路回家,哈哈。

column2: Then, on the next day, off to new adventures. Browsing the latest shit.
column3: 然后第二天,又是新的冒险。浏览最新潮的玩意。

column2: Do you have adventures here in this world, too?
column3: 你在这个世界里也有冒险吗?

column2: Sure. I have all sorts of exciting days. The city is beautiful, does have its perks. But I think it's too dangerous beyond the city.
column3: 当然。我每天都有各种刺激的日子。这座城市很美,有它的好处。但我认为城外太危险了。

column2: There's all sorts of violence and stuff.
column3: 外面到处是暴力什么的。

column2: Have you heard about a Titan machine entering the city?
column3: 你听说过有泰坦机器进城吗?

column2: A Titan entering the city? No, I have not. Now that would be a sight I'm sure I would not forget.
column3: 泰坦进城?没有,我没听说过。那绝对会是我一辈子忘不掉的场面。

column2: You say 'machine'. Is it a hybrid? Oh my god. Imagine the machines and the mutants cooperating.
column3: 你说"机器"。是混血的吗?我的天。想象一下机器和变异人合作。

column2: Those fuckers! Where would that leave us humans?
column3: 那些混蛋!那我们人类算什么?

column2: We need to be ready for that. For the worst case scenario.
column3: 我们得为此做好准备。为最坏的情况。

column2: We should own the means to fight for our rights. With violence, if necessary.
column3: 我们应该拥有为自己的权利而斗争的手段。必要时用暴力。

column2: Bah. What are you? A pacifist?
column3: 切。你算什么?和平主义者?

column2: Well, I might have an idea about where to start.
column3: 嗯,我也许有点头绪该从哪开始。

column2: A fine taste? Sounds like you need someone who appreciates good food.
column3: 好的品味?听起来你需要一个懂美食的人。

column2: Ask Hudde over there in the east of the Market. She knows all about meat.
column3: 去问市场东边那边的哈德。关于肉她无所不知。

column2: Forget about it. The Collectors have overtaken the Administration.
column3: 别想了。收藏者接管了行政厅。

column2: This changes a lot. But we'll have to see in what way.
column3: 这改变了很多。但得看往哪个方向变。

column2: Scout the Administration, find any weakness, and observe its military strength.
column3: 侦察行政厅,找出任何弱点,观察它的军事力量。

column2: I have finished investigating the Administration.
column3: 我完成了对行政厅的调查。

column2: Yes, this will help us a lot. I thank you.
column3: 是的,这会帮我们大忙。我感谢你。

column2: I think it's about time you meet some of my friends.
column3: 我觉得是时候让你见见我的几个朋友了。

column2: Go over to the Residential Area. There's this rough looking guy hanging out in front of a door.
column3: 去居住区。有个看起来很凶的家伙守在一扇门前。

column2: Tell him that Protas sent you, and he'll know you're one of us.
column3: 告诉他是普罗塔斯派你来的,他就知道你是自己人了。

column2: So what's that idea you mentioned?
column3: 你说的那个想法是什么?

column2: What I propose is simple: We take control of the city. For ourselves. The humans.
column3: 我的提议很简单:我们接管这座城市。为了我们自己。为了人类。

column2: We are not alone in this. There are other people, friends of mine, already planning for contingencies.
column3: 在这件事上我们并不孤单。还有其他人,我的朋友们,已经在筹划应对之策。

column2: Look, I'm not saying that it has to be violent. At first.
column3: 听着,我不是说非得动用暴力。一开始嘛。

column2: What we need to start with is a bit of good old reconnoitering. Are you in?
column3: 起步需要的是一点老派的侦察。你加入吗?

column2: What exactly would I be in for?
Taking a peek at the Administration. A fresh face will be less suspicious than mine.
column3: 去行政厅窥探一番。生面孔比我的脸可疑度低。

column2: Eh, alright. Come back if you remember for which team you're supposed to be playing here.
column3: 呃,好吧。等你想起来自己该给哪边卖命的时候再回来。

column2: OK. I think I can do that.
That's the spirit. Now, what I need you to do: Scout the Administration, find any weakness, and observe its military strength.
column3: 这就对了。现在,我要你做的是:侦察行政厅,找出任何弱点,观察它的军事力量。

column2: You mentioned meeting some of your friends...
column3: 你说过要介绍你的朋友给我……

column2: Yes. Indeed. You did us a solid there.
column3: 是的。千真万确。你帮了我们大忙。

column2: I kind of guessed that you would be one of those people helping out if a community is in need. And that you couldn't stand those machine fuckers either.
column3: 我多少猜到,如果社群有需要,你会是那种出手相助的人。而且你也受不了那些机器混蛋。

column2: I saw that in you. Right from the start.
column3: 我一开始就在你身上看出来了。

column2: Well done, my friend. Well done.
column3: 干得好,我的朋友。干得好。

column2: I feel great relief about this.
Rebuilding. Gonna take some time and effort. For now we're allowed to have a bit of rest without a machine eye leering at us.
column3: 重建。需要时间和精力。至少现在,我们可以稍微歇息,不再有机器的眼睛瞪着我们。

column2: You there. You are new around here. I haven't seen you before.
column3: 你那边那位。你是这一带的新面孔。我以前没见过你。

column2: I welcome you to the exalted metropolis.
column3: 欢迎来到这座尊贵的大都会。

column2: Enjoy being a human around other humans here. If they let you.
column3: 好好享受在同类中间做人的日子。如果他们允许的话。

column2: The machines. They make a nice appearance at first.
column3: 机器。他们起初看着挺和善。

column2: But that iron fist is waiting for you if you move somewhere you're not supposed to be.
column3: 可一旦你走到不该去的地方,那只铁拳就等着你。

column2: All for our protection, as they are wont to say. But doesn't that feel more like oppression?
column3: 用他们的话说,一切都是为了保护我们。但这难道不像压迫吗?

column2: Enter off-limit areas and they'll shoot you without warning. Build a garden to grow some meat-alternative and they'll destroy it because of 'health' issues.
column3: 进入禁区,他们会不警告就开枪。种个园子种点肉的替代品,他们会以"健康"问题为由毁掉它。

column2: That's on top of not being able to have children and of not being able to access technology that historically belonged to us humans.
column3: 这还不算不能生孩子,不能接触历史上属于我们人类的技术。

column2: We used to own this whole planet, including this capital.
column3: 我们曾拥有整个星球,包括这座首都。

column2: Lately, we are not even allowed to leave the capital, and I guess the same goes for entering.
column3: 最近我们甚至不被允许离开首都,我猜进来也一样。

column2: You are actually the first new face I have seen in a long while.
column3: 你确实是这么久以来我见到的第一张新面孔。

column2: Well, sorry for chewing your ear off.
column3: 好吧,抱歉跟你唠叨个没完。

column2: What do you want to know?
I need to concentrate and figure this out.
column3: 我需要专心把这事想明白。

column2: I just need time. Lots of it.
column3: 我只是需要时间。很多时间。

column2: And the sooner you get out of my sight, the sooner I will be left to my own ponderings, and be able to focus again.
column3: 你越早从我眼前消失,我就越早能沉浸在自己的思考里,重新集中精神。

column2: The flesh growth. Where it came from. Where it's going. Why it's gonna overwhelm us.
column3: 血肉的增生。它从哪来。往哪去。为什么它终将吞没我们。

column2: So did you find any answers yet?
column3: 那你找到什么答案了吗?

column2: But one question bothers me even more than the others.
column3: 但有一个问题比其他所有问题都更困扰我。

column2: The question of how we might be able to revert the whole thing.
column3: 那就是我们如何才能逆转这一切。

column2: Basically, how to exterminate the flesh completely.
column3: 基本上就是,如何把血肉彻底清除。

column2: But, here comes the disappointment. It's not gonna vanish. It's here and it's gonna stay.
column3: 但,失望来了。它不会消失。它就在这里,而且会一直留着。

column2: Do you understand? There's nothing we can do about it.
column3: 你明白吗?我们对此无能为力。

column2: So could the flesh growth be influenced at least?
column3: 那血肉的增生至少能被影响吗?

column2: Curtailing the flesh seems to be impossible. Holding it back from growing and thus conquering the whole world.
column3: 遏制血肉似乎是不可能的。挡住它的生长,不让它征服整个世界。

column2: Trying to stop it is like trying to put the genie back into the bottle and corking it with a stopper.
column3: 试图阻止它,就像试图把精灵塞回瓶子里再用塞子堵上。

column2: I don't think we're able to do it.
There's no way the flesh growth could be stopped?
column3: 血肉的增生就完全没法阻止吗?

column2: We might hold them off. Here, on Nexus. At least make sure that they're not able to leave the planet.
column3: 我们也许能挡住它们。在这里,在 Nexus 上。至少确保它们没法离开这颗星球。

column2: See, my biggest concern would be the flesh taking over other worlds.
column3: 你看,我最担心的就是血肉侵占其他世界。

column2: Think about all the people on these other worlds. What would happen if the flesh invaded their homes?
column3: 想想那些世界上的所有人。如果血肉侵入了他们的家园会怎样?

column2: Do you know any other worlds?
Do you know how the flesh would travel to other worlds?
column3: 你知道血肉会怎么前往其他世界吗?

column2: That all seems a bit vague to me.
column3: 这一切对我来说都有点含糊。

column2: Maybe. I don't know. I need to think this through.
column3: 也许吧。我不知道。我需要把这事想透。

column2: I'm a doctor. I don't kill people. Usually.
column3: 我是医生。我不杀人。通常。

column2: I need to get rid of some flesh maggots.
Ah. Yeah, I got something that could help.
column3: 啊。对,我有点东西也许能帮上忙。

column2: But it's an important ingredient of my liver medicine.
column3: 但那是我肝病药的重要成分。

column2: I can't share it with you.
But if you can bring me some materials I can mix it up for you.
column3: 不过如果你能给我带些材料来,我可以给你调配一份。

column2: I need some ethanol, a poisonous fungus, and some juice to keep the lab running.
column3: 我需要一些乙醇、一种毒蘑菇,还有一些让实验室运转的电池液。

column2: Ok. I'll go looking for that.
We're out in the wastes here.
And the lab isn't gonna run on it's own.
column3: 实验室可不会自己运转。

column2: I need something to induce energy.
column3: 我需要点能提供能量的东西。

column2: Bright, yellow, usually grows in caves.
column3: 亮黄色,通常长在洞穴里。

column2: You're an adult. I'm sure you'll find that somewhere.
column3: 你是成年人了。我相信你能在哪找到的。

column2: And make sure it's the good stuff.
Here are the things you asked for.
Did you just drink the booze?
I thought you needed it as an ingredient.
column3: 我还以为你要拿它当材料。

column2: That's why I'm a doctor, and you're not.
column3: 所以我是医生,而你不是。

column2: I should probably hurry back to the Puke Bar before it's overrun by maggots.
column3: 我得赶紧回呕吐酒吧,免得它被蛆攻占了。

column2: I don't feel so well. Can you examine me?
column3: 我不太舒服。你能帮我检查一下吗?

column2: The Machines said that I am contaminated.
You're from one of the habitats?
column3: 你是从某个栖居地来的?

column2: Ok. Let me take a quick look.

column3: 你的器官显示出轻微的应激性。

column2: But that's expected if you're freshly exposed to the environment around here.
column3: 不过如果你刚接触到这一带的环境,这属于预期反应。

column2: Can't see anything else on the scanner that would be a cause for your sickness.
column3: 扫描仪上看不到其他可能导致你生病的东西。

column2: Sorry, but seems I can't help you there.
It's a long shot, but Mortus is researching the flesh and how it affects us humans.
column3: 不太有把握,但莫图斯在研究血肉以及它对我们人类的影响。

column2: He showed up a while ago and set up his base here in the underground beneath us.
column3: 他不久前出现,把基地设在了我们脚下的地下。

column2: Maybe he could take a look at you.
Here are the brains and the Octagon fluid.
What? I didn't ask for that.

column3: 这些是给地下莫图斯的吧?

column2: Do you have a spare medical scanner?
column3: 你有多余的医疗扫描仪吗?

column2: Mortus wants to examine me and needs better equipment for that.
column3: 莫图斯想给我做检查,需要更好的设备。

column2: Mortus said I would give you one?
column3: 莫图斯说你会给我一台?

column2: Alright. I guess I could lend it to Mortus.
column3: 好吧。我想我可以借给莫图斯。

column2: RESPONSE UNITS FROM GROUP B HAVE BEEN SET TO REST MODE.
column3: B 组响应单元已设置为休眠模式。

column2: All that traveling. All those miles. On foot.
column3: 那些旅行。那些路程。全靠双脚。

column2: It's in your gait, you know?
column3: 都写在你的步态里,知道吗?

column2: Nah, not really. It's just that a guy told me about it once.
column3: 呃,也不算。只是有个人跟我说起过一次。

column2: Oh, man, was he disappointed that he couldn't get into the Temple here in the city.
column3: 哦天,他进不了城里的神庙,失望得不行。
'走了那么远的路。全都白费了。'

column2: He looked all sad and stuff.
I have visited the Puke Bar.
THE Puke Bar? Oh my god.
Was it gross? Did you get drunk?
It's... well, I guess it was.
I don't remember if I got drunk.
I'm a friend of the Fleshkraken.
Did he try to eat you before you became his friend?
column3: 在你们成为朋友之前,它有没有想吃掉你?

column2: Uhm, maybe. I am not so sure.
I wonder what it's like to get eaten by a Flesh Titan.
column3: 好奇被血肉泰坦吃掉是什么感觉。

column2: Well, we would have to ask Fleshface about that.
column3: 嗯,这个我们得问问肉脸了。

column2: Long story. Maybe I'll get back to it at some point.
column3: 说来话长。也许改天我再讲。

column2: I overthrew the Administration of this city.
column3: 我推翻了这座城市的行政厅。

column2: I wondered what happened. There are rumors, but no one could tell me anything concrete.
column3: 我还纳闷发生了什么。有流言,但没人说得清。

column2: I was kind of glad to see the machines leaving this place.
column3: 看到机器离开这里,我还挺高兴的。

column2: I am glad that you fought alongside our own team, haha.
column3: 幸好你是跟我们自己的队伍并肩作战,哈哈。

column2: Protas tells me that it's us who are in charge now. I guess we'll have to see about that.
column3: 普罗塔斯告诉我,现在是我们当家了。这还得走着瞧。

column2: I mean, not a fan of the new machines here.
column3: 我是说,我不是新机器的粉丝。

column2: But I guess they haven't killed anyone so far, so maybe that's better.
column3: 不过他们到目前为止还没杀过人,所以也许还更好些。

column2: Are you new here? Did you come from outside?
column3: 你是新来的?你从外面来的?

column2: When I left the Silent City I was a bit lost at first, but then I found this place. And then I was too afraid to leave again. Because of all the scary stuff out there.
column3: 我离开寂静之城的时候一开始也有点迷茫,但后来找到了这地方。然后就再也不敢离开了。外面那些吓人的东西太多了。

column2: But you, you must be a hero. Like one of the characters from the Cyberwomb tales.
column3: 但你,你肯定是个英雄。就像义体子宫传说里的人物。

column2: A scoundrel. A lonesome wanderer. A scion of Prometheus.
column3: 一个浪子。一个孤独的流浪者。普罗米修斯的后裔。

column2: Please, tell me about one of your heroic feats.
column3: 求你了,给我讲讲你的英雄事迹吧。

column2: Leave me be and continue your journey.
column3: 别管我,继续你的旅程吧。

column2: Continue enjoying this world. I'm gonna rescue it for all of us.
column3: 继续享受这个世界吧。我会为了我们所有人拯救它。

column2: She was my stars. Now she's the black sky, flickering, drifting into darkness.
column3: 她曾是我的星辰。如今她是黑色的天空,闪烁着,飘向黑暗。
很快,我就再也够不到她了。

column2: I'll punch the Evergrowing Heart so it will pump again.
column3: 我会痛击那颗恒增之心,让它重新跳动。

column2: You don't know anything, do you?
I'll get them, one by one, until I know where the heart is.
column3: 我会一个一个地抓到他们,直到我找到心脏在哪。

column2: Kill them all, if I have to.
column3: 必要时就把他们全杀了。

column2: You should be thanking me. What good would this world be if the flesh dies?
column3: 你应该谢谢我。如果血肉死了,这个世界还有什么好?

column2: A dead planet. Humans crawling on it like maggots.
column3: 一颗死去的星球。人类像蛆一样在上面爬。

column2: And I am not even hungry.
Bleh. How can this thing live?
What do you want to talk about, fellow human?
column3: 你想聊点什么,同为人类的你?

column2: I would like to talk about our plans.
I'm not really sure what we're up to.
column3: 我不太确定我们在忙什么。

column2: I would like to meet new people.
Actually, I have someone big and meaty in need of a friend.
column3: 其实,我认识一个又大又多肉的家伙,正需要朋友。

column2: Maybe we should meet that someone.
column3: 也许我们该去见见那位。

column2: You said you left the Machine Masters. Why?
column3: 你说过你离开了机器主人。为什么?

column2: I want to mingle among the humans.
I'm alone. I'm different than the other machines.
column3: 我很孤独。我和其他机器不一样。

column2: And I don't want to become like the machines again.
column3: 我不想再变回机器那样。

column2: So I have to become something else.
column3: 所以我必须变成别的东西。

column2: I want to become similar to the humans.
I'm a multi-purpose cyborg. I was created as a worker and protector.
column3: 我是多功能改造人。我被造出来时是工人兼护卫。

column2: To the Machine Masters and therefore also for the humans, of course.
column3: 为机器主人服务,当然,也因此为人类服务。

column2: I gave myself the flesh face to be more alike humans. Therefore I am Fleshface.
column3: 我给自己装了血肉之脸,为了更像人类。所以我叫肉脸。

column2: There's a funnel sticking out of him. Maybe... organic lubricant?
column3: 他身上插着一个漏斗。也许……需要有机润滑油?

column2: I was one of your masters. Here to protect you.
column3: 我曾是你的主人之一。来保护你。

column2: To shield you from the dangers of this world.
column3: 为你挡住这个世界的危险。

column2: But that was in my previous life.
I left the masters to become one of you.
column3: 我离开了主人们,为了变成你们中的一员。

column2: Is that why someone destroyed you?
I don't know. I don't have any memory of me getting destroyed.
column3: 我不知道。我不记得自己被毁过。

column2: Are you the one who activated me again?
column3: 是你把我重新启动的吗?

column2: I would like to continue my travels. Exploring. Getting to know people.
column3: 我想继续我的旅行。探索。认识人们。

column2: Perhaps you could separate my head from my body and carry me around?
column3: 也许你可以把我的头和身体分开,带着我走?

column2: I'm fully self-sufficient. I won't be a burden to you.
column3: 我完全能自理。我不会成为你的负担。

column2: I just want to experience life. Make friends. See new places.
column3: 我只想体验生活。交朋友。看看新地方。

column2: Already took the most important part.
column3: 最重要的部分已经拿走了。

column2: Say, you're here for the steaks, too?

column3: 就是那些红衣服的家伙。

column2: They wanna get rid of everyone. Us. The Titans.
column3: 他们想除掉所有人。我们。还有泰坦。

column2: I bet they even have it in for the Machines.
column3: 我打赌他们连机器都惦记着。

column2: So, you're here for the steaks?
Yes. I heard that this house has a cellar, and there's a hidden path.
column3: 是的。我听说这房子有个地窖,有条暗道。

column2: Somewhere behind the house, among the rocks.
column3: 就在房子后面,岩石中间。

column2: Yeah. You eat one, and when you fall asleep you start seeing reality as it is.
column3: 对。你吃一块,睡着后就会开始看到世界的本来的样子。

column2: But it's difficult to get hold of one, with all these Godhunters around.
column3: 但很难弄到手,周围全是这些猎神者。

column2: Steaks so good, they make your brain melt.
column3: 好吃到让你脑浆融化的牛排。

column2: And they make you see things. See visions. The truth.
column3: 而且它们会让你看到东西。看到幻象。看到真相。

column2: What? Why else would you be here then?
column3: 什么?那你来这儿干什么?

column2: But while you're here: Maybe you could help me with a thing?
column3: 不过既然你在这儿:也许你能帮我个忙?

column2: I want you to sneak into the cellar and get me a piece of the Butcher's Cut.
column3: 我要你溜进地窖,给我弄一块"屠夫切肉"。

column2: There's got to be some of it somewhere.
I heard about a hidden entrance behind the house, among the rocks.
column3: 我听说房子后面的岩石间有个暗道入口。

column2: You're lucky none of the Godhunters got to you while you were wandering around.
column3: 你四处乱逛的时候居然没被猎神者抓到,算你走运。

column2: Exit's down there. But maybe you'd like to stay here and help me with a thing?
column3: 出口在下面。不过也许你愿意留在这帮我个忙?

column2: If you got nothing better to do, I might need your help with something.
column3: 如果你没什么要紧事,我可能需要你帮个忙。

column2: I'd say the steaks here are worth my life, but with all these Godhunters around I'm reconsidering.
column3: 我本想说这里的牛排值得我冒这条命,但周围全是猎神者,我得再想想。

column2: Great. Here's the deal for you: I tell you how to get some of that meat the easy way, and you bring me a piece of it.
column3: 这笔交易是这样:我告诉你怎么轻松弄到那种肉,你给我带一块回来。

column2: How dare you show your face to me?
column3: 你怎么敢在我面前露出那张脸?

column2: Oh, I can smell it. You have found the flesh, haven't you?
column3: 哦,我闻到了。你找到血肉了,对不对?

column2: How dare you? Give it to me.
Oh, you glorious piece of flesh.
column3: 哦,你这光荣的血肉之块。

column2: I am going to enjoy this.
Here, take this as a thanks.
So, what do you do all day?
Hmmh? What else could there be?
What the hell? You have friends?
You want me to go look for someone?
Probably won't be easy though, considering your... circumstances.
column3: 不过恐怕不容易,考虑到你的……情况。

column2: What kind of animal are you?
That's me, human. What are you though?
No luck yet, sorry, but could you maybe help me talk to the Flesh Nexus?
column3: 还没找到,抱歉。不过你能帮我跟血肉枢纽说上话吗?

column2: Yeah, but, could you first help me out with talking to the Nexus?
column3: 是啊,不过你能先帮我跟枢纽搭上话吗?

column2: Yes. This one looks interesting enough.
column3: 可以。这个看起来够有意思。

column2: Swallow? You want to eat it?
Ehh. It's pretty sure it wants to eat you.
There's a high chance my shell is resilient enough to survive this. Could be an informative experiment.
column3: 我的外壳大概率够结实,能撑过去。也许会是个长见识的实验。

column2: But I could also be stuck in the bowels of this animal for years. Decades, even.
column3: 但我也可能被卡在这动物的肠子里好几年。甚至几十年。

column2: Thank you. Chances are high I might need that.
Ok. I'll leave you to it for now.
Hey, do you know how to talk to the flesh that's growing everywhere?
column3: 嘿,你知道怎么跟到处生长的血肉说话吗?

column2: A sudden awareness of past and recent experiences washes over you.
column3: 一股对过往与近期经历的认知突然涌上你的心头。

column2: Hey. Who are you? What are you doing here?
column3: 嘿。你是谁?你在这干什么?

column2: I live here and guard the Fleshkraken. Now, WHAT are you doing here?
column3: 我住在这里,守着血肉海妖。所以,你到底在这干什么?

column2: Please don't attack me. I'm not hurting anyone. I'm just taking care of the Fleshkraken.
column3: 请别攻击我。我不伤害任何人。我只是照顾血肉海妖。
你在这里不觉得孤独吗?

column2: The Fleshkraken is my friend. But he doesn't talk much.
column3: 血肉海妖是我的朋友。但它话不多。

column2: And I wish there were more people around here.
column3: 我真希望这一带能多些人。

column2: But it's important that someone takes care of the Kraken. So I'll just stay here.
column3: 但总得有人照顾海妖。所以我就在这待着。

column2: I'm alright. Don't worry. But thanks for asking.
column3: 我没事。别担心。谢谢你的关心。

column2: It's not mine. Look, you can talk to him, if you want.
column3: 它不是我的。这样吧,愿意的话,你可以和它聊聊。

column2: He's a bit moody these days.
You think? I mean, he's stuck here. I suppose he might like to have someone to talk to other than me.
column3: 你这么觉得?它被困在这里。我想它可能想找个除我之外能说话的。

column2: No, and I don't know how they got him in there in the first place. I just... I just take care of him.
column3: 出不去,我也不知道他们当初是怎么把它弄进去的。我只是……我只是照顾它。

column2: Do you know of other beings that are similar to him?
column3: 你知道和它类似的生物吗?

column2: I heard rumours. About an eye as big as a house. And mountains of flesh. But I don't know where they are.
column3: 我听过传言。说有一只房子那么大的眼睛。还有血肉之山。但我不知道它们在哪。

column2: Maybe you could ask around Tauris. It's to the east of here.
column3: 也许你可以在陶里斯打听打听。在这东边。

column2: I would, if I had any weapon.
Phew. I'm glad. I won't hurt you either. I just care for the Fleshkraken.
column3: 呼。太好了。我也不会伤害你。我只是照顾血肉海妖。

column2: I came from back there. The facility.
column3: 我是从后面那来的。那处设施。

column2: You came through the door? That's working?
column3: 你穿过那扇门了?那门还能用?

column2: Apparently. You know about the machines down there?
column3: 显然。你知道底下那些机器吗?

column2: No. Didn't know there were any.
column3: 不知道。我都不知道有机器。

column2: You can stay here if you want. I don't mind.
column3: 愿意的话你可以留在这。我不介意。

column2: Go away. Leave me, you bastard.
column3: 走开。离开我,你这个混蛋。

column2: The Flesh Nexus is calling you.
You try to reach out, but no one reacts to you.
column3: 你试图伸出触角,但没有任何东西回应你。

column2: You reach out, and there is something or someone reacting to you.
column3: 你伸出触角,有什么东西,或者什么人,回应了你。

column2: The sensation increases, and now you feel a thousand eyes fixed on you.
column3: 那种感觉越来越强,此刻你感到一千只眼睛盯着你。

column2: You try to speak, but have no voice.
column3: 你试图说话,却没有声音。

column2: The moment passes, and you feel the presence vanishing again.
column3: 那一瞬间过去了,你感到那存在再次远去。

column2: You reach out and the Flesh Nexus is aware of you.
column3: 你伸出触角,血肉枢纽察觉到了你。

column2: You let the flesh enter your mind.
column3: 你让血肉进入你的心智。

column2: The Nexus emits a warm feeling towards you, but remains silent.
column3: 枢纽向你散发出一种温暖的感觉,但保持沉默。

column2: You are standing in the light of the Mother. It would be appropriate to approach her Temple with reverence.
column3: 你正站在母亲的光辉之下。以敬畏之心走近她的神庙才是得体的。

column2: She might not be your mother, but she's a mother thousandfold. Show some respect.
column3: 她也许不是你的母亲,但她是千百人的母亲。放尊重些。

column2: She's the mother of the city. I think she's always been here. Might even be friends with the Collectors.
column3: 她是这座城市的母亲。我想她一直都在这儿。说不定和收藏者还是朋友。

column2: Mother is biding her time beneath us. She's all-seeing, all-caring. It's her call that we are hearing and that we have to follow through.
column3: 母亲在我们脚下静候时机。她全知全爱。我们听到的是她的召唤,而我们必须遵从。

column2: How do I get into the Temple?
I don't know. I am not sure that I would want to. It's Mother's realm and should be respected.
column3: 我不知道。我也不确定我想进。那是母亲的领域,应当被敬重。
人类再利用程序已启动。

column2: This machine is missing a Machine Core.
column3: 这台机器缺了一个机器核心。

column2: Some parts inside must have dislodged.
column3: 里面肯定有些零件松了。

column2: I've collected the worm. Nothing else to do here.
column3: 我已经抓到蠕虫了。这里没别的事了。

column2: A food store? It's a banquet. It's my delightsome haute cuisine. From derinded and dry-aged to garnished with lard, to dulcified even.
column3: 食品店?这是一场盛宴。这是我的美味高级料理。从去骨风干到肥油点缀,甚至还有甜口做法。

column2: It's here where I correspond with my meals. Better said, I nourish myself by pondering about all the possible meals I could be having.
column3: 在这里,我与我的餐食神交。确切地说,我靠畅想各种可能的大餐来滋养自己。

column2: Ahhh, how I long for a fresh set of giblets, savory and delicious.
column3: 啊啊,多想要一份新鲜的下水,香嫩美味。

column2: But, full disclosure and everything, I also sell meat. Yes.
column3: 不过,老实交代,我也卖肉。是的。

column2: What is up with that worm in the pen?
column3: 圈里那条蠕虫是怎么回事?

column2: I caught it to process it. To get something savory from it.
column3: 我抓它是为了加工它。从它身上弄点美味出来。

column2: Or rather, Marcia caught it and was smart enough to sell it to me. She knows I have a rather advanced palate.
column3: 或者说,是玛西娅抓的,她还挺聪明,卖给了我。她知道我的口味相当讲究。

column2: The problem is that I am unsure how to prepare this animal.
column3: 问题是我不知道该怎么料理这动物。

column2: It has a rather slimy underside, which I adore, but its muscular back looks tasty, too.
column3: 它腹部黏滑,我很喜欢,但它健壮的背部看着也很美味。

column2: I could keep it alive for that occasional smear of fat.
column3: 我也可以养着它,时不时刮点肥油。

column2: Maybe the animal is too wild though. Maybe I should just butcher it to get my fix of filet.
column3: 不过也许这动物太野了。也许我该直接宰了它,来享受我的菲力。

column2: Isn't that the hardest thing in the world, making decisions like that?
column3: 这难道不是世界上最难的事吗,做这样的决定?

column2: I could help you making a decision about that animal.
Are you sure you are up for it?
I am a connoisseur of all things relating to taste.
column3: 我可是万般滋味相关的行家。

column2: Uhm. It's rather irregular for me to depend on someone else.
column3: 呃。依靠别人对我来说挺不寻常的。

column2: But I guess it's worth a try.
Ah, doesn't it exude something, I don't know, ripe and aromatic?
column3: 啊,它是不是散发着某种……怎么说呢,成熟而芬芳的气息?

column2: Here. Let me open the door.
I think you should set the animal free.
column3: 我觉得你应该放了这动物。

column2: I have examined the worm. It's under a lot of stress.
column3: 我检查过那条蠕虫了。它压力很大。

column2: I don't think it would give you some tender meat anyway.
column3: 反正我觉得它也给不了你什么嫩肉。

column2: And the worm looks kinda old.
column3: 而且那条蠕虫看着有点老了。

column2: Wouldn't it be better to be known for only the best and freshest stuff?
column3: 以只卖最好最新鲜的东西闻名,不是更好吗?

column2: Now that you mention it, the animal looks kinda old. And frightened.
column3: 经你一说,这动物看着是有点老。而且惊恐。

column2: Alright. I'll set it free soon. I appreciate your opinion.
column3: 好吧。我很快放了它。谢谢你的意见。
安抚?像驯服那样?干什么?

column2: Ah, wait. You mean I should keep it alive for that slimy underside?
column3: 啊,等等。你是说我该把它养着,要它那黏滑的腹部?

column2: Yum. Look at this fine fatty underbelly.
column3: 唔姆。看看这漂亮的肥肚腩。

column2: {There's a smear of the fatty substance on her lips.}
I killed that worm for you.
column3: 我帮你把那条蠕虫杀了。

column2: What? You can't just kill a delicacy like that.
column3: 什么?你不能就这样杀了一道美食。

column2: If we want its meat, we have to carefully gut and bone it for its most precious parts.
column3: 我们要吃它的肉,就得小心地取脏剔骨,把最珍贵的部分取出来。

column2: These parts here seem fine to me.
column3: 这些部分在我看来没问题。

column2: Aha. Yes, indeed. They look fine.
column3: 啊哈。是的,确实。看着不错。

column2: Do you know anything about this Titan Support System?
column3: 你对这个泰坦支持系统了解多少?

column2: Is that the thing regulating the Titan's metabolism?
column3: 是那个调节泰坦新陈代谢的东西吗?

column2: I guess so. Looks like it needs a new filter.
column3: 应该是吧。看起来它需要个新过滤器。

column2: Oof. I'm no help with any mechanical task. Sorry.
column3: 呜哦。机械活我可帮不上忙。抱歉。

column2: Do you know where I could get a new filter?
column3: 你知道我去哪能弄个新过滤器吗?

column2: I don't know that either. Sorry.
About that exquisite taste I am looking for...
column3: 关于我要找的那种精致滋味……

column2: Yes. It's right in front of us, potentially. Morrowmeat, the suffering Titan.
column3: 有了。它就摆在我们眼前,可以说唾手可得。摩罗肉铺,那头受苦的泰坦。

column2: I think I got it already.
Could I have a piece of that?
I see. If you need something else, find me over at my old place.
column3: 明白了。如果你还需要什么,去我老地方找我。

column2: So I just grab a bite from him?
column3: 所以我直接从他身上咬一口就行?

column2: No. Not yet. Not like that.
He used to provide the most savory and tender raw meat this side of the City walls.
column3: 他曾是这城墙这一侧最香最嫩的生肉的提供者。

column2: But over time, right from when he was alone here, without Mother, he began descending into an abyss of personal darkness.
column3: 但随着时间流逝,就在他独自留在这里、没有母亲陪伴之后,他开始坠入个人黑暗的深渊。

column2: Can't help that people are using his flesh as their day-to-day meat.
column3: 也没办法阻止人们拿他的血肉当日常肉食。

column2: You should find a way to make his living more comfortable.
column3: 你应该想办法让他的日子好过一点。

column2: That's the best way to extract the most exquisite taste experiences: Making sure the raw materials are well-cared for.
column3: 这是提取最精致味觉体验的最好方式:确保原材料被悉心照料。

column2: I don't know. Examine him. Talk to the guardians.
column3: 我不知道。检查它。和守护者们谈谈。

column2: I've personally given up on him returning from that abyss.
column3: 我个人已经放弃他会从那深渊归来的指望了。

column2: But I know we would have the most exquisite piece of meat one could think of: Savored meat of a saved Titan.
column3: 但我知道我们将得到可想而知的最好的肉:一头被拯救的泰坦的美味之肉。

column2: Wait. What is that? Morrowmeat looks different.
column3: 等等。那是什么?摩罗肉铺看起来不一样了。

column2: He was really miserable the last time I saw him.
column3: 我上次见他的时候他真的惨不忍睹。

column2: Now he's showing a vibrance, a joie de vivre even.
column3: 现在他焕发出一种活力,甚至是一种生活的喜悦。

column2: Although I could be mistaken in that regard. His flesh is glistening so much.
column3: 不过这点上我也可能看错了。他的血肉实在太油亮了。

column2: I think you could talk to him now. Get a piece of savored meat of a saved Titan.
column3: 我想你现在可以跟他谈谈了。拿到一块被拯救的泰坦的美味之肉。

column2: I am looking for someone who can help me acquire a fine taste.
column3: 我在找一个能帮我弄到精致滋味的人。

column2: The Seneschal from the Collectors wants to expand his palate.
column3: 收藏者的总管想拓展他的味蕾。
他想尝一种"非凡"的东西。

column2: Oh. I know the Collectors. Won't be pleased easily.
column3: 哦。我了解收藏者。他们可不容易满足。

column2: I could help you with that. Later.
Because right now I have a taste problem of my own.
column3: 因为我现在自己有个滋味难题。

column2: It's the worm in the pen.
There's actually something that would be the pinnacle of taste in this city, I can tell you that.
column3: 其实我知道一样东西,会是这座城市滋味之巅,我可以告诉你。

column2: You cannot get it right away, but I can show it to you.
column3: 你没办法马上得到它,但我可以带你去看看。

column2: Let's walk over to the Meat Quarry.
column3: 我们一起走去肉石场吧。
欢迎,友善的血肉爱好者。

column2: Welcome to my humble place where we will talk about meat.
column3: 欢迎来到我寒舍,在这里我们谈论肉。

column2: You are interested in meat, yes?
You look a bit tart yourself, but also like having a full bouquet.
column3: 你自己看着也有点酸涩,但又不乏醇厚。

column2: Wait! You're not allowed to go back to the habitat.
column3: 等等!你不允许返回栖居地。

column2: You would risk contaminating the other citizens.
To prevent this, your life will be terminated if you enter the prohibited zone.
column3: 为了防止这一点,如果你进入禁区,你的生命将被终结。

column2: {The creature relaxes and lets go of the Flesh Spikes.}
column3: {生物放松下来,放开了血肉尖刺。}

column2: Hey. You wanna look at my stuff?
I heard about you. You helped us overcome the machines.
column3: 我听说过你的事。你帮我们战胜了机器。

column2: Ohhh... I don't feel so well.
Maybe there's a doctor out there somewhere.
column3: 也许外面哪里有个医生。
名称:固定式泰坦支持系统。

column2: STATUS: Reflux filter working at one hundred percent.
column3: 状态:回流过滤器运转率百分之一百。

column2: ERROR: Reflux filter efficiency at zero percent.
column3: 错误:回流过滤器效率为零。

column2: ERROR: Reflux filter in need of replacement.
column3: 错误:回流过滤器需要更换。

column2: I don't carry a fitting replacement with me.

column3: 注意:已安装新回流过滤器。

column2: That seems to have done it.

column3: 看起来像个科研工作站。

column2: Planet Nexus. Centuries after the Bleeding.
column3: 行星 Nexus。大流血之后的数个世纪。
机器四处游荡,执行审判。

column2: And the outcasts try to survive.
You should give your mind a bit of a rest sometimes, my friend.
column3: 朋友,有时候你也该让脑子歇一歇。

column2: Please. I'm just here for a bit of solitude.
column3: 拜托。我只是来这里图个清净。

column2: It's... it's nothing. I just like to reminisce sometimes.
column3: 没什么。我只是有时喜欢追忆往事。

column2: You see, I was taking care of my Titan. I was a guardian.
column3: 你看,我照顾过一头泰坦。我是个守护者。

column2: While the Titan was used as a feeder still.
column3: 那时泰坦还被当作喂养者使用。

column2: I didn't see much wrong with it then. Or, to be honest, I didn't want to think much about it.
column3: 当时我没觉得有什么不对。或者老实说,我不愿意多想。

column2: Apart from the obvious gruesome act... it's also just plain wrong?
column3: 除了那明摆着的残忍行径……那根本就是错的,不是吗?

column2: It's like taking advantage of someone innocent. For years. For decades. Maybe centuries?
column3: 就像占一个无辜者的便宜。一年又一年。十年又十年。甚至几个世纪?

column2: But you said it was useful for both sides.
column3: 可你说过这对双方都有好处。

column2: I don't know. Can't shake the feeling we did them wrong, the Titans.
column3: 我不知道。总觉得我们亏欠了泰坦,那种感觉挥之不去。

column2: Anyway. Please let me have some solitude now.
column3: 总之。请让我现在清净一会儿。

column2: Thank you for taking part in my thoughts.
column3: 谢谢你有心听我的思绪。

column2: Oh, so you don't know about this.
Sorry, I don't really want to talk about it.
column3: 抱歉,我真的不太想谈这个。

column2: Maybe it's enough to say that it was more like a partnership.
column3: 也许可以这么说:那更像是一种合作关系。

column2: We got the meat. They get... whatever they get out of it. I'm not really sure.
column3: 我们拿到肉。他们得到……他们从中得到的一切吧。我不太确定。

column2: I'm looking for this place called Tauris.
column3: 我在找一个叫陶里斯的地方。

column2: Got a bit lost on my way.
You know how I can get there?
I guess I'll have to find it on my own then.
column3: 那看来我只能自己找了。

column2: Perfect. I'll be on my way then.
Hey, are you from around here?
Well, it doesn't really matter if you're from here or there
column3: 嗯,你从哪来其实不重要。

column2: If only I had a drink...
I could walk so much longer...
If this goes on, I'll never find the Puke Bar.
column3: 再这样下去,我永远找不到呕吐酒吧了。

column2: You wouldn't happen to have something with you, right?
column3: 你身上不会正好有喝的吧?

column2: How about this bottle of booze?
Give it to me. I'll compensate you fairly.
column3: 给我吧。我会好好补偿你的。

column2: I'll never forget what you did for me.
column3: 我永远不会忘记你的恩情。

column2: Once I get to the Puke Bar, I'm sure the drinks will be marvellous.
column3: 等我到了呕吐酒吧,那里的酒一定很棒。

column2: I was so sure I would find it this time.
column3: 我这次很肯定能找到的。

column2: But the Puke Bar just won't show up, no matter how far I walk.
column3: 但不管走多远,呕吐酒吧就是不肯出现。

column2: I must be cursed or something.
column3: 我一定是被诅咒了还是怎么的。

column2: How am I supposed to get a drink now?
You wouldn't happen to have something with you, right?
column3: 你身上不会正好有喝的吧?

column2: Several people have told me the way, yet the Puke Bar is nowhere to be seen.
column3: 好几个人都给我指过路,可呕吐酒吧连个影子都没有。

column2: I'm sure I'll find it this time.
You told me the way after all.
I've given up on reaching Tauris.
column3: 我已经放弃去陶里斯了。

column2: It doesn't matter if you know the way or not.
column3: 认不认识路已经无所谓了。

column2: I'm now trying to get to this Puke Bar place.
column3: 我现在想去的是那个呕吐酒吧。

column2: Somebody told me that it should be close by...
column3: 有人跟我说应该就在附近……

column2: If somebody told you, they're probably right...
column3: 要是有人这么告诉你,那多半没错……

column2: You think so too? That's a good sign.
column3: 你也这么想?这是个好兆头。

column2: Perfect. Can't wait for a good drink.
column3: 完美。等不及要喝一杯好酒了。

column2: I made sure to follow what you said precisely this time.
column3: 这次我可是严格照你说的走的。

column2: Yet I still couldn't find it.
I've met somebody else. They told me about this Puke Bar.
column3: 我遇到了另一个人。他们跟我说了呕吐酒吧。

column2: I think it's supposed to be near here...
column3: 我听说应该就在这附近……

column2: I'll find my way to Tauris. Even without your help.
column3: 就算没有你帮忙,我也会找到去陶里斯的路。

column2: You just told me, where I need to go.
column3: 你刚才告诉我该怎么走了。

column2: You wouldn't happen to have learned where Tauris is by now?
column3: 你该不会到现在已经知道陶里斯在哪了吧?

column2: If you have, can you tell me?
Well, I'll guess I'll have to follow my instincts then.
column3: 好吧,那我就跟着直觉走了。

column2: Just this way, towards the horizon...
Great. I'm sure I'll find it this time.
It's just a bit in this direction...
Even though you told me the way, I still haven't managed to find this Tauris place.
column3: 虽然你告诉了我路,我还是没能找到这个陶里斯。

column2: But you know where it is, right?
Can you point me towards it?
I really need to find this Puke Bar place and have some more.
column3: 我一定要找到呕吐酒吧,再多喝点。

column2: Acquiring target for remote trigger termination...
column3: 正在为远程触发终结锁定目标……

column2: That machine looks interesting. I don't know its purpose though.
column3: 那台机器看起来有意思。不过我不知道它是干什么用的。

column2: I already took what I wanted.
Looks like I can open the machine and grab the insides.
column3: 看来我可以打开机器,取出里面的东西。

column2: That might be the Machine Core I was looking for.
column3: 这可能就是我在找的机器核心。

column2: We could try to get in there.
At least from where we are standing.
column3: 至少从我们站的位置不行。

column2: The entrance to the Great Perished One.
Every few months I come by and check if someone opened it.
column3: 每隔几个月我就来看看有没有人打开它。

column2: They say it's dead. It's all dead in there.
column3: 他们说它死了。里面全都死透了。

column2: Tired of eating meat all the time.
I bet they have better stuff in the city.
column3: 我打赌城里的东西更好。

column2: Though I could share it with you.

column3: 那就请让我一个人待着。

column2: And please close the door behind you.
Well, I'm Marla. I'm old, so I just stay here most of the time.
column3: 嗯,我是玛尔拉。我老了,所以大部分时间就待在这。
不过我和所有人都是朋友。

column2: Yeah. Agira's best though. She takes care of me.
column3: 嗯。最好的朋友是阿吉拉。她照顾我。

column2: Even brought me cheese that one day. Only time I had some, apart from Cyberwomb.
column3: 有一次还给我带了奶酪。除了义体子宫里,那是我唯一一次吃到。

column2: I met this... Kraken. And it needs a friend.
column3: 我遇到了那个……海妖。它需要朋友。

column2: A friend for the Kraken, you say? ... Wait!
column3: 给海妖找朋友,你是说?……等等!

column2: Are you talking about one of the Titans here?
column3: 你是说这里泰坦中的一位?

column2: I guess. ... It seemed a bit lonely.
Ohh. Really? I suppose they could have feelings like that.
column3: 哦。真的吗?我想它们也会有那种感情吧。

column2: Did you ever meet the Kraken?
No. You think I would ever leave Tauris again? I'm not as mad as you, traveling through the world.
column3: 没有。你觉得我还会再离开陶里斯吗?我可没你疯,满世界跑。

column2: So where would I get a friend for the Kraken?
column3: 那我去哪给海妖找朋友?

column2: I don't know, really. ... Oh wait. Maybe Mortus can help you.
column3: 我真不知道。……哦等等。也许莫图斯能帮你。

column2: Knows all kinds of stuff about the flesh.
column3: 关于血肉他什么都懂一些。

column2: He's living underground in the old facilities.
You can get there through one of the other houses.
column3: 你可以从另一栋房子过去。

column2: Meat! You want to buy some meat?
Is it safe to eat it raw like that?

column3: 安全。这一带的人都这么吃。

column2: What's with all the meat everywhere, anyway?
column3: 话说到处都是肉是怎么回事?

column2: Oh, and takes craftsmanship to pick the best pieces of course.
column3: 哦,当然,挑出最好的部位还是需要手艺的。

column2: Yeah, but where does it come from?
As far as I remember it has always been growing everywhere, right from the ground.
column3: 就我所记得,它一直都到处生长,直接从地里长出来。

column2: Maybe we're living on a planet full of flesh and right now we're standing on a crust of stone and dirt.
column3: 也许我们住在一颗满是血肉的星球上,而现在我们正站在一层石头和泥土的外壳上。

column2: So, do you want a piece of meat now?
column3: 那么,现在要来一块肉吗?

column2: We take care of everyone. If you want more though, you have to pay.
column3: 我们照顾每一个人。不过想要更多,就得付钱了。

column2: Have to prepare this fine meat.
column3: 得把这块好肉处理一下。

column2: Talk to Gonzo if you want to have some.
