column2: There's a broom, a bucket and a bunch of squished bottles.
column3: 有一把扫帚、一个水桶和一堆压扁的瓶子。
欢迎来到"奥德修斯"行动站点。

column2: THIS IS A HIGH SECURITY ENVIRONMENT.
PLEASE PLACE ALL HARMFUL ITEMS IN THE SECURITY STORAGE BOX.
column3: 请将所有危险物品放入安保储物箱。

column2: IT IS FORBIDDEN TO RECORD PROCEEDINGS IN THIS FACILITY.
column3: 禁止记录本设施内的任何活动。

column2: OUR SECURITY BOTS ARE HERE TO ENSURE YOUR SAFETY.
column3: 我们的安保机器人将确保您的安全。

column2: Save your data for yourself and the upcoming generations. 5000 years guaranteed.
column3: 为你自己和子孙后代保存数据。保证 5000 年。

column2: The insides have been pierced by stalagmites.
Some brown stuff is dripping down constantly.
column3: 一些棕色的东西在不停地往下滴。

column2: The leg of a plushie is stuck below.
column3: 下面卡着一只毛绒玩具的腿。

column2: It's warm, as if used recently.
column3: 它是温的,好像最近被用过。

column2: There's some rotating brushes in here. They have trouble turning though.
column3: 这里面有些旋转的刷子。不过它们转起来有点费劲。

column2: What a place to kick the bucket.
column3: 这地方倒是挺适合咽气的。

column2: Made any progress recently with your studies?
column3: 最近你的研究有进展吗?

column2: Not really. Science is oftentimes a slow process.
column3: 并没有。科学向来是个缓慢的过程。

column2: But I'm persistent. We'll figure this out.
column3: 但我很有毅力。我们会弄明白的。

column2: You have any idea where to get a friend for a big meat guy?
column3: 你知道去哪给一个多肉的大块头找朋友吗?

column2: I met this giant flesh creature. Looked like some tentacle animal.
column3: 我遇到了这个巨大的血肉生物。看着像某种触手动物。

column2: And it's a bit lonely and asking for a friend.
column3: 它有点孤独,正在找朋友。

column2: What kind of friend would a creature like that need? Another flesh creature?
column3: 那样的生物需要什么样的朋友?另一个血肉生物?

column2: I don't know. It accepted me as a friend though.
column3: 我不知道。不过它已经接受我做朋友了。

column2: Maybe you could repurpose one of the androids for this.
column3: 也许你可以改造一个人造人来干这事。

column2: That creature gets a friend, we have a chance to observe, and no one gets endangered.
column3: 那生物有了朋友,我们有了观察的机会,也不会有人陷入危险。

column2: Where would I get an android for this?
column3: 我去哪找能干这个的人造人?

column2: There's no use asking one of the Enforcers.
But I saw a broken android out there in Tauris, near the old house to the south.
column3: 但我在陶里斯外面见过一个坏了的人造人,在南边的老房子附近。

column2: Alright. Will take a look. Thanks.
Oh, I think I know which one.
It's that flesh tentacle creature I told you about.
column3: 就是我跟你说的那个血肉触手生物。

column2: Yes, I would be willing to.
This is quite interesting for me, too, you know.
column3: 你知道,这对我而言也相当有意思。

column2: You would be the first case I could study that's still in a very premature state.
column3: 你将是我能研究的第一个还处于非常早期阶段的病例。

column2: Premature? So you have an idea what this leads to?
column3: 早期?这么说你知道这会发展成什么?

column2: No. Don't know at this point. A mutation perhaps.
column3: 不知道。目前还不清楚。也许是某种变异。

column2: But first things first. I'm not fully equipped to perform human cell study.
column3: 但先做紧要的事。我的设备还不完全支持人类细胞研究。

column2: I'm gonna need a medical scanner and some octagon fluid.
column3: 我需要一个医疗扫描仪和一些八角液。

column2: Maybe you can get a scanner from the doctor here in Tauris. Tell him it's for me. Mortus.
column3: 也许你可以从陶里斯的医生那弄台扫描仪。告诉我是为了我,莫图斯。

column2: And there's no octagon fluid around here. You'll have to search one of the old facilities to the north.
column3: 八角液这附近没有。你得去北边的某处旧设施找找。

column2: Last but not least, it would be helpful if you got me some mutant brain tissue.
column3: 最后,如果你能给我弄点变异人脑组织,那会很有帮助。

column2: What did you want me to do?
Walk over to the Flesh Nexus and see if the flesh reacts to you.
column3: 走到血肉枢纽那里,看看血肉是否对你有反应。

column2: What was it you needed from me?
Some brain tissue, some octagon fluid, and a medical scanner.
column3: 一些脑组织、一些八角液,还有一台医疗扫描仪。

column2: I have all the items you wanted.
Alright. I've adjusted the frequency of the scanner to listen to any flesh activity.
column3: 好了。我已经把扫描仪的频率调整到能监听任何血肉活动。

column2: Would be interesting to see how the Flesh Nexus reacts to your body if it's enhanced by Octagon Fluid.
column3: 如果用八角液强化你的身体,血肉枢纽会作何反应,那会很有意思。

column2: It's my name for the web of flesh that fills these caves.
column3: 那是我给填满这些洞穴的血肉枢纽起的名字。

column2: It has mass, tentacles and nodes.
column3: 它有主体,有触手,有节点。

column2: There's a remarkable node here at the back of this cave.
column3: 这个洞穴深处有一个了不起的节点。

column2: Here, let me apply some of that Octagon fluid to your skin.
column3: 来,让我往你皮肤上涂一点八角液。

column2: If I am correct, then this should make you a lot more attractive to the Nexus.
column3: 如果我没错,这会让你对枢纽的吸引力大增。

column2: Go over to the node and give it a try.
Oh. I already talked to that thing.
column3: 哦。我已经跟那东西说过话了。

column2: Interesting. Your mutations must have developed further than suspected.
column3: 有意思。你的变异一定比预想的发展得更快。

column2: But more importantly, what did you see? Is it intelligent?
column3: 但更重要的是,你看到了什么?它有智慧吗?

column2: I'm not entirely sure about the Flesh Nexus itself.
column3: 血肉枢纽本身我说不准。

column2: But there was someone in there, communicating through the Nexus.
column3: 但里面有个人,通过枢纽在交流。

column2: Called himself the Oracle. And he wants me to find him.
column3: 他自称先知。他要我找到他。

column2: The Oracle mentioned a worm shaman.
column3: 先知提到了一个蠕虫萨满。

column2: And that a worm shaman is bound to help the Oracle.
column3: 还说蠕虫萨满注定会帮助先知。

column2: A shaman, you say? Maybe like that witch at the old trees?
column3: 萨满,你说?也许就像古树的那个女巫?

column2: It's what the people call her. I don't really know what's up with her.
column3: 大家是这么叫她的。我不太清楚她的底细。

column2: Witch. Shaman. Maybe it's the same. Or connected.
column3: 女巫。萨满。也许是同一个人。或者有关联。

column2: I think you should try talking to her.
column3: 我觉得你应该去跟她谈谈。

column2: Fascinating. Sounds like a real adventure.
column3: 引人入胜。听起来像一场真正的冒险。

column2: I think you've earned yourself some rest now, though.
column3: 不过我想你已经赚得了一些休息时间。

column2: It reacts to me. I feel like I could communicate with it, even.
column3: 它对我有反应。我甚至觉得我能与它交流。

column2: Only, my voice is not strong enough, or something like that.
column3: 只是我的声音不够强,或者类似的问题。

column2: How would you... how would you get a stronger voice for that?
column3: 那你会……你会怎么获得一个更洪亮的声音?

column2: I don't know. I'll look around.
Maybe I'll find another flesh node or stuff like that.
column3: 也许我会找到另一个血肉节点之类的东西。

column2: I met this giant flesh creature though. Looked like some tentacle animal.
column3: 不过我遇到了那个巨大的血肉生物。看着像某种触手动物。

column2: Maybe this creature might teach me how to get a stronger voice?
column3: 也许那个生物能教我怎么获得更洪亮的声音?

column2: Yes. Worth a shot, I guess.
Ok. I'll go talk to it.
Maybe that flesh tentacle creature I told you about.
column3: 也许是我说过的那个血肉触手生物。

column2: I've talked to the Flesh Nexus.
column3: 我跟血肉枢纽交谈过了。

column2: You did? Is it... are we talking about an intelligent being here?
column3: 是吗?那……我们说的是一个有智慧的存在吗?

column2: You wanted to visit that tentacle creature, see if it can teach you how to communicate with the Flesh Nexus.
column3: 你之前想去找那个触手生物,看它能不能教你怎么跟血肉枢纽交流。

column2: I feel ready to talk to the Flesh Nexus now.
column3: 我觉得我现在可以和血肉枢纽交谈了。

column2: Alright. How would you do it?
Don't know how, but I feel like I have a voice now.
column3: 不知道怎么做,但我感觉我现在有声音了。

column2: Interesting. Please, give it a try.
Examining the flesh. The machines. Finding out about our place among them.
column3: 检查血肉。检查机器。弄清我们在它们之中的位置。

column2: But my current studies are mostly focused on the flesh.
column3: 不过我目前的研究主要聚焦在血肉上。

column2: I wonder... What's your perception of all the forms of meat around us?
column3: 我好奇……你对周围这些形形色色的肉有什么看法?

column2: My general observations would be that it's unusual and we cannot discern where it comes from.
column3: 我的总体观察是:它很不寻常,而且我们无法分辨它从何而来。

column2: Its origin is what I'm concerned about. And its connection to the infections and mutations.
column3: 我关心的是它的来源。以及它与感染和变异的关系。

column2: Ehhh... I was cast out from the habitat because I'm contaminated. Could this be related?
column3: 呃呃……我因为被污染而被赶出了栖居地。这有关系吗?

column2: Interesting. There are no visible signs of any illness.
column3: 有意思。没有任何可见的疾病迹象。

column2: Pretty normal, most of the time. Occasionally sickness overcomes me and I have the urge to vomit.
column3: 大部分时间挺正常。偶尔会一阵恶心,有想吐的冲动。

column2: Alright. Those could be the first signs of your metabolism changing.
column3: 好。那些可能是你的新陈代谢开始转变的初期迹象。

column2: I would even say that there's no discernible origin of the meat.
column3: 我甚至会说,这些肉没有可辨的来源。

column2: Well, 'just' is a pretty bold assumption.
column3: 嗯,"就在那里"是个挺大胆的假设。

column2: I am glad that you returned to me.
column3: 你回到我身边,我很高兴。

column2: Are you the companion whom I have awaited so long?
column3: 你就是等待已久的同伴吗?

column2: I guess I could be that companion.
column3: 我想我可以做那个同伴。

column2: Oh, what joy I am feeling.
I did suppress any premature sentiments of hope. I did not dare to yearn too much.
column3: 我确实压制过那些过早滋生的希望。我不敢奢求太多。

column2: But a trickle remained, I admit, and now I see that it was warranted.
column3: 但一丝细流仍在,我承认。而现在我看到,那是有根据的。

column2: Lead on then and guide me.
column3: 那么请在前领路,指引我。

column2: I name you companion from now on.
column3: 从今往后,我命名你为同伴。

column2: A friendly face in this dark cavern.
column3: 黑暗洞穴中一张友善的脸。

column2: My heart blooms, encountering another person, and my mood lightens, for I know that I won't be as alone anymore.
column3: 我的心因遇见另一个人而绽放,我的心情也轻快起来,因为我知道自己不再那么孤独了。

column2: It pains me to see so much coldness in this world.
column3: 看到这个世界上如此多的冷漠,我很痛心。

column2: This piece of journey will be a joy to spend together, won't it?
column3: 这一段旅程一起走过,会是乐事,对吧?

column2: Dear companion, let us continue on our path.
column3: 亲爱的同伴,让我们继续上路。

column2: I can sense a profound warmth that fills the area around us.
column3: 我能感觉到一股深厚的暖意充盈在我们周围。

column2: This place speaks to me. The open structure, the sun and the trees: They welcome me, don't they?
column3: 这地方在对我说话。开阔的结构,太阳和树木:它们在欢迎我,不是吗?

column2: I can see my mind resting here, and the environment will dispel any quips of boredom, of that I am sure.
column3: 我能看见我的心智在此栖息,这里的环境定能驱散一切无聊的念头,对此我深信不疑。

column2: I will miss the companionship, but I know that you have to continue with your journey now.
column3: 我会想念这份陪伴的,但我知道你现在必须继续你的旅程。

column2: I feel a sense of dread in this place, dear companion.
column3: 亲爱的同伴,这地方让我心生畏惧。

column2: A disturbing force at the fringes of my mind, compelling me to dwell here.
column3: 我脑海边缘有一股不安的力量,引诱我留在这里。

column2: It is a form of unrest, but a fulfilling one, and I long for it.
column3: 那是一种躁动,却也是一种充实,我渴望它。

column2: Will this be the place where I will stay, live and abide?
column3: 这里会是我停留、生活、长居的地方吗?

column2: A dread hangs over me, but I see now that this is where I am supposed to be.
column3: 我头顶笼罩着恐惧,但现在我明白,这就是我注定停留之地。

column2: Life is full of challenges, isn't it?
column3: 人生充满了挑战,不是吗?

column2: And it is right that we don't flee them, dear companion.
column3: 而我们不应逃避它们,亲爱的同伴。

column2: I often think about the quest we took part in together, dear companion.
column3: 我常常想起我们一起参与的任务,亲爱的同伴。

column2: But I am glad now that we have found a site or rest.
column3: 但我如今很高兴,我们找到了一处歇息之地。

column2: Dear companion, it looks like we have two paths ahead of us.
column3: 亲爱的同伴,看来我们面前有两条路。

column2: The path on the right will lead us to a quiet place. Some forlorn site where the heart may rest in eternity.
column3: 右边的路会通向一个安静的地方。一处荒凉的所在,心可以在那里永远休息。

column2: And I can feel my heart yearning for it.
column3: 我能感到我的心渴望着它。

column2: A presence, an "unknowing", an oscillating morsel of unquietness, and it beckons us towards the left.
column3: 一种存在,一种"未知",一缕摇摆不定的不安,它在召唤我们向左走。

column2: Oh, I fear for my soul, looking at that dark path ahead. Yet at the same time there's a curious spirit in me, longing to explore it.
column3: 哦,看着前方那条黑暗的路,我为我的灵魂担忧。但与此同时,我心中又有好奇的精神,渴望去探索。

column2: Go forward, companion, and I will follow.
column3: 向前走吧,同伴,我会跟着。

column2: This place fills me with a dark foreboding.
column3: 这地方让我心中充满不祥的预感。

column2: Ohhh, look at this peaceful and friendly place.
column3: 哦哦,看看这和平友善的地方。

column2: We are at a crossroads. Let us contemplate our journey.
column3: 我们到了岔路口。让我们静思一下这段旅程。

column2: Hahaha. Look at you. Wearing clothes, so serious and all.
column3: 哈哈哈。瞧瞧你。穿着衣服,一本正经的。

column2: Here, look at my dancing skills...
It's how I celebrate the sun.
column3: 这是我庆祝太阳的方式。

column2: Maybe you're interested in a big, meaty friend?
column3: 也许你会对一个又大又多肉的朋友感兴趣?

column2: Ohhh. You mean that big flesh monster in that temple over there?
column3: 哦哦。你是说那边神庙里的那个大血肉怪物?

column2: Nah. Not interested in any relationship with it.
column3: 不。我对和它处关系没兴趣。

column2: I mean... clothes are very practical.

column3: 现在请让我一个人待着。

column2: Do you need help with anything?
Nah. I don't need any help.

column3: 哦,好呀。一个同路的旅人。

column2: People over here are a bit weird though.
column3: 不过这一带的人有点怪。

column2: I was looking for some food, but they only serve raw meat. Blergh.
column3: 我本来在找吃的,但他们只供应生肉。呕呃。

column2: Back to eating plants and dirt, I guess.
column3: 看来只能回去吃植物和土了。

column2: Hey, welcome to my humble abode.
I thought this place looked nice.
column3: 我觉得这地方看着不错。
也许我会开始布置一下。

column2: Hey, I found somebody for you.
I heard that you've been really sad recently.
column3: 我听说你最近哭得很伤心。

column2: Let me help you forget all of that.
What do you mean? I don't want to forget Millja...
column3: 你什么意思?我不想忘记米尔娅……

column2: But maybe you just need somebody to take care of.
column3: 但也许你只是需要个能照顾的对象。

column2: My friend, your next drink is on me.
column3: 我的朋友,你的下一杯酒我请。

column2: Shank you. Your a gooood one.
Heard you've been crying for a week now.
column3: 听说你已经哭了一个星期了。

column2: Please, tell me a bit about Millja.
column3: 拜托,跟我说说米尔娅吧。

column2: Oh... She wash de cutesht liddle wormy out here.
column3: 哦……她是外面最可——爱的小蠕虫。

column2: An when she wash hungry... I'd jus...
I'd puke... and she ate it.
And she showed me her beautiful littl teethies.
column3: 然后她会给我看她漂亮的小牙牙。

column2: But then... you kno... she's a curious one.
column3: 可是后来……你知道……她好奇心重。

column2: An she went cho she turret.
An hen... she... she... never came back...
You know yourself that you can't go on like this, right?
column3: 你自己也清楚,不能再这样下去了,对吧?

column2: You know what? Go for it.
Fuck no. The guards will kill you.
column3: 千万别。守卫会杀了你的。

column2: But then... what should I do?
You want me to replashe Millja?
But there'sh noone else out there like her.
column3: 可是外面再也没有像她一样的了。
米尔娅是那么*嗝*独一无二。

column2: An you jus wand me to forget? To take another one?
column3: 你就这么想让我忘记?让我再养一条?

column2: Your no better than the turret that shot her.
column3: 你跟打死她的那座炮塔一样坏。

column2: I don't really have an answer.
I've only known you for a couple of minutes, you know.
column3: 我认识你才几分钟,你知道吧。

column2: It's not like I'd know what would help you get over it.
column3: 我并不知道什么能帮你走出来。

column2: Do things that make you happy. Keep busy. Make your head free.
column3: 做点让自己开心的事。让自己忙起来。放空脑袋。

column2: Maybe you'll find someone out there, to fill a bit of that gap Millja left.
column3: 也许你会在外面遇到谁,填补一点米尔娅留下的空缺。

column2: I heard your story from the guards.
column3: 我从守卫那听说了你的事。

column2: I think I can help you.
How? Millja ish gone. An nothin' willl bring her back.
column3: 怎么帮?米尔娅已经没了。什——么都换不回她。

column2: I should do this more often.
Oh, and since you helped me so much...
column3: 哦,既然你帮了我这么多……

column2: I wont touch the booze again... at least for a couple of days.
column3: 我不会再碰酒了……至少这几天不会。

column2: I'm sure Millja is showing her smile to the Titans now.
column3: 我确信米尔娅现在正对着泰坦们微笑呢。

column2: Are you happy to see me, or do you have a fleshworm in your pants?
column3: 你见到我是开心呢,还是裤子里藏了条血肉蠕虫?

column2: Do you still feel sad about Millja?

column3: 我们正沉浸在这氛围里呢。

column2: Sometimes I wonder: Am I always right, or are the others always wrong?
column3: 有时我在想:到底总是我对,还是别人总是错?

column2: Do you ever wonder where the Flesh Titans come from?
column3: 你想过血肉泰坦是从哪来的吗?

column2: Do not listen to the Historian.
This place is sacred. Watch your fucking language.
column3: 这地方是神圣的。管好你他妈的嘴。

column2: We are like one big, fleshy family.
column3: 我们就像一个血肉相连的大家庭。

column2: I recently met a follower of the Machines. Such a moron.
column3: 我最近遇到了一个机器的追随者。真是个白痴。

column2: You anger one of us, you anger all of us.
column3: 你惹了我们中的一个,就是惹了我们全体。

column2: The Flesh Titans are like our brothers and sisters. And fathers and mothers. And masters.
column3: 血肉泰坦就像我们的兄弟姐妹。是我们的父与母。也是我们的主人。

column2: The High Priest is a wise man.
Many people come here to talk to the High Priest.
column3: 很多人来这里找大祭司谈话。

column2: The Titans bless you, my child.
Who are you, that you don't know of them?
column3: 你是谁,竟然不知道他们?

column2: But if the Titans gave me this challenge, I will see it through.
column3: 但如果这是泰坦给我的考验,我会坚持到底。

column2: You must be blessed by them, even if you do not know.
column3: 你一定是被他们保佑着,哪怕你自己不知道。

column2: Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
But you are not yet abandoned.
Let me help you find back to the flock.
column3: 让我帮你找到回归羊群的路。

column2: But if the Titans gave me this challenge, I will see it through.
column3: 但如果这是泰坦给我的考验,我会坚持到底。

column2: At least you have the humility to see that.
Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.

column3: 泰坦?就像那个血肉海妖?

column2: You have met one of them?

column3: 我看到了一颗谦卑的灵魂。

column2: Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
You do not appear to be very devout.

column3: 我看到了一颗谦卑的灵魂。

column2: You would do well to show more respect to the Titans.
column3: 你最好对泰坦表现出更多敬意。

column2: But you don't look like a Titan.
The Titans are the proof of life to be.
column3: 泰坦是未来生命的证明。

column2: Where they walk, the soil is blessed.
column3: 他们走过的地方,土壤受到祝福。

column2: And gives us our daily meat.
column3: 并赐予我们每日的肉食。

column2: Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
The Titan's heart has been stolen, and its guarding priest has been killed.
column3: 泰坦的心脏被偷走了,守护它的祭司也被杀了。

column2: Until this situation is resolved, I am in no state to continue with you.
column3: 在这件事解决之前,我没有状态与你同行。

column2: Maybe this is the quest the Titans intended for you from the very beginning.
column3: 也许这正是泰坦从一开始就为你安排的任务。

column2: I'd send you out to retrieve the heart.
column3: 我会派你去找回那颗心脏。

column2: But it is too large, even for one of your stature.
column3: 但它太大了,就算是你的身板也拿不动。

column2: Inside its heart you shall find the seedling of a Titan.
column3: 在它心中,你会找到一粒泰坦之种。

column2: Not its child, but its source.
column3: 那不是它的孩子,而是它的源头。

column2: Bring me this, and it shall grow back to former glory.
column3: 把它带给我,它就会重归昔日的荣光。

column2: Take this. It will help you.
And where should I look for that heart?
You should try the prison of the Godhunters, north of here.
column3: 你应该试试北边的猎神者监狱。

column2: But be careful. It is not without danger to enter.
column3: 但小心。进去可不是没有危险的。

column2: Even after proving yourself to the Titans already.
column3: 就算你已经向泰坦证明了自己。

column2: You are indeed blessed by the Titans.
column3: 你确实受到泰坦的保佑。

column2: They must have sent you, knowing this would happen.
column3: 他们一定是派你来的,早就知道会发生这种事。

column2: We checked out your report, and it sadly appears to be true.
column3: 我们核实了你的报告,很遗憾,看来是真的。

column2: Almost. Something quite worrying has come up.
column3: 差不多。只是出了件相当令人担忧的事。

column2: And it's keeping us very occupied.
And it's as we were told.
The Priest of the Heart was killed and dismembered.
column3: 心灵祭司被杀,还被肢解了。

column2: He managed to crawl away a bit. But it was too late.
column3: 他挣扎着爬远了一点。但太迟了。

column2: You'll have to wait until this mess is sorted out.
column3: 你只能等这团乱麻理清之后了。

column2: The Priest of the Heart was killed in front of the pedestal.
column3: 心灵祭司是在基座前被杀害的。

column2: Whoever did this also took his belongings.
column3: 凶手还拿走了他的随身物品。

column2: But it doesn't look like the Godhunters did it.
column3: 但看起来不像是猎神者干的。

column2: No. They would have at least made a show of his body.
column3: 不。他们至少会炫耀尸体。

column2: This was much more straight forward.
column3: 这次的手法要干脆得多。

column2: Without the priest to guard it, the Godhunters must have used the moment to snatch it.
column3: 没有祭司看守,猎神者一定是趁乱下手抢走的。

column2: Almost. We are still inquiring about the priest of the heart.
column3: 差不多。我们还在调查心灵祭司的事。

column2: I'm sorry, but the Titan's Heart has been stolen.
column3: 我很抱歉,泰坦之心已经被偷走了。

column2: I don't even know where to start.
Here, take this. It might aid you.
column3: 给,拿着这个。也许能帮上忙。

column2: It will give you entrance to the Godhunters prison.
column3: 它能让你进入猎神者监狱。

column2: Be careful. It is a dangerous place.
column3: 小心。那是个危险的地方。

column2: I wished to give you the key to the Godhunters prison.
column3: 我本想给你猎神者监狱的钥匙。

column2: But it appears to have left my possession.
column3: 但它似乎已不在我身上。

column2: It must be that the Titans are giving you one more challenge to overcome.
column3: 这一定是泰坦要给你多设一道考验。

column2: What am I supposed to do?
I gave you the key to the prison of the Godhunters.
column3: 我把猎神者监狱的钥匙给过你。

column2: The prison of the Godhunters is too dangerous for me.
column3: 猎神者监狱对我来说太危险了。

column2: The Titans are watching over you.
I am sure of your success.
You must be a holy one, chosen by the Titans.
column3: 你一定是被泰坦选中的圣人。

column2: Please hand the seedling over to me.
We will return it to where it belongs.
column3: 我们会把它送回属于它的地方。

column2: It's great to see you, I need to talk to you.
column3: 见到你太好了,我有话要跟你说。

column2: You remember how I told you I could not share the secret of this place with you?
column3: 你记得我说过不能和你分享此地的秘密吗?

column2: Well, to my shame it turns out I acted foolishly.
column3: 唉,惭愧,结果是我干了蠢事。

column2: The key was in my other pocket, and I just forgot to check.
column3: 钥匙一直在我另一个口袋里,我只是忘了查。

column2: Here, take this, and see for yourself what this place once used to be.
column3: 拿着这个,亲眼看看这地方曾经的模样吧。

column2: Oh blessed one, I need to talk to you.
column3: 哦,受祝福的人,我有话要跟你说。

column2: Oh **forename**, I need to talk to you.
What would you like to talk about?
We stand within the holy ruins of New Delphi.
column3: 我们站在新德尔斐的神圣遗迹之中。

column2: A place so old even the Historian, down there in his hut, is struggling to fathom them.
column3: 此地如此古老,就连下面小屋里的历史学家都难以参透。

column2: Even then, the only history which matters is that of the Sleeper.
column3: 但即便如此,唯一重要的历史只有沉睡者的历史。

column2: He chose this as his resting place.
column3: 他选择了这里作为长眠之地。

column2: So we gather around him, and pray to him.
column3: 于是我们聚在他的周围,向他祈祷。

column2: Is there something else you would like to hear about?
I am the High Priest of New Delphi.
column3: 我是新德尔斐的大祭司。

column2: I dispense the will of the Titans.
And serve as a connection between them and all other people.
column3: 并担任泰坦与所有其他人之间的桥梁。

column2: As such I have discarded my own identity.
column3: 因此,我早已舍弃了自己的身份。

column2: All I am now is a vessel for the masters.
column3: 如今我只是一具承载主人们的容器。

column2: Apparently you're hiding something about this place.
column3: 显然,关于这个地方你藏着什么。

column2: Tell me the secret of New Delphi.
column3: 告诉我新德尔斐的秘密。

column2: I heard something about becoming a pilgrim?
column3: 我听说成为朝圣者什么的?

column2: You wish to prove your devotion to the Masters, don't you?
column3: 你想向主人们证明你的虔诚,对吧?

column2: The priest at Titans Heart has been killed.
column3: 泰坦之心的祭司被杀了。

column2: What's the secret you didn't want to tell me before?
column3: 你之前不肯告诉我的秘密是什么?

column2: Have I proven my worth now?
column3: 我现在证明自己的价值了吗?

column2: Go and pray to the sleeper.
What was I supposed to do again?
column3: 你要我做的事是什么来着?

column2: The final step on your path to become a true believer.
column3: 那是你成为真正信徒之路的最后一步。

column2: Go and pray to the sleeper.
You have more than proven yourself.
column3: 你已经充分证明了自己。

column2: Take this, and be safe in the knowledge, that the Titans love you as much as you love them.
column3: 拿着这个,并安心记住:泰坦爱你,一如你爱他们。

column2: What a pleasure to see you again, **forename**.
Some time ago we found the body of a Titan.
column3: 不久前,我们发现了一头泰坦的遗体。

column2: We took it apart and enshrined the parts all over.
column3: 我们将它分解,把各部分供奉在各处。

column2: So people everywhere could see the wonders of the Titans in their glory.
column3: 好让各地的人们都能见证泰坦荣耀的奇观。

column2: Go on a pilgrimage and meet the guardians to the shrines of the Head, the Guts and the Heart.
column3: 去朝圣吧,去见颅之神龛、肠之神龛与心之神龛的守护者。

column2: Prove yourself to them, and they will give you a sigil of approval.
column3: 向他们证明自己,他们会给你一枚认可印记。

column2: Are you ready for this task?
column3: 你准备好接受这个任务了吗?

column2: I knew this would be your answer.
column3: 我就知道这是你的回答。

column2: Talk to me again when you wish to prove your devotion.
column3: 等你愿意证明虔诚的时候再来找我。

column2: The first shrine, the Titans Head, is in the mountains south of here.
column3: 第一座神龛,泰坦之颅,在这南边的山里。

column2: You must be blessed by the Titans.
column3: 你一定是被泰坦保佑了。

column2: Though this does come as a surprise.
I need to prepare some things.
Let us talk about this again next time you come to New Delphi.
column3: 等你下次来新德尔斐我们再谈。

column2: You have yet to receive the first sigil, at Titan's Head.
column3: 你还没有获得第一枚印记,在泰坦之颅。

column2: You will receive the second sigil at Titans Guts, southeast of here.
column3: 第二枚印记要在泰坦之肠获得,在这东南边。

column2: The last sigil can be gotten at Titans Heart.
column3: 最后一枚印记可以在泰坦之心拿到。

column2: Just go eastwards from here to find it.
column3: 从这里往东走就能找到。

column2: I can feel the Titans growing inside you.
column3: 我能感觉到泰坦在你体内生长。

column2: But before we continue, I need to prepare some things.
column3: 但在继续之前,我需要准备一些东西。

column2: Let's talk again next time you visit New Delphi.
column3: 等你下次来新德尔斐我们再谈。

column2: He was mutilated and there was blood all over the place.
column3: 他被肢解了,血溅得到处都是。

column2: He is dead now, but before he died he mentioned something about the Godhunters.
column3: 他已经死了,但临死前提到了猎神者。

column2: Go to Titans Heart and check the situation there!
column3: 去泰坦之心查看那边的情况!

column2: There goes my cozy guard job.
column3: 我这份清闲的守卫工作泡汤了。

column2: Thank you very much for telling us about that.
column3: 非常感谢你告诉我们这件事。
那个历史学家又多嘴了?

column2: I told him to guard his mouth.
column3: 我警告过他管好自己的嘴。

column2: There is good reason why we tell the story this way.
column3: 我们这样讲述这段历史是有充分理由的。

column2: Alright. You don't have to tell me.
Ah, it's good to see you're reasonable.
I see that it is not worth arguing this with you.
But you will have to prove your devotion to the Titans beforehand.
column3: 但你得先证明你对泰坦的虔诚。

column2: It's probably not worth it anyway.
I knew this would be your answer.
column3: 我就知道这是你的回答。

column2: Talk to me again when you wish to prove your devotion.
column3: 等你愿意证明虔诚的时候再来找我。

column2: What do I need to do?
Complete the final steps of a pilgrims trial, prove your devotion, and we may talk about this again.
column3: 完成朝圣考验的最后几步,证明你的虔诚,我们或许可以再谈。

column2: Complete your pilgrimage, and we may talk about this again.
column3: 完成你的朝圣,我们或许可以再谈这件事。

column2: But I am preoccupied with the situation around the Titans Heart.
column3: 但我正忙着处理泰坦之心的局势。

column2: Please ask again once this is over.
But you will have to finish proving your devotion to the Titans beforehand.
column3: 但你得先完成对泰坦虔诚的证明。

column2: Which, of course, can only happen once I finished my preparations for the final step.
column3: 而这,当然,只能等我为最后一步做好准备之后。

column2: So please stay patient until then.
column3: 所以在那之前请保持耐心。

column2: You will have to prove your devotion before I will say anything.
column3: 你得先证明虔诚,我才会开口。

column2: Once we are done with the last step of you becoming a true believer, ask me again.
column3: 等你完成成为真正信徒的最后一步之后,再来问我。

column2: You will have to prove your devotion before I will say anything.
column3: 你得先证明虔诚,我才会开口。

column2: I apologize, but we are still in worry with what happened to the Heart of the Titan.
column3: 很抱歉,我们仍在为泰坦之心的变故忧心。

column2: I cannot entertain this matter right now.
So it's finally come to this.
I wish I didn't have to, but you have proven yourself more than worthy.
column3: 我本不愿如此,但你已经证明自己绰绰有余。

column2: No matter how much I wished this to remain a secret.
column3: 无论我多么希望这仍是一个秘密。

column2: I was burdened with the key to the gate down below.
column3: 我曾背负着下方那扇门的钥匙。

column2: Behind which lie the remnants of this place's past.
column3: 门后是这个地方往昔的残迹。

column2: But the Titans have heard my prayers and lifted this weight from me.
column3: 但泰坦听到了我的祈祷,卸下了我这副重担。

column2: And with it my ability to present you the secret.
column3: 随之而去的,还有我向你揭示秘密的能力。

column2: And with it my ability to present you the answer.
column3: 随之而去的,还有我向你揭示答案的能力。

column2: Here, take this and walk through the gate down there.
column3: 给,拿着这个,穿过下面那扇门。

column2: Experience yourself what this place used to be.
column3: 亲身感受这地方曾经是什么吧。

column2: Oh, how I wish you wouldn't ask.
So it's finally come to this.
I hoped that by sending you away I wouldn't have to tell you.
column3: 我曾希望把你打发走,就不用告诉你了。

column2: You're still interested in talking with me?
Why won't the others talk to you?
column3: 其他人为什么不跟你说话?

column2: The others, they're more interested in the rites and stuff.
column3: 其他人,他们更关心那些仪式什么的。

column2: Not the stories our community is actually built upon.
column3: 而不是我们社群真正赖以建立的故事。
大概我让他们觉得无聊了吧。

column2: Except for the High Priest, maybe.
Even though we don't agree on many things, he was always kind to me.
column3: 虽然我们在很多事上意见不合,但他一直对我很好。

column2: What was that about the true story of this place?
column3: 这个地方真实历史是怎么回事?

column2: The High Priest told me not to talk about this.
This is just an ancient place that is older than the Bleeding.
column3: 这里只是一个比大流血还古老的遗迹。

column2: And the Sleeper chose one of the pools here as his resting place.
column3: 沉睡者选中了这里的一处水池作为他的长眠之地。

column2: So stop asking me about this.
It is said that he used to wander around the deserts in this area.
column3: 据说他曾在这一带的沙漠中游荡。

column2: But one day he decided to take his rest in the pools.
column3: 但有一天他决定在池水中休眠。

column2: So New Delphi became a holy place.
column3: 于是新德尔斐成了圣地。

column2: And the pilgrims come here to pray to him.
column3: 朝圣者来这里向他祈祷。

column2: At least that's the official story.
column3: 至少官方的说法是这样。
文献里讲的却是另一回事。

column2: Oh, wait. The High Priest told me not to talk about that.
column3: 哦,等等。大祭司叫我别谈这个。

column2: It happened a long time ago.
This planet used to be completely normal.
column3: 这颗星球曾经完全正常。

column2: But then it started to rain blood and flesh.
column3: 但后来开始下血雨,下血肉。

column2: For a long time. Maybe years even.
There aren't many records from that time.
And soon after, the Titans started appearing.
column3: 不久之后,泰坦开始出现。

column2: They started appearing after the Bleeding.
column3: 他们在大流血之后开始出现。

column2: Where they go, the flesh grows.
column3: 他们走到哪里,血肉就在哪里生长。

column2: And with the flesh comes life.
column3: 而血肉所至,生命随之而来。

column2: At least that's what we believe.
But their history is very murky.
column3: 但他们的历史非常模糊。

column2: So, what is the history of this place?
column3: 那么,这个地方的历史是什么?

column2: These are the ruins of New Delphi.
column3: 这些是新德尔斐的遗迹。

column2: This place was old even before the Bleeding.
column3: 这地方在大流血之前就已古老。

column2: The pools are filled with mysterious liquids.
column3: 水池里注满神秘的液体。

column2: And the Sleeper chose one of them as his resting place.
column3: 沉睡者选中了其中一个作为他的长眠之地。

column2: I study the history of places connected to the Flesh Titans.
column3: 我研究与血肉泰坦相关的地点的历史。

column2: No one ever talks to me.
As we consume the flesh, the flesh will consume us.
column3: 我们食用血肉,血肉也将食用我们。

column2: These ruins were already ancient when the bleeding happened.
column3: 大流血发生时,这些遗迹就已经很古老了。

column2: I travelled for five days, just to see the sleeper.
column3: 我走了五天,就为了看一眼沉睡者。

column2: They say New Delphi is hiding a secret.
column3: 他们说新德尔斐藏着一个秘密。

column2: Have you not met the sleeper?
I did not expect it to be so hot here.
I travelled from far away, and still no hookup.
column3: 我从远方赶来,还是没搭上关系。

column2: May the wounds close in peace.
May the Titans offer you peace.
Will you let the Titans bless you?
column3: 你可愿意接受泰坦的祝福?

column2: That Titan over there doesn't seem very active.
column3: 那边那头泰坦好像不太活跃。

column2: Do not let the pilgrims waver in their belief.
column3: 不要让朝圣者的信仰动摇。

column2: Take the Historian as your example, quietly staying down in his hut.
column3: 学学那个历史学家,安安静静待在他的小屋里。

column2: This place is blessed by the sleeper, and nobody's words may defile it.
column3: 此地受沉睡者祝福,任何人的言语都不得玷污。

column2: Such is the glory of the Titans.
What's with the big guy in the pool?
column3: 水池里那个大家伙是怎么回事?

column2: Do not speak ill of the sleeper.
He is a Titan who wandered these lands and decided to take his rest, right here.
column3: 他曾是一位在这片土地上漫游的泰坦,决定就在此地休眠。

column2: He has blessed us with his presence.
column3: 他莅临于此,是我们的福分。

column2: And we share his blessings with the rest of all the people.
column3: 而我们与世间众人共享他的祝福。

column2: Even one as you may receive them.
The souls, once lost, who have found their way to truth.
column3: 曾经迷失,而后寻得真理之路的灵魂。

column2: They come from far and wide to show their devotion as pilgrims.
column3: 他们从四面八方赶来,以朝圣表明虔诚。

column2: They are here to receive the blessing of the Titans.
column3: 他们来此领受泰坦的祝福。

column2: The strongest among them have even decided to stay, and put their entire being in front of the masters.
column3: 其中最坚定的人甚至决定留下,把整个生命都奉献在主人面前。

column2: You too could be one of them.
column3: 你也可以成为他们中的一员。

column2: But you have far surpassed them in both strength and devotion already.
column3: 不过你在力量与虔诚上都早已远超他们。

column2: Oh you poor soul, don't you know of them?
column3: 哦,可怜的灵魂,你不知道他们吗?

column2: They saw our sinful ways, and came to lead us to bliss.
column3: 他们看到我们罪恶的行径,前来引领我们走向极乐。

column2: Where they go, the flesh grows.
column3: 他们走到哪里,血肉便在哪里生长。

column2: And where the flesh grows, life blooms.
column3: 血肉生长之处,生命绽放。

column2: Praise them, my child, for they still have hope for you.
column3: 赞美他们吧,我的孩子,因为他们对你仍怀有希望。

column2: Come, and join us in praise.
You have saved one's seedling after all.
column3: 毕竟你拯救过一位的种子。

column2: They are the ones who have sent you to help us.
column3: 正是他们派你来帮助我们的。

column2: Oh, what an oddity do my eyes see.
column3: 哦,我的眼睛看到了多么奇怪的景象。

column2: A child, that has not yet joined the flock.
column3: 一个还未加入羊群的孩子。

column2: Let the grace of the Titans bless you, like it blesses all the others.
column3: 让泰坦的恩典祝福你,如同祝福所有其他人。

column2: I have heard of your heroic tale.
column3: 你的英雄事迹我有所耳闻。

column2: The Titans must have big plans for you.
column3: 泰坦对你必有宏大的安排。

column2: I have a question regarding the celibacy.
column3: 我有个关于独身的问题。

column2: What do you mean? We have no rules enforcing celibacy.
column3: 什么意思?我们没有强制独身的规矩。

column2: WHAT? All this time I live in abstinence, and... no one ever told me?
column3: 什么?!我禁欲了这么久,而且……从来没人告诉过我?

column2: Alright. Gonna make the best of that now.
column3: 好吧。那我这就充分利用起来。

column2: Finally decided to come over, right? You were staring at me the whole time.
column3: 终于决定过来了,对吧?你一直盯着我看。

column2: Do you have some food that is not meat? Can I have it?
column3: 你有没有不是肉的食物?能给我吗?

column2: Did you read that passage about uniting the children?
column3: 你读过关于联合孩子们的那段经文吗?

column2: Do you know if that's us? The children, I mean.
column3: 你知道那说的是不是我们?我是说,孩子们。

column2: Do I look like I'm in charge? I have no idea really.
column3: 我看起来像管事的吗?我真不知道。

column2: It could literally mean children, right? Perhaps it's a hint that we should begin making some?
column3: 它字面上可以指孩子,对吧?也许这是暗示我们应该开始造一些?

column2: I'm not so sure about that.
Painful. But I don't want to complain too much.
More than painful. Fucking hell, really.
It's like someone decided to make this a hellhole for me, raining shit from...
column3: 就好像有人存心把这里变成我的地狱,往我头上淋屎……

column2: Ah, well, don't want to complain either.
So, how did they capture you?
column3: 那么,他们是怎么抓住你的?

column2: I was out to take a piss.
And they were hiding in the bush.
Let's say they weren't very happy with the situation.
column3: 怎么说呢,他们对那场面不太满意。

column2: But if I had one, I'd be missing her after all this time.
column3: 但如果有的话,过了这么久我也会想她的。

column2: How long have we been here for?
Wasn't it your turn to count the days?
column3: 不是轮到你数日子了吗?

column2: I have a question regarding the celibacy. Celibacy.
column3: 我有个关于独身的问题。独身。

column2: What do you mean? What? We have no rules enforcing celibacy. No rules.
column3: 什么意思?什么?我们没有强制独身的规矩。没有规矩。

column2: WHAT? WHAT? All this time I live in abstinence, and... no one ever told me? No one?
column3: 什么?!什么?!我禁欲了这么久,而且……从来没人告诉过我?没有人?

column2: Alright. Alright. Gonna make the best of that now. Best of that.
column3: 好吧。好吧。那我这就充分利用起来。充分利用。

column2: Finally decided to come over, right? Right? You were staring at me the whole time. At me.
column3: 终于决定过来了,对吧?对吧?你一直盯着我看。盯着我。

column2: Alright. Alright. See you later. See you.
I need to eat something. Need to eat.
Do you have some food that is not meat? Not meat? Can I have it? Can I
column3: 你有没有不是肉的食物?不是肉?能给我吗?能我——

column2: All Hail the Hierarch! The Hierarch!
Did you read that passage about uniting the children? Uniting?
column3: 你读过关于联合孩子们的那段经文吗?联合?

column2: Do you know if that's us? Us? The children, I mean. The children.
column3: 你知道那说的是不是我们?我们?我是说,孩子们。孩子们。

column2: Do I look like I'm in charge? Do I? I have no idea really. No idea.
column3: 我看起来像管事的吗?像吗?我真不知道。不知道。

column2: It could literally mean children, right? Right? Perhaps it's a hint that we should begin making some? Making some?
column3: 它字面上可以指孩子,对吧?对吧?也许这是暗示我们应该开始造一些?造一些?

column2: I'm not so sure about that. Not sure.
Hey. Hey. How is it today? How?
Painful. Painful. But I don't want to complain too much. Too much.
column3: 疼。疼。但我不想抱怨太多。太多。

column2: More than painful. More. Fucking hell, really. Really.
column3: 比疼还糟。还糟。真是他妈的。真的。

column2: It's like someone decided to make this a hellhole for me. A hellhole. Raining shit from... Raining...
column3: 就好像有人存心把这里变成我的地狱。地狱。往我头上淋屎……淋……

column2: Ah, well, don't want to complain either. Don't want to.
column3: 啊,算了,我也不想抱怨。不想。

column2: Hmmh. This flesh blocks some kind of entrance.
column3: 唔。这团血肉堵着某个入口。

column2: The flesh reacts to your presence.
column3: 血肉对你的存在做出了反应。

column2: Lines and symbols of some kind.
Doesn't make much sense to me though.
I should probably learn how to read these.
column3: 我也许该学学怎么读这些。

column2: There's got to be someone out there who knows his way around blueprints and tools.
column3: 外面肯定有懂图纸和工具的人。

column2: The merchant in Tauris told me something about a guy who went west, if I remember correctly.
column3: 如果我没记错,陶里斯的商人提过一个往西边去的人。

column2: Maybe that book I found can help.
column3: 也许我找到的那本书能帮上忙。

column2: Perhaps I could reuse the materials for something else.
column3: 也许我可以把这些材料挪作他用。

column2: Would be useful to learn how to break this apart without destroying the materials.
column3: 要学会不破坏材料就把这东西拆开,会很有用。

column2: I'll have to ponder a bit more. Don't mind me, just staring at eternity, haha.
column3: 我还得再琢磨琢磨。别管我,只是在盯着永恒看,哈哈。

column2: I don't really know where we are. I stumbled through this world and I found this place. Right here.
column3: 我不知道我们在哪。我跌跌撞撞穿过这个世界,然后发现了这个地方。就在这里。

column2: I'm thinking: Is this everything here? Is this the end we're staring at? Or eternity? Is this endless?
column3: 我在想:这里就是全部吗?这就是我们凝视的尽头吗?还是永恒?这里是无穷的吗?

column2: I know we're living in a fractured world, all those nooks and corners, but here, this corner here, this spot, is it the very end of the world, or are we right in the middle of things?
column3: 我知道我们活在一个破碎的世界里,有那么多角落和缝隙。但这里,这个角落,这个地方,是世界的尽头,还是我们正处在万物的中央?

column2: Hmmh. Thank you for your perspective.
We are on a journey. And that journey hasn't ended yet.
column3: 我们在旅途之中。而旅程尚未结束。

column2: There will be more ahead. More corners.
column3: 前面还会有更多。更多的角落。

column2: Therefore, we're not at the end.
Yes. It doesn't go much further here. We're at one end of the world.
column3: 是的。这里走不了多远了。我们在世界的一端。

column2: This looks like I could get down here if I had something that would help me climb up again, too.
column3: 看起来我可以下到这来——如果我也有什么能帮我再爬上去的话。

column2: Can you show me one of the rules of the Oracle?
column3: 你能给我看一条先知的规则吗?

column2: Wisdom. Flesh. Not flesh. All not flesh.
column3: 智慧。血肉。非血肉。全非血肉。

column2: Ok. That's a lot. Flesh and not flesh.
column3: 好。信息量很大。血肉与非血肉。
为什么是血肉和非血肉?

column2: Tread lightly here, stranger. I'll kill you if you try to cross me.
column3: 在这儿放轻脚步,陌生人。你要是敢跟我过不去,我就杀了你。

column2: I am the strongest here, actually.
column3: 其实我才是这里最强的。

column2: Hahaha. You don't say! You want a chance to prove it?
column3: 哈哈哈。你不是来真的吧!想要个证明的机会吗?

column2: Hah! I knew you would back off.
Ohhh, this is gonna be glorious!
I don't want to fight you.
That's what he said about you, too.
WHAT?! That pompous flesh scribe? I can easily stomp that guy into the ground.
column3: 什么?!那个浮夸的血肉书记员?我能轻松把他踩进地里。

column2: I don't know. He looked pretty strong.
column3: 我不知道。他看着挺壮的。

column2: Pah! I'm gonna show you who's the strongest.
column3: 呸!我会让你看看谁才是最强的。

column2: You are ready to fight for your place here?
column3: 你准备好为你的地盘而战了吗?

column2: Yes. This place here. I don't know what this place is, but it's a place. And I can fight for it.
column3: 是的。这地方。我不知道这是什么地方,但它是个地方。我可以为它而战。

column2: Fighting is good. Keeps me strong.
column3: 战斗是好事。让我保持强壮。

column2: This is the survival of the strongest. Are you here to challenge me?
column3: 这是强者的生存法则。你是来挑战我的吗?

column2: It's best if you leave now if you don't want to get your head bashed in. I am ready to fight for my place here.
column3: 你最好现在就走,免得脑袋开花。我已经准备好为我的地盘而战了。

column2: Stop it right there, you unholy Godhunter!
column3: 站住,你这个邪恶的猎神者!

column2: I won't let you have the Titans Guts!
column3: 我不会让你拿到泰坦之肠的!

column2: Nice try, but I'm not falling for that.
I've got rations for months to come.
column3: 我的口粮还够吃几个月呢。
噁。那玩意简直不能算食物。

column2: Give me the details of that recording.

column3: 有一条栖居者死亡的录像可用。

column2: Error. Recording has been processed. No further data recorders available.
column3: 错误。录像已被处理过。没有更多数据记录器可用。

column2: Hey, what was that thing you needed?
column3: 嘿,你需要的是什么来着?

column2: Hey, what did you want me to do?
What was I supposed to do again?
Well. I know a thing or two about fixing things and breaking things.
column3: 嗯。修东西和拆东西,我还懂一两手。

column2: Actually had a handy guide about some basics. But sold it to a guy that was heading west.
column3: 其实有过一本基础入门指南。但卖给一个往西走的人了。

column2: Oh. It is. ... What happened to the guy?

column3: 发现他的时候已经死了。

column2: Ah, Ok. I guess it's yours now. You should read it.
column3: 啊,好。那现在归你了。你应该读读它。

column2: Alright. I can give you another face. Or retrain your brain patterns.
column3: 好吧。我可以给你换一张脸。或者重塑你的脑波模式。

column2: Are you selling any special equipment?
Well, I'm selling some implants and bits.
column3: 嗯,我卖一些植入体和小零件。

column2: You can take a look at them in my shop.
column3: 你可以在我的店里看看。

column2: I was looking for something more.... punchy.
column3: 我在找更……有冲击力的东西。

column2: Punchy? You might wanna have a look at this machine over there.
column3: 有冲击力?那你也许该看看旁边那台机器。

column2: Stop nagging me about this. I gave you my flyer already.
column3: 别再烦我了。传单我已经给过你了。

column2: Ok stranger, if you are really looking for the hot stuff, take a look at this.
column3: 好啦陌生人,如果你真在找火热的好货,看看这个。

column2: What is this machine next to you?
column3: 你旁边这台机器是什么?

column2: It's a Machine Merchant. Fine thing, right? The Collectors installed it.
column3: 是台机器商人。好东西,对吧?收藏者装的。

column2: People have tried. But the machine cannot be destroyed, it seems.
column3: 有人试过。但这机器好像毁不掉。

column2: I would bet the machine also records any attempts.
column3: 我打赌它还会记录所有试图攻击的行为。

column2: Don't try anything stupid. I wouldn't want to get on the bad side of the Collectors, haha.
column3: 别耍花样。我可不想惹恼收藏者,哈哈。

column2: Bunch of traders. Looking for rare scrap, but interested in all kind of goods, really.
column3: 一群商人。找稀有废料,但其实什么货都感兴趣。

column2: Never heard of them? Where are you from?
column3: 没听说过他们?你从哪来的?
总之……还有别的想要的吗?

column2: Well. Aren't we all? Some of us have been here for a while, though.
column3: 嗯。我们不都是吗?不过有些人在这里待了很久了。

column2: Decades. The place itself has been for way longer.
column3: 几十年。这地方本身存在得还要久得多。

column2: Huh. It's been a while since someone came from there.
column3: 哈。好久没人从那边来了。

column2: But you do not hear any words.
column3: 但你没有听到任何话语。

column2: Well, I should better continue with my travels.
column3: 嗯,我最好继续我的旅行了。

column2: That title was easy to get, really. Played well to my personal strengths.
column3: 那头衔其实很容易得来。正好发挥了我的个人长处。

column2: Ah, subject, that's an easy ploy to detect.
column3: 啊,"臣民",这把戏一眼就能识破。

column2: You're trying to make me all fuzzy by talking about fornication, only to get into my bed and then brag a lifetime long how you humped mighty Queen Margas.
column3: 你想跟我谈交合让我神魂颠倒,好钻进我的被窝,然后一辈子吹嘘自己上了伟大的玛尔加斯女王。

column2: That won't do. Can't have sex with everyone who wanders by.
column3: 这可不行。不能路过一个就上一个。

column2: Oh, had lots of them. But they were all crushed by the royal libido.
column3: 哦,有过很多。但他们都被皇家的欲望碾碎了。

column2: Child, it's not proper to talk about the royal weight.
column3: 孩子,谈论皇家的体重可不合适。

column2: Ahh, another mortal seeking the attention of the queen.
column3: 啊啊,又一个渴望女王垂青的凡人。

column2: But I feel a little indisposed today.
Maybe the subject can return on another day.
column3: 也许臣民可以改日再来。

column2: Well then, I'm known to be generous. And this might even give us some entertainment.
column3: 好吧,我素来慷慨。而且这说不定还能给我们添点乐子。

column2: Ahem. Welcome, subject. What is its name and what does it want?
column3: 咳咳。欢迎,臣民。它叫什么名字,想要什么?

column2: **forename**. And I'm just curious who you are.
**forename**. Well, can't expect a more elaborate name of a mortal, right?
column3: **forename**。嗯,不能指望一个凡人有更讲究的名字了,对吧?

column2: I am the Enlightened Queen Margas, Guardian of the Netherrealm, Protector of Shebzu, Trinity Mistress of Fornication.
column3: 我是觉醒女王玛尔加斯,冥界守卫,谢布祖守护者,交合三重夫人。

column2: Somebody seems to be using this as a fireplace.
column3: 好像有人拿这个当壁炉用。

column2: I could cook some meat here.
Oh, wow. The Titans must have sent you. They heard my prayers.
column3: 哦,哇。一定是泰坦派你来的。他们听到了我的祈祷。

column2: By the Titans, this is marvellous.
column3: 泰坦在上,这真是太棒了。

column2: I'd give you a sigil for what you've done.
column3: 就凭这个我都想给你一枚印记。

column2: But somehow I don't have any right now.
column3: 但我现在身上一枚也没有。

column2: Those Godhunters must have stolen my stash.
column3: 肯定是猎神者偷走了我的存货。

column2: You can get another sigil from the priest at Titan's Heart, near the foot of the mountains to the north.
column3: 你可以从泰坦之心北边山脚的祭司那里再拿一枚印记。

column2: Please accept this. You've earned it, haha.
column3: 请收下这个。你应得的,哈哈。

column2: Oh, wow. The Titans must have sent you. They heard my prayers.
column3: 哦,哇。一定是泰坦派你来的。他们听到了我的祈祷。

column2: The shrine to the guts of a Flesh Titan.
column3: 供奉血肉泰坦之肠的神龛。

column2: If you wish to become a pilgrim of the Titans, please talk to the High Priest in New Delphi.
column3: 如果你想成为泰坦的朝圣者,请去新德尔斐找大祭司。

column2: It appears that the Titans have indeed blessed you.
column3: 看来泰坦确实保佑了你。

column2: Godhunters have been sneaking around a lot lately.
column3: 猎神者最近老是鬼鬼祟祟地出没。

column2: Faithless people, who have decided to conquer our gods.
column3: 背弃信仰的人,决意要征服我们的神。

column2: They are trying to kill the Titans.
You can get another sigil from the priest at Titan's Heart, near the foot of the mountains to the north.
column3: 你可以从泰坦之心北边山脚的祭司那里再拿一枚印记。

column2: I can feel the spiritual energy coming from you.
column3: 我能感觉到你身上散发出的灵性力量。

column2: If you have them all, you should go and talk to the High Priest in New Delphi.
column3: 如果你集齐了,就该去新德尔斐找大祭司谈谈。

column2: Where was that smell coming from?
I don't want any more of these rations.
column3: 我不想再吃这种口粮了。

If you wish to become a pilgrim of the Titans, please talk to the High Priest in New Delphi.
column3: 如果你想成为泰坦的朝圣者,请去新德尔斐找大祭司。

column2: You have proven the depth of your belief in the Titans to me.
column3: 你向我证明了你信仰泰坦的深度。

column2: Take this sigil as a sign of my approval, and go east, to the Titans Guts.
column3: 收下这枚印记,作为我认可的信物,然后往东去泰坦之肠。

column2: Though other gods are also acceptable.
column3: 不过其他神明也可以接受。

column2: I kill in its name only.
...and provides infinitive wisdom through his sheer existence.
column3: ……并以其存在本身赐予无穷智慧。

column2: ...and feeds me Fleshworms when I'm hungry.
column3: ……还会在我饿的时候喂我血肉蠕虫。

column2: ...that lazes around on a sunny day...
column3: ……那个在晴天懒洋洋晒太阳的……

column2: The High Priest has sent me.
You're supposed to give me a sigil?
A pilgrim on a quest for true devotion.
column3: 一位追寻真正虔诚的朝圣者。

column2: Yes, I do have a sigil for you.
column3: 是的,我确实有一枚印记给你。

column2: But you need to earn it.
I usually give out sigils to the pilgrims who prove their devotion to the Titans here.
column3: 我通常把印记发给在这里证明了对泰坦虔诚的朝圣者。

column2: But it appears I have run out of sigils.
column3: 但看来我的印记用完了。

column2: Forgive me, but there is nothing I can do for you now.
column3: 原谅我,但我现在帮不了你什么。

column2: You may have better luck visiting the priest at Titan's Guts.
column3: 你可以去泰坦之肠找那里的祭司,运气也许会好些。

column2: I wish you success on your pilgrimage.
The priest of the Titan's Guts east of here will have further information for you.
column3: 东边泰坦之肠的祭司会有更多信息给你。

column2: It appears that the Titans have indeed blessed you.
column3: 看来泰坦们确实降福于你了。

column2: Do you not see how I am suffering?
column3: 你没看见我有多痛苦吗?

column2: Are you here to gloat now? Or to torture me?
column3: 你是来炫耀的吗?还是来折磨我的?

column2: You look different. You're not one of them, right?
column3: 你看起来不太一样。你不是他们那伙的,对吧?

column2: The Titans must have sent you, to conclude my final deed.
column3: 一定是泰坦派你来的,来完成我最后一件事。

column2: Here, take this, and go to New Delphi.
column3: 来,拿着这个,去新德尔斐。

column2: Tell them the Godhunters have stolen the heart.
column3: 告诉他们,心被猎神者偷走了。

column2: Go now, and let me rest.
The shrine to a Titan's heart.
If you wish to become a pilgrim of the Titans, please talk to the High Priest in New Delphi.
column3: 如果你想成为泰坦的朝圣者,请去新德尔斐找大祭司。

column2: You can get as drunk as you want.
What's with the guy crying at the bar?
column3: 吧台那个哭的家伙是怎么回事?

column2: That's just Nard being overly emotional.
column3: 那只是纳德又多愁善感了。

column2: Used to have a pet fleshworm. Called it Ilja or something along that line.
column3: 他以前养了只宠物血肉蠕虫。叫什么米尔娅之类的。

column2: But last week it went too close to a turret.
column3: 但上周它凑炮塔凑得太近了。

column2: But since then he's been here. Crying.
column3: 但从那以后他就一直待在这儿。哭。

column2: I don't mind. As long as he pays.
I got so drunk yesterday, I blacked out.
column3: 我昨天喝得太醉,断片了。

column2: Or was that two days ago?
Here's a tip: Always stop before your last drink.
column3: 给你个忠告:永远在最后一杯之前停下。

column2: The last drink always brings you over the edge.
column3: 最后一杯总会让你越过界限。

column2: Stop just before that, and you're good.
column3: 在它之前停住,你就没事。

column2: You know how they say too much alcohol is bad for you?
column3: 你知道人们总说酒喝多了伤身吗?

column2: Then you maybe need a good puke.
column3: 那你可能需要痛快吐一场。

column2: Washes out all the bad stuff.
column3: 能把所有不好的东西都吐出去。

column2: No wait, there's three of you.
Look, I can still walk in a straight line.
I've been travelling for quite a while now.
column3: 我旅行已经有一阵子了。

column2: The Puke Bar is just the perfect rest stop.
column3: 呕吐酒吧就是最完美的歇脚点。
想知道我为什么喝醉吗?

column2: Your right, that's a waste of time.
column3: 你说得对,那是浪费时间。

column2: You got some booze to share?
If I'm not careful, I'm gonna end up sober soon.
column3: 再不小心点,我马上就要清醒了。

column2: It's been tasting so boring recently.
I don't know what they do to the meat they serve here.
column3: 我不知道他们对手上的肉做了什么。

column2: You, me, that room over there. What do you say?
column3: 你,我,那边的房间。怎么样?

column2: The bots told me something about being terminated.
column3: 机器人跟我说过什么终止处理之类的话。

column2: Just come with me. It's gonna be good.
column3: 跟我来就是了。会很舒服的。

column2: Here, take this. It's on me.
You, me, that room over there. What do you say?
column3: 你,我,那边的房间。怎么样?

column2: But you see that crying mess over at the bar?
column3: 不过你看到吧台那边那个哭哭啼啼的可怜虫了吗?

column2: How about you giving him some company?
No way. I wanna have some fun. And he doesn't look like fun.
column3: 没门。我想要点乐子。他看起来一点也不像乐子。

column2: Just look at him. How can you be so heartless?
column3: 你就看看他吧。你怎么能这么没心没肺?

column2: I'll take care of him. For now.
But you'll have to introduce us properly.
column3: 但你得正式给我们引荐一下。

column2: What would I need to give you to change your mind?
column3: 要给你什么你才肯改主意?

column2: What are you taking me for?
I just don't have it right now.
Then come back once you have enough.
Fuck off. I'm not that cheap.
I just don't have it right now.
Bartering me down, and not being ready to pay.
column3: 跟我讨价还价,结果又付不起钱。

column2: Do you know the guy crying at the bar?
column3: 你认识吧台那个哭鼻子的家伙吗?

column2: Nard? He's been going at it for a couple of weeks now.
column3: 纳德?他都哭了好几个星期了。

column2: Wish I could stomach as much as him.
column3: 真希望我的酒量有他一半好。

column2: Somebody called Millja, or something like that.
column3: 一个叫米尔娅的,还是什么类似的名字。
守卫们可能知道得更多。

column2: Leave us alone. We're having a moment.
column3: 别打扰我们。我们正浪漫着呢。

column2: Two people will fit on this, if they cuddle.
column3: 这张床能睡两个人,只要互相搂着点。

column2: Looks like somebody forgot to flush.
Looks like the Bar is hoarding some meat here.
column3: 看来酒吧在这儿囤了些肉。

column2: I guess people over here get hungry, too.
column3: 我猜这边的人也会饿嘛。

column2: This meat was infected by flesh maggots.
column3: 这些肉被血肉蛆感染过。

column2: These must be the flesh maggots Eldred mentioned.
column3: 这些应该就是埃尔德雷德提到的血肉蛆。

column2: Guess I could try getting that poison.
column3: 估计我可以试着弄点那种毒药。

column2: Spreading it all over the place.
Hello. Hope you're enjoying your stay at the Puke Bar.
column3: 你好。希望你在呕吐酒吧待得愉快。

column2: I didn't see you come up the stairs, so you must have snuck in.
column3: 我没看见你从楼梯上来,那你肯定是溜进来的。

column2: Don't go creeping around too much, okay?
column3: 别到处鬼鬼祟祟的,行吗?

column2: Hello and welcome to the Puke Bar!
column3: 你好,欢迎来到呕吐酒吧!

column2: Best drinks. Best meat. What else do you need?
column3: 最好的酒。最好的肉。你还需要什么?

column2: Be friendly, not annoying, and watch where you step.
column3: 友善点,别讨人嫌,走路看着点脚下。

column2: And, this is important, don't carry any weapons openly in there.
column3: 还有,这条很重要:在里面别明着带武器。

column2: Guys inside are tense. If they see a weapon in your hand, they will shoot.
column3: 里面的人神经都绷得很紧。他们要是看见你手里有武器,会开枪的。

column2: I carry my weapon wherever I want.
column3: 我的武器想带到哪儿就带到哪儿。

column2: Good. Don't draw your weapon in there. Guys are tense.
column3: 很好。在里面别拔武器。大家都很紧张。

column2: And, this is important, put your weapon away.
column3: 还有,这条很重要:把武器收起来。

Find someone who can examine your "contamination".

Decide what to do with the cyborgs

Give the pain reliever to the cyborg failure
column3: 把止痛药交给失败的改造人

You've met a woman who got lost on the way to Tauris

Return to New Delphi in a while
