column2: Hmmh. Can't remember what I wanted to do.
column3: 唔。想不起来刚才要干什么了。

column2: Eh? ... Sorry. I was just lost in thoughts.

column3: 石头。他妈的到处都是石头。

column2: Hello. Do you want me to join you?
It's a cage with a worm.
column3: 这是个装着蠕虫的笼子。

column2: I should talk to Ira now.
Yeah. It's cozy. And I'm not bothering anyone here.
column3: 是啊。挺舒服的。而且我在这儿也不打扰任何人。

column2: Not that it matters. Sometimes I think no one cares about anything anymore, for good or bad.
column3: 反正也不重要。有时我觉得已经没人在乎任何事了,无论是好是坏。

column2: Everyone else has become indifferent. Even the machines.
column3: 其他所有人都变得冷漠了。连机器也是。

column2: I heard they were much friendlier and caring back then.
column3: 听说他们以前友善多了,也更有爱心。

column2: Take care. Keep a low profile, right?
Want some advice? Don't hang out with the wrong people.
column3: 要忠告吗?别跟不对的人混。

column2: Them fleshies and them flesh people. Can't trust them.
column3: 那些血肉怪和血肉人。信不过他们。

column2: I'm looking for a fleshy friend, actually.
column3: 其实我正在找一个血肉朋友。

column2: Why would you want to be a friend to some of them monsters?
column3: 你为什么想跟那种怪物交朋友?

column2: I'm already a friend. I'm looking for MORE friends for the Kraken.
column3: 我已经是一个朋友了。我在给海妖找更多的朋友。

column2: You're either a pervert or just messing with me.
column3: 你要么是个变态,要么就是在耍我。

column2: I don't wanna be friends with one of them. Please leave me alone.
column3: 我不想跟那种东西做朋友。请离我远点。

column2: Why can't I trust the fleshies?
column3: 为什么我不能信任血肉怪?

column2: They're gonna kill you. Hack you up, and then build a new Titan with your arms and liver and blood.
column3: 他们会杀了你。把你肢解,然后用你的胳膊、肝脏和血液拼一头新泰坦。

column2: They're building new Titans from body parts?
column3: 他们在用身体部件拼新泰坦?

column2: You saw that yourself or heard that somewhere?
column3: 你亲眼见过,还是听说的?

column2: Didn't see it with my own eyes. But it makes sense, right?
column3: 没亲眼见过。但这说得通,对吧?

column2: Ha! You're just afraid to see the truth for what it is.
column3: 哈!你就是不敢面对真相罢了。

column2: You'll remember this when the fleshies catch you.
column3: 等血肉怪抓住你的时候,你会想起这句话的。

column2: Be careful out there. Don't let the fleshies catch you.
column3: 在外面当心点。别让血肉怪抓到你。

column2: The Sleeper rests in quietude and peace.
column3: 沉睡者在静谧与和平中安眠。

column2: An image is formed in your mind. Of a time long gone. Of violence, now forgotten.
column3: 一幅画面在你脑海中成形。那是久远的时光。是被遗忘的暴力。

column2: An image of mountains and blood. Of a journey that is history but might come again.
column3: 群山与鲜血的画面。一段已成历史、却可能重演的旅程。

column2: Makes me feel a bit nauseous around here.
column3: 待在这附近让我有点反胃。

column2: We have talked about your status already.
column3: 你的身份问题我们已经谈过了。

column2: We encourage you now to follow the Surface Integration Course.
column3: 我们现在建议你参加地表融合课程。

column2: But you're free to leave any time you want.
column3: 不过你随时都可以离开。

column2: Alright. Just follow the small corridor to Section Two.
column3: 好。沿着小走廊走到第二区就行。

column2: Alright. Just continue towards Section One then.
column3: 好。那就请继续前往第一区。

column2: It looks like the operation has been successful.
Do you remember who you are?
We still take interest in your well-being.
column3: 我们依然关心你的福祉。

column2: However, you have to leave us now. The danger of a possible contamination cannot be ignored.
column3: 然而,你现在必须离开。可能发生污染的危险不容忽视。

column2: Please don't try to return to your old habitat. We have put security measures in place to prevent this.
column3: 请不要试图返回你原来的栖居地。我们已部署安全措施以防万一。

column2: So what happens to me now? Where should I go?
column3: 那我之后怎么办?我该去哪?

column2: This is not for us to answer. You're free to go anywhere, as long as you don't try to enter a habitat.
column3: 这不是我们要回答的。你可以去任何地方,只要不试图进入任何栖居地。

column2: Here is all relevant info for you in written form in case you forget.
column3: 这里是为你准备的书面资料,以免你遗忘。

column2: Your body will malfunction permanently when nearing one of our habitats.
column3: 一旦靠近我们的任何栖居地,你的身体将永久性故障。

column2: The Surface Integration Course is standard procedure to teach you basic survival skills.
column3: 地表融合课程是教授基础生存技能的标准流程。

column2: The course disables safety limits to better prepare you for the world outside.
column3: 课程将解除安全限制,以便让你更好地为外面的世界做准备。

column2: Good luck, former citizen, and goodbye.
Your life will be terminated if you enter the prohibited zone.
column3: 如果你进入禁区,你的生命将被终结。

column2: This competition I got running. You gonna help me?
column3: 我组织的这个比赛。你要帮我吗?

column2: Sounds like fun. What do you need?
column3: 听起来挺好玩。需要什么?

column2: There's a lot of that pink glibber stuff in the Red Forest to the south of here.
column3: 这南边的红森林里有很多那种粉红色的粘液。

column2: It's gross. Never could stomach even looking at it.
column3: 恶心死了。光是看一眼我都受不了。

column2: It's gotta do something to my innards, right?
column3: 那玩意对我的内脏肯定有点作用,对吧?

column2: Alright. I'll get it for you.
It's about which of us can puke most.
I heard she's practicing a lot for this.
column3: 听说她为了这个练了很久。

column2: I don't wanna lose this time.
Ah, you brought me the stuff.
Thanks to you I could win that bet.
column3: 多亏了你,我赢下了那个赌局。

column2: Hey, you! Do you think I can win?
I just don't know if I can.
Hey! You're not trying to cheat here, are you?
column3: 嘿!你不是想在这里作弊吧?

column2: What's this person doing here then?
Take all the advice you can. You'll still lose.
column3: 能听的忠告都听了吧。你还是赢不了。

column2: Ok. So I need your help to win this.
column3: 好。所以我需要你帮我赢。

column2: My friend over there. Isn't he the cutest?
column3: 我那边那位朋友。他是不是最可爱的?

column2: Look at him, how hard he's trying.
Just wait until he defeats you.
Oh, I don't plan on winning.
I just want him to feel good.

column3: 你刚才不是在激将他吗?

column2: Of course. He can't know I'm helping.
column3: 当然。他可不能知道我在帮他。

column2: He asked me to help him cheat.
Marvellous. I'm sure that winning will build him up a bit.
column3: 太好了。我相信这场胜利能让他自信一点。

column2: He won. By his own rules at least.
column3: 他赢了。至少按他自己的规则算是赢了。

column2: Can you see how confident he looks now?
column3: 你看到他现在多有自信了吗?

column2: There's some crusty puke on it.
column3: 上面有些结痂的呕吐物。

column2: The last patient who slept on this bed clearly had bladder problems.
column3: 上一个睡这张床的病人明显有膀胱问题。

column2: You sure? You're not gonna cry when you lose, right?
column3: 确定?输了可不许哭,对吧?

column2: Not bad, not bad. But look at this.
About the same as mine, but that was just warm up. Here's the real deal.
column3: 跟我差不多嘛,不过那只是热身。看这个,真正的。

column2: That's a lot. And why is there some pink stuff in it?
column3: 量真大。里面怎么还有粉色的东西?

column2: That's nowhere near enough. look at this.
I can't anymore. I give up.
Finally. I'm so happy, I could just...
column3: 终于。我太高兴了,我简直可以……

column2: Seems like nobody has used this bed in years. The sheets are still clean.
column3: 这张床好像好几年没人用过了。床单还是干净的。

column2: This must have been brought in from one of those old facilities.
column3: 这肯定是从那些旧设施里搬进来的。

column2: I was a child. Now I am guardian.
column3: 我曾经是个孩子。现在我是守护者。

column2: You succeed in suppressing this creature's mind.
column3: 你成功压制了这个生物的心智。

column2: The Flesh Spikes pull back, opening the way.
column3: 血肉尖刺缩了回去,让开了道路。

column2: {The creature stares at you with vacant eyes.}
This machine doesn't seem to be active here in this module.
column3: 这台机器在这个模块里似乎没有激活。

column2: Looks like people tried to break through or something.
column3: 好像有人试图砸开过什么的。

column2: Oh, this is a large one.
Hey, there. Welcome to the Shrine of the Heart.
column3: 嘿,你好。欢迎来到心灵神龛。

column2: The heart isn't here anymore, but we built a small garden for the worm it contained.
column3: 心脏已经不在这里了,但我们为它里面那条蠕虫建了个小花园。

column2: The worm was rescued by a great savior of our people.
column3: 那条蠕虫是我们人民的伟大救星救下来的。

column2: I kind of imagined you would look more heroic.
column3: 我原本想象你会更有英雄气概一些。

column2: But that's not important. Thanks so much for helping us.
column3: 不过这不重要。非常感谢你帮了我们。

column2: Look for her. Look for her.
If she's here, talk to her. Talk to her.
column3: 她要是在这,跟她谈谈。谈谈。

column2: These are our brothers and sisters. Brothers and sisters.
column3: 这些是我们的兄弟姐妹。兄弟姐妹。
主人改良了他们。改良了。

column2: They are enhanced from humanity. Enhanced.
column3: 他们从人性中得到了强化。强化了。

column2: But they can barely move and talk.
column3: 可他们几乎不能动,也不能说话。

column2: And this room is so small.
They don't need room. They don't need to talk. They don't. They don't.
column3: 他们不需要空间。不需要说话。不需要。不需要。

column2: Master has made them better. Better.
column3: 主人让他们变得更好了。更好了。

column2: You are the masters creation. Creation.
If you say so, you are right. Are right.
column3: 你既然这么说,那就是对的。是对的。

column2: You should interact with the terminal over there. Over there.
column3: 你应该去那边那个终端看看。那边。

column2: I don't know your face. Your face.
column3: 我不认识你的脸。你的脸。

column2: But if you're here you're welcome. You're welcome.
column3: 但既然你来了,就欢迎。欢迎。

column2: What do you want to do?

column3: 警告:检测到未经授权的核心移除。
正在激活高级安全协议。

column2: This machine is missing a Machine Core.
column3: 这台机器缺了一个机器核心。

column2: The hierarch awaits you at the top. At the top.
Many people come here. Come here.
You will have to talk to the Hierarch. Hierarch.
You should talk to him, if you want to know more. Talk to him.
column3: 想知道更多就该去和他谈。和他谈。

column2: Why are you talking like this?
What do you mean? You mean?
I am just doing work for the Hierarch. Hierarch.
column3: 我只是为圣主办事。圣主。
没什么不对。没什么不对。

column2: But an exam must be undertaken first.
column3: 但必须先通过一场考验。

column2: Only the best are good enough to fit my army after all.
column3: 毕竟只有最优秀的人,才配得上我的军队。

column2: WARNING: Intruder detected. Running sterilization protocol.
column3: 警告:检测到入侵者。正在执行灭菌协议。

column2: FAILURE: Room could not be quarantined due to mechanical failure.
column3: 失败:由于机械故障,房间无法隔离。
检测到入侵者。正在启动灭菌流程。
检测到入侵者。正在启动灭菌流程。

column2: I may have seen one. Seen one.
column3: 我可能见过一个。见过一个。

column2: But here I am alone. Am alone.
column3: 但我现在孤身一人。孤身一人。

column2: A challenge set to you by the Hierarch.
column3: 是圣主给你的一场考验。

column2: He gathers us, to make us strong. Make us strong.
column3: 他召集我们,让我们变强。变强。

column2: Why are you talking like this?
I was asked this before. Before.
column3: 之前也有人这么问过。问过。

column2: What do people mean, when they ask this? Ask this.
column3: 人们这么问是什么意思?什么意思?

column2: I am talking normally. Very normally.
column3: 我说话很正常。非常正常。

column2: You must have found a way to avoid the challenge. Avoid.
column3: 你一定是找到了躲开考验的办法。躲开。

column2: Is it because you tried to hide from it? Hide?
column3: 是因为你试着躲起来了?躲起来?

column2: Is that the secret to your success? Success.
column3: 这就是你成功的秘诀吗?秘诀。

column2: You have faced the challenge. The challenge.
column3: 你已经面对过考验了。考验。

column2: Either with brawn or with skill. Brawn or skill.
column3: 无论是靠蛮力还是技巧。蛮力或技巧。

column2: Surely you must now recognize the danger this technology brings to us.
column3: 想必你现在已认识到这项技术带给我们的危险。

column2: But the tower has not yet been conquered.
This floor requires wits to pass.
column3: 这一层需要用智慧通过。

column2: Use your head responsibly, and you may just go unharmed.
column3: 理智地使用你的头脑,你或许就能毫发无损。

column2: Go on, recruit. In preparation for the cause.
column3: 去吧,新兵。为了大业做准备。

column2: Mechanical Failure: Gate can not be opened.
column3: 机械故障:大门无法打开。

column2: Have you come to join me? Join me?
column3: 你是来加入我的吗?加入我?

column2: Two of them came by a long time ago. Long time ago.
column3: 很久以前有两个来过。很久以前。

column2: I remember them, because they were the first survivors. First survivors.
column3: 我记得她们,因为她们是最早的幸存者。最早的幸存者。

column2: But I have not seen them since. Not seen them since.
column3: 但之后就再没见过她们。再没见过。

column2: This is my room. My room.
column3: 这是我的房间。我的房间。

column2: It is where I stay to do the Hierarchs bidding. His bidding.
column3: 是我待着执行圣主吩咐的地方。他的吩咐。

column2: I do as he tells me. As he tells me.
column3: 他叫我做什么我就做什么。他叫我做。

column2: Why are you talking like this?

column3: 我听起来一定很怪。很怪。

column2: I have been here for a long time. Long time.
column3: 我在这里待了很久。很久。

column2: The Hierarch sent me, to take care of this floor. This floor.
column3: 圣主派我来看守这一层。这一层。

column2: He sends me food every week. Every week.
column3: 他每周给我送食物。每周。

column2: But I have not seen many people since. Many people.
column3: 但之后就没什么人来找过我。什么人。

column2: My lack of interaction must make me sound odd. Sound odd.
column3: 缺少与人交流,我说起话来一定很怪。很怪。

column2: By the Hierarch, a survivor. Survivor.
column3: 以圣主之名,一个幸存者。幸存者。

column2: This place used to be a factory. A place the machines used for replication.
column3: 这里曾是一座工厂。机器用来复制自己的地方。

column2: So much of their power, concentrated in this place.
column3: 它们那么多的力量,曾汇聚于此。
想想看,如果它们失去了它。

column2: Imagine if we used their own powers against them.
column3: 想想看,如果我们用它们自己的力量对付它们。

column2: This is why I have conquered this place.
column3: 这就是我征服此地的理由。

column2: This is why I gather the strong.
column3: 这就是我召集强者的理由。

column2: The next exam awaits you now. Good luck.
column3: 下一场考核正等着你。祝你好运。

column2: What is taking you so long? So long?

column3: 我和那个改造人谈过了。
就是你叫的"碍眼的东西"。
那其实是个失败的改造人。

column2: Seems like the Hierarch didn't do a good job during the creation.
column3: 看来圣主在创造它的时候没弄好。

column2: So this thing is even more of a blight on the Hierarchs honor? More of a blight?
column3: 这么说这东西更是对圣主荣誉的玷污了?更是玷污?

column2: Even more reason to kill it. Kill it.
column3: 更有理由杀了它了。杀了它。

column2: You can help him yourself. Help him.

column3: 那个碍眼的东西我处理完了。

column2: And you also took care of the other one too. The other one.
column3: 你把另一个也处理了。另一个。

column2: I couldn't be more happy. More happy.
There is just one more issue. One issue.
column3: 只剩一个小问题。一个问题。

column2: We have another eyesore right over there. Over there.
column3: 那边正好还有一个碍眼的东西。那边。

column2: Please take care of that too. Take care.
column3: 请把它也处理掉。处理掉。

column2: I'm done with the other one too.
I am very grateful for your service. For your service.
column3: 我对你的效劳感激不尽。感激不尽。

column2: You are new here. New here.
Yet you have already done something amazing. Amazing.
column3: 却已经做了了不起的事。了不起。

column2: You got rid of the eyesores. The eyesores.
column3: 你清除了那些碍眼的东西。碍眼的东西。

column2: I could not be happier. Could not.
column3: 我高兴得不能再高兴了。不能。

column2: You got rid of the eyesore. The eyesore.
column3: 你清除了那个碍眼的东西。碍眼的东西。

column2: Though there is one more. One more.
column3: 不过还有一个。还有一个。

column2: You should remove it too. Remove it.
column3: 你也应该把它清除。清除。

column2: The beauty of the Hierarch should not be tainted by it. Not be tainted.
column3: 圣主之美不应被它玷污。不被玷污。

column2: Can you do me a favour? Favour?
You see this room here. This room.
column3: 你看到这个房间了吗。这个房间。

column2: There's an eyesore inside. An eyesore.
column3: 里面有个碍眼的东西。碍眼的东西。

column2: We need to get rid of it. Get rid of it.

column3: 我们谈过了。他是个改造人。

column2: That is even more reason to kill it. More reason to kill.
column3: 那就更有理由杀了它。更有理由。

column2: You can help him yourself. Help him.
I don't know how else to call it. How else to call it.
column3: 我不知道还能怎么称呼它。怎么称呼。

column2: It just came here from upstairs. From upstairs.
column3: 它刚从楼上下来的。从楼上。

column2: We then captured it and put it in here. In here.
column3: 然后我们抓住它,关在这里。在这里。

column2: The others are saying the Hierarch created it. The Hierarch created it.
column3: 其他人说是圣主造了它。圣主造了它。

column2: The Hierarch only creates perfection. Perfection.
You have come back. Come back.
What are you waiting for? Waiting for?
The eyesore is in that small room over there. Over there.
column3: 那碍眼的东西就在那边的小房间里。那边。

column2: Well, the other eyesore is now gone.
column3: 嗯,另一个碍眼的东西已经没了。

column2: I could not be more happy. More happy.
The Hierarch is untainted once again. Once again.
column3: 圣主再次纯净无瑕了。再次。

column2: You wanted to help that thing. Help.
column3: 你不是想帮那东西吗。帮。

column2: And yet it is gone. It is gone.
You must be completely useless. Useless.
You are trying to help that thing. That thing.
column3: 你竟想帮那东西。那东西。

column2: You know this won't make the Hierarch happy. The Hierarch.
column3: 你知道这不会让圣主高兴的。圣主。
我的计划成功了。成功了。

column2: Help me get rid of the eyesore in this room. The eyesore.
column3: 帮我除掉这个房间里的碍眼的东西。碍眼的东西。

column2: No, I need to help him.
You are trying to help that thing. That thing.
column3: 你竟想帮那东西。那东西。

column2: Do you have anything, that could help?
column3: 你有什么能帮上忙的东西吗?

column2: Why would I help you with this? With this?
column3: 我为什么要帮你这个?帮你?

column2: The eyesore needs to go. Needs to go.
column3: 那碍眼的东西必须消失。必须消失。

column2: But he's made by the Hierarch, isn't he?
column3: 可他是圣主造的,不是吗?

column2: This here might help. Might help.
But I am not that sure if it really will. Not that sure.
column3: 但我不太确定是否真有用。不太确定。

column2: I can give you this. Give you this.
I am sure it will work. It will work.
column3: 我确信它会管用。会管用。

column2: I'm looking for pain reliever ingredients.
Do you have anything, that could help?
column3: 你有什么能帮上忙的东西吗?

column2: There's another one like you over there.
column3: 那边还有一个跟你一样的。

column2: Look, I brought you a pain reliever.
This person outside wants me to kill you.
column3: 外面那个人要我杀了你。
干得好,拿到那把钥匙了。

column2: Yes. We cyborgs are his creation.
column3: 是的。我们改造人是他的造物。

column2: He is taking in us feeble humans, and augmenting us.
column3: 他收留我们这些孱弱的人类,并强化我们。

column2: So we can join him in his fight against the machine when the time is right.
column3: 等时机成熟,我们便能加入他对抗机器的战斗。

column2: Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
You mean like the supervisors you met on your way up, or the scientists in here?
column3: 你是说你上楼时遇到的那些监工,还是这里的科学家?

column2: I'm a cyborg. A former piece of flesh and bones, augmented and improved by the Hierarch.
column3: 我是改造人。曾经只是一副血肉之躯,被圣主强化改良。

column2: They on the other hand are still raw humans.
column3: 而他们仍是未经改造的人类。

column2: The Hierarch chose them to serve him.
column3: 圣主选中他们为自己效力。

column2: Cyborg guard for the one and only Hierarch.
column3: 独一无二之圣主的改造人守卫。

column2: Cluvo is always telling the truth.
You have the key. Give it to me!
Oh no. I'm sorry, but you are wrong.
Give us a moment to reorganize, then try again.
column3: 给我们点时间重新安排,然后再来试。

column2: Here take it, and hurry to the Hierarch.
He is surely eager to meet a newcomer.
column3: 他一定很想见见新来的人。

column2: Wait, I really don't have it.
Did you manage to get sneaky on me?
column3: 你是对我使了什么偷鸡摸狗的手段?

column2: Apparently I don't have the key.
You ... you got the key? You're good.
column3: 你……你拿到钥匙了?你真行。

column2: At least I'm a bit stronger now.
column3: 至少我现在强壮了一点。

column2: Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
I'm not sure what you mean.
I mean, so many others in this tower do it.
column3: 我是说,塔里好多人都这样。

column2: Bann is always telling the truth. Please trust him.
column3: 班恩总是说真话。请相信他。

column2: You have the key. Give it to me!
I'm sorry, but you're wrong. I don't have it.
column3: 抱歉,但你猜错了。我没有。

column2: Please try again in a moment. Okay?
Wait, I really don't have it.
Oh wait... Did you take it from me?
column3: 哦等等……是你从我身上拿走的?

column2: I'm sorry, I don't have the key.
I'm sorry, I don't have the key.
Now off you go. Do whatever you want with it.
column3: 现在走吧。随你怎么用它。

column2: Yeah. The Hierarch gave me this chance, I took it, and here we are.
column3: 是啊。圣主给了我这个机会,我抓住了,就有了现在的我。

column2: A lot stronger, and with a cozy job guarding this gate.
column3: 强壮多了,还有份看大门的轻松差事。

column2: He said some stuff about an upcoming war too.
column3: 他还说了些即将来临的战争之类的事。

column2: Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
Don't you dare compare me to those ... people.
I'm saying a thing. Saying a thing.
That's why I'm standing guard out here, rather than being inside with the others.
column3: 所以我才在外头站岗,不跟其他人待在里面。

column2: If they just became cyborgs like us. How much more peaceful it could be.
column3: 要是他们像我们一样变成改造人。能太平多少啊。

column2: I was hoping you'd tell me a bit more than just your name.
column3: 我还指望你不只说个名字呢。

column2: Are you looking for a fight?
Asger is always telling the truth.
You have the key. Give it to me!
Try again later, if you think you can still do it.
column3: 过会儿再试吧,如果你觉得自己还行。

column2: Figured it out, huh? Or were you just guessing?
column3: 想明白了,是吧?还是瞎蒙的?

column2: Now take the key, and go inside.
You stole it from my pocket, didn't you.
column3: 你从我口袋里偷的,对吧。

column2: Well, if you already have it, move on.
column3: 行吧,你既然拿到了,就继续走吧。

column2: Well done getting the key, human.
column3: 干得好,人类。钥匙已到手。

column2: Do not be afraid of me, human.
I was once like you, human.
Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
I am distancing myself from human speech patterns.
column3: 我正在脱离人类的语言模式。

column2: I shall not repeat myself like those humans.
column3: 我不会像那些人类那样重复自己。

column2: I am beyond your and their comprehension.
column3: 我超越你们与他们的理解。

column2: Door guard under the Great Hierarch.
Well done getting the key, fellow cyborg.
column3: 干得好,改造人同胞。钥匙已到手。

column2: You have the key. Give it to me!
I do not have the key.
You must have used covert tactics to take it from me.
column3: 你必定使用了隐蔽手段从我处取得。

column2: Congratulations on finding such an improbable solution.
column3: 祝贺你找到如此出人意料的解法。

column2: I do not have the key.
I do not have the key.
I do not have the key.
While searching for the key, every one of the guards will either always tell you the truth, or always lie.
column3: 在寻找钥匙的过程中,每一位守卫要么永远对你说真话,要么永远撒谎。

column2: If you guess wrong, we'll switch it around.
column3: 如果你猜错了,我们就换一批。

column2: The person who has the key, and the individuals who will lie about everything they say, will change every time you guess incorrectly.
column3: 持有钥匙的人,以及句句撒谎的那些人,每次你猜错都会更换。

column2: This here is your final challenge.
To continue, you'll need a key.
column3: 要继续往上,你需要一把钥匙。

column2: One of the guards behind me has it. Try to find out who.
column3: 我身后的守卫中有一人拿着它。试着查出是谁。

column2: It might be Drun over there.
Oh the poor failures. Poor failures.
column3: 哦,可怜的失败品。可怜的失败品。

column2: Who did this to them? Who?
column3: 是谁把他们弄成这样?是谁?

column2: Why did it have to die? Why?
column3: 它为什么非得死呢?为什么?

column2: They came in from upstairs. From upstairs.
column3: 他们是从楼上下来的。从楼上。

column2: Where the Hierarch rests. The Hierarch.
And we took them in. Took them in.
column3: 我们把他们收留了。收留了。

column2: You mean that cyborg, that's in pain?
column3: 你是说那个很痛苦的改造人?

column2: Oh no, he's in pain? He's in pain?
column3: 哦不,他很痛苦?他很痛苦?

column2: We should help him. Should help him.
column3: 我们应该帮帮他。应该帮。

column2: What a pity you think that way. What a pity.
column3: 你这么想真可惜。真可惜。

column2: May the Hierarch forgive you. Forgive you.
You can still change your mind. Change your mind.
column3: 你还可以改变主意。改变主意。

column2: I think I know a way. Know a way.
column3: 我想我知道一个办法。一个办法。

column2: But we need to gather some things for this. Some things for this.
column3: 但我们得为此收集些东西。些东西。

column2: We need some glibber, a brain and some flesh. And some flesh.
column3: 我们需要一些粘液、一个脑和一些血肉。一些血肉。

column2: I am sure you will find everything you need on this floor. On this floor.
column3: 我确信你要的一切在这一层都能找到。这一层。

column2: You mean those in the small room?
column3: 你是说小房间里的那些?

column2: I talked with one of them.
We need to help. Need to help.
Did you give him the pain reliever yet? Give him the pain reliever?
column3: 你把止痛药给他了吗?给他了吗?

column2: We need the ingredients for a pain reliever. Pain reliever.
column3: 我们需要止痛药的原料。止痛药。

column2: Do you have everything we need? Everything we need?
column3: 我们需要的东西你都拿到了吗?都拿到了?

column2: Then please, hurry and get it. Hurry.
Please give this to the cyborg. The cyborg.
column3: 请把这个交给那个改造人。改造人。

column2: He will feel better. Feel better.
column3: 他会好受一些的。好受一些。

column2: It did not help. Not help.
Was one of the ingredients wrong? Ingredients wrong?
column3: 是哪味原料错了吗?原料错了?

column2: You did well to help the failures. The failures.
column3: 你帮助那些失败品,做得很好。失败品。

column2: The Hierarch will be very grateful. Very grateful.
column3: 圣主会非常感激的。非常感激。

column2: Please don't interrupt us. Interrupt us.
column3: 请别打断我们。打断我们。

column2: We are analyzing this robot. This robot.
column3: 我们正在分析这台机器人。这台机器人。

column2: I'm looking for pain reliever ingredients.
Will you shut up, if I give you this? Will you?
column3: 如果我给你这个,你能闭嘴吗?能吗?

column2: How about this? How about this?
column3: 这个怎么样?这个怎么样?

column2: We pull the shell from both sides. From both sides.
column3: 我们从两边把外壳拉开。两边。

column2: We will expose the sensors much more easily. Much more easily.
column3: 这样暴露传感器会容易得多。容易得多。

column2: We already tried that. Tried that.
column3: 我们已经试过了。试过了。

column2: But we need some much heavier machinery for this. For this.
column3: 但这需要重得多的机械。重得多。

column2: I have an idea. An idea.
We take its levitation module. Levitation module.
column3: 我们取下它的悬浮模块。悬浮模块。

column2: And attach it to a human torso. Human torso.
column3: 再装到人类躯干上。人类躯干。

column2: We can make people without legs fly. People without legs fly.
column3: 我们能让没有腿的人飞起来。没有腿的人飞。

column2: Did you already forget what happened last time we tried that? Last time we tried that?
column3: 你已经忘了上次我们那么做时发生了什么吗?上次?

column2: Do you think you could get me the thermal unwelder? Thermal unwelder?
column3: 你觉得你能帮我拿到热力拆焊器吗?热力拆焊器?

column2: Do you see this? See this?
column3: 你看到这个了吗?看到了吗?

column2: The hatch on its back is open, revealing all the wiring and mechanics inside.
column3: 它背上的舱门开着,露出里面所有的线路和机械结构。

column2: I should probably keep my distance from it.
I do work for the Hierarch. The Hierarch.
We will improve his army. His army.
column3: 我们会改良他的军队。他的军队。

column2: The Hierarch is great. Is great.
It is an honour to meet him. To meet him.
column3: 能见到他是种荣耀。一种荣耀。

column2: How did I get here? Get here?
column3: 我是怎么到这儿来的?怎么来的?

column2: The Hierarch is kind. Is kind.
He gave us this place to sleep. Sleep.
column3: 他给了我们这个地方睡觉。睡觉。

column2: Do you have ingredients for a pain reliever?
I don't have anything. Have anything.
column3: 我什么都没有。什么都没有。

column2: Who is in pain? Who is?
That cyborg failure in the small room.
column3: 小房间里那个失败的改造人。

column2: But I only have glibber. Only glibber.
column3: 但我只有粘液。只有粘液。

column2: That would help a lot, actually.
You have now reached the place, where the strong ones reside.
column3: 你现在抵达了强者居住的地方。

column2: This is the place for survivors.
This is where we plan how to defeat the Machine God.
column3: 这是我们谋划如何击败机器之神的地方。

column2: This is the place for the strong and the smart.
And you belong here too, now.
Welcome to the Mechanical Body Parts Remover Unit.
column3: 欢迎来到机械身体部件移除装置。

column2: How can this unit be of service?
What does this unit do, exactly?
column3: 本装置具体是做什么的?

column2: This unit will help with removing mechanical body parts.
column3: 本装置用于协助移除机械身体部件。
未检测到机械身体部件。

column2: Do you want to remove the mechanical part?

column3: 你看起来很强壮。非常强壮。
你的朋友不会再回来了。

column2: I know she is still in there. In there.
column3: 我知道她还在里面。在里面。

column2: Waiting for somebody to rescue her. Rescue her.
And since I'm not alone anymore, time passes faster. Pass faster.
column3: 既然不再是独自一人,时间过得快多了。快多了。

column2: But, could you go in the tower for me? For me?
column3: 不过,你能替我去一趟塔里吗?替我?

column2: My friend is still in there. Still there.
column3: 我的朋友还在里面。还在。

column2: Why are you talking like this?
What do you mean? You mean?
Always repeating words. Again and again.
column3: 总是在重复词语。一遍又一遍。

column2: But enough about me. About me.

column3: 你看起来很强壮。非常强壮。

column2: So, what will you do now?
column3: 那么,你现在打算做什么?

column2: Take care of my friend, of course.
You have helped me a lot.
Thanks to you, I could see Noor again.
column3: 多亏了你,我才能再见到诺尔。

column2: Even if she is a bit ... different.
But she's a bit different than you might remember her.
column3: 但她和你记忆中的样子有点不一样了。
你看起来很强壮。非常强壮。
你看起来很强壮。非常强壮。

column2: The fuck is going on here?
I'm looking for someone to save my friend. My friend.
column3: 我在找能救我朋友的人。我朋友。

column2: Yeah, you already said that before.
column3: 嗯,这话你之前已经说过了。

column2: Are you calling me crazy? Me crazy?
column3: 你是在说我疯了吗?我疯?

column2: I am not crazy. Not crazy.
Let me proove it to you.

column3: 你看起来很强壮。非常强壮。

column2: Yeah, you already said that before.
column3: 嗯,这话你之前已经说过了。

column2: You see my friend has gone into this tower. Tower.
column3: 你看,我的朋友进了这座塔。塔。

column2: And she hasn't come out yet. Not yet.
Will you go in and get her for me? For me?
column3: 你愿意进去替我把她带出来吗?替我?

column2: You want to stay with me? Stay with me?
column3: 你想和我待在一起?和我?

column2: Then we can wait here for my friend together. Together.
column3: 那我们可以一起在这里等我朋友。一起。

column2: And when somebody strong comes, we can send them in to look for her. Look for her.
column3: 等有强壮的人来,我们就派他进去找她。找她。
我的朋友……在这儿?在哪儿?

column2: She's literally standing just next to you.
column3: 她就明晃晃地站在你旁边啊。

column2: This can't be my friend. Friend.
column3: 这不可能是我的朋友。朋友。

column2: My friend is very beautiful. Beautiful.
column3: 我的朋友非常漂亮。非常漂亮。

column2: She is in the tower, waiting. Waiting.
You could at least talk to her.
So, who are you? Are you?
Are you really telling the truth? The truth?
If this is really her, she must be hurting. Hurting.
column3: 如果这真是她,她一定在受苦。受苦。

column2: We must release her from the pain. From the pain.
column3: 我们必须把她从痛苦中解救出来。痛苦中。

column2: This person is my friend? Friend?
column3: 这个人是我的朋友?朋友?

column2: I don't know her. Don't know.
If you're not here to help, just leave. Just leave.
column3: 你如果不是来帮忙的,就走开。走开。

column2: Same goes for you. For you.
The two of you came here together.
I don't really understand why, but somehow you ended up out here, telling people to climb the tower.
column3: 我不太明白为什么,但不知怎的你最后跑到了外面,叫别人去爬塔。

column2: This doesn't make sense. No sense.
I am waiting for my friend. My friend.
column3: 我在等我的朋友。我朋友。

column2: She is in the tower. The tower.
If you don't want to believe me, maybe you'd at least want to befriend this cyborg here?
column3: 如果你不愿相信我,那你至少愿意和这个改造人交个朋友吗?

column2: She will be my friend? Friend?
column3: 她会成为我的朋友?朋友?
不。我们以前就是好朋友。

column2: This is for the best of you both.
Just take good care of each other, will you?
You were brainwashed by the Titan.
Yes. He does that to people.
They all talk in circles. Like you.
column3: 他们都说话绕圈子。像你一样。

column2: It would also explain, why you don't recognize her.
column3: 这也能解释你为什么认不出她。

column2: It makes my head hurt. My head hurts.

column3: 放松。这样下去可不健康。

column2: Just know that this woman here wants to be friends with you.
column3: 你只要知道,这位女士想和你做朋友。

column2: Stay strong. You need to remember.
It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It huuuurts.
column3: 好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛。好痛————。

column2: We wanted to go to the tower.
What the fuck happened to you?
column3: 你他妈到底遭遇了什么?

column2: Come here. Let me take care of you.
Remember. You two climbed the tower together.
column3: 想起来。你们俩是一起爬上这座塔的。

column2: There's a Titan there, who turned her into this.
column3: 塔里有个泰坦,把她变成了这样。

column2: And he sent you out, to lure in more people for him.
column3: 然后他把你放出来,替他诱骗更多人。

column2: She is inside the tower. Waiting. Waiting.
Why are you talking like this.
You already asked this. Asked this.
column3: 这个你已经问过了。问过了。

column2: My friend has gone into this tower here. Tower.
column3: 我的朋友进了这座塔。塔。

column2: And she hasn't come back yet. Not back.
It's been several days now. Days.
column3: 已经过去好几天了。好几天。

column2: I don't think she's alive anymore.
What do you mean? Do you mean?
I'll just wait for her. Wait for her.
Can't you look for her yourself?
I don't think she's in there anymore.
Has a woman come by recently?
Many have approached since I started spreading the word.
column3: 自我开始传扬以来,前来者众多。

column2: The person you mean might, or might not, have survived this place.
column3: 你说的那个人也许活了下来,也许没有。

column2: If you wish to check, come to the top.
column3: 若你想查证,便到塔顶来。

column2: I am the one who has seen the danger.
I am the one who opposes the machines.
I am the one who stands on top of the tower.
Reach me, and all will be answered.
column3: 抵达我处,一切自会解答。

column2: So the subject does not even know why it is here.
column3: 原来实验对象甚至不知道自己为何在此。

column2: If you wish to turn stronger.
If you wish to transcend the limits of your flesh.
column3: 若你想超越血肉的极限。

column2: Reach me at the top of this tower.
All will be answered in time.
What's going on with this gun?
I gave this weapon to you to help you.
column3: 我把这件武器给你,是为了帮助你。

column2: Do not tell me you wish not to have it?
I was worried you might not like it, seeing how I compelled you to it.
column3: 我有点担心你不喜欢它,毕竟我是强迫你收下的。

column2: I shall take it back then.
Can you renew the machines in my body?
column3: 你能更新我体内的机器吗?

column2: The person outside the tower is missing a friend.
column3: 塔外那个人少了一位朋友。

column2: Both she and her friend have passed my exam.
column3: 她和她的朋友都通过了我的考验。

column2: But only one of them wished to become a better human.
column3: 但她们中只有一人愿意成为更好的人类。

column2: Whereas I sent the other one out to gather more people.
column3: 而我派另一个出去召集更多人。

column2: So that is who you were asking about before.
column3: 原来你之前问的就是她。

column2: In the room above, with all my other improved children.
column3: 在楼上的房间里,和我其他被改良的孩子们在一起。

column2: So you can slaughter her like my other children?
column3: 好让你像屠戮我其他孩子那样宰了她?

column2: No, I shall not let you.
None of my children were helped by you.
column3: 我的孩子没有一个得到过你的帮助。

column2: Neither have you sworn service to me, or helped me in any form.
column3: 你也未曾向我宣誓效忠,或以任何形式帮助过我。

column2: I fail to see why I should grant you this wish of yours.
column3: 我不明白我为何要满足你这个愿望。

column2: As you have become my child, I shall grant you this wish.
column3: 既然你已成为我的孩子,我便满足你这个愿望。

column2: She will wait for you outside the tower.
You did lessen the pain on one of my mistakes.
column3: 你确实减轻了我一个失误的痛苦。

column2: I shall grant you this wish, as repentance for my mistake, and reward for your good deed.
column3: 我便满足你这个愿望,作为对我失误的忏悔,也是对你善行的奖赏。

column2: It is a place only few shall have access to.
column3: 那是唯有极少数人才能进入的地方。

column2: Even though you have become one of my children, that place shall not be reached by you.
column3: 尽管你已成为我的孩子之一,那地方也不是你能踏足的。

column2: What with those things, that escaped from here?
column3: 那些从这里逃走的东西呢?

column2: Not everyone took my enhancement well.
column3: 并非每个人都能很好地承受我的强化。

column2: They are part of my shameful past.
column3: 他们是我耻辱过去的一部分。

column2: Yet they are my children I hold dearly.
column3: 但他们仍是我珍爱的孩子。

column2: But yes, they are the result of my earliest attempts.
column3: 但没错,他们是我最初尝试的结果。

column2: It took me many tries to combine the machines of this place with the bodies of strong humans.
column3: 我尝试了许多次,才将此地的机器与强壮人类的身体结合。

column2: Though all the missteps on my way there do present my progress.
column3: 不过一路上的所有失误,也正展现了我的进步。

column2: I hold them as dearly as all my other children.
column3: 我和珍爱其他孩子一样珍爱他们。

column2: Are those weird talking people also "improved"?
column3: 那些说话怪里怪气的人也是被"改良"的吗?

column2: In the beginning, not everybody came to me freely.
column3: 起初,并非所有人都自愿来投奔我。

column2: And I required followers to do my bidding.
column3: 而我需要追随者为我效力。

column2: So I gave them a push.
It messed up their brains a bit.
column3: 他们的脑子因此有点乱了。

column2: But do not worry. They are otherwise fine.
column3: 但别担心。除此之外他们都好好的。

column2: Though you do appear to have taken issue with them.
column3: 不过你似乎对他们有些意见。

column2: Do not worry, I can make you even better than they were.
column3: 别担心,我能把你造得比他们更好。

column2: Let me enhance you beyond your human limitations.
column3: 让我强化你,超越你的人类极限。

column2: Take in some machines. To make you better.
column3: 接纳一些机器。让你变得更好。

column2: Let yourself become more like me.
If you ever change your mind, ask me again.
column3: 如果你改变主意,随时再来问我。

column2: You have become almost perfect, my child.
column3: 你已近乎完美,我的孩子。

column2: Still, there appears to be an issue.
Your body does not accept me fully.
column3: 你的身体没有完全接纳我。

column2: Over time it will return back to what it was. Mostly.
column3: 假以时日,它会恢复成原来的样子。大体上。

column2: When that time comes, reach me once more.
Until then, you shall be a weapon of mine.
column3: 在那之前,你将是我的武器。

column2: Use this, to aid us in our aspirations.
column3: 用上这个,助我们达成宏愿。

column2: I made it so it may never leave you.
column3: 我把它造得永远不会离开你。

column2: Even when the machines influence in your body wanes.
column3: 即使你体内机器的影响消退。

column2: You have met them, have you not?
Do you not wish to join them?
Like what you did to me?
Yes. I brought you closer to the machines.
column3: 是的。我让你更接近机器。

column2: Made you stronger with their weapons.
column3: 用他们的武器让你更强。

column2: And lowered some of your human weaknesses.
column3: 并削弱了你的一部分人性弱点。

column2: As I did with most who conquered this tower.
column3: 我对大多数征服此塔的人都这么做。

column2: You have passed the exam, so I shall tell you.
column3: 你已通过考验,那我便告诉你。

column2: This is the place where I gather my army to fight the Machine God.
column3: 这里是我集结军队对抗机器之神的地方。

column2: I have taken over his factory, and am producing my own.
column3: 我夺下了他的工厂,正在生产我自己的。

column2: I cannot fight the machines with machines only.
column3: 光靠机器,我无法与机器作战。

column2: You have come back, my child.
Do you wish to become strong?
Hey, did you talk to the Titan?
column3: 嘿,你和那个泰坦谈过了吗?

column2: This probably used to be a bed.
What is that supposed to mean?
This machine looks like it's connected to the door.
column3: 这台机器看起来和门连着。

column2: Where am I supposed to find organic lubricant?
column3: 我上哪儿去找有机润滑剂?

column2: I don't need anything from this machine anymore.
column3: 我不再需要这台机器的任何东西了。

column2: And I don't want to fill more of my stuff in there.
column3: 我也不想再往里面填我自己的东西了。

column2: This must have been valuable a long time ago.
column3: 这很久以前一定很值钱。

column2: There's some broken tools here. Nothing useful though.
column3: 这里有些坏掉的工具。不过没什么有用的。
这里没什么有用的东西。

column2: Can't use anything from that stuff.
column3: 那堆东西里没一样能用。

column2: Does seem to be functional, but I don't know its purpose.
column3: 看起来还能用,但我不知道它是干什么用的。

column2: I don't know what that is.
Not sure what this is. But nothing I could use.
column3: 不确定这是什么。但没有我能用的。

column2: These boots belonged to Careen Tyler, a Founding Guardian of the Crystal City.
column3: 这双靴子属于卡琳·泰勒,水晶之城的创始守护者之一。

column2: The brain of someone who killed himself accidentally by imagining himself dead.
column3: 某个人的脑,他靠想象自己已死而意外自杀了。

column2: A recording of his chain of thoughts was preserved, but later erased.
column3: 他思维链的记录被保存了下来,但后来被抹除。

column2: These clothes were found on the street, encircled by a silent, astonished crowd.
column3: 这些衣服是在街上发现的,四周围着一圈沉默而震惊的人群。

column2: Witnesses spoke of a profound shedding of human shackles—of an old man freeing himself once more, unbound by cloth.
column3: 目击者谈及一次人性枷锁的深刻脱落——一位老人再次解放了自己,挣脱了布料的束缚。

column2: Flesh draped over metal, I guess.
column3: 血肉披挂在金属上,我猜。

column2: We want it peaceful in there.
column3: 我们希望里面保持太平。

column2: You wanted peace, but it's war you got. [Begin Combat.]
column3: 你要太平,来的却是战争。[开始战斗。]

column2: I carry my weapon wherever I want.
column3: 我的武器想带到哪儿就带到哪儿。

column2: Guys inside are tense. If they see a weapon in your hand, they will shoot.
column3: 里面的人神经绷得很紧。他们要是看见你手里有武器,会开枪的。

column2: Good. Don't draw your weapon in there. Guys are tense.
column3: 很好。在里面别拔武器。大家都很紧张。

column2: Hey. Put that weapon away or you'll get killed.
column3: 嘿。把那武器收起来,不然你会没命的。

column2: Hey. Put your weapon away or you're gonna regret it.
column3: 嘿。把武器收起来,不然你会后悔的。

column2: Hey, you want to see my wares?
Where they go, the flesh grows.
column3: 他们走到哪里,血肉便生长到哪里。

column2: Where the flesh grows, life blooms.
column3: 血肉生长之处,生命便绽放。

column2: Do you believe in the Titans?

column3: 你说的"相信"是什么意思?

column2: They will bring us to peace.
You should go to New Delphi, if you wish to learn more.
column3: 如果你想了解更多,应该去新德尔斐。

column2: I heard that one of our holy items had been stolen recently.
column3: 听说我们的一件圣物最近被偷了。

column2: But the Titans sent out a champion to retrieve it.
column3: 但泰坦派出了一位勇士去取回它。

column2: This proves that the will of the Titans is real.
column3: 这证明泰坦的意志是真实的。

column2: We're just taking a break on our pilgrimage to New Delphi.

My hideout.||I'm over there sometimes, deep in thoughts, at peace with the world. ||||But then I get pulled out again.
column3: 想象一面山坡,分隔开两种景致,而从这一侧望去,它像一道通向无垠的边界。再想象在它的阴影某处,一面寻常的山壁,安卧在山谷之中。||一座小小的花岗岩堡垒嵌进那面巨壁的一道大裂缝里,像从洞口探头的老鼠。堡垒已被遗弃。||穿过它的大门,一条蜿蜒的小径穿过厅室与走廊,深入山体,直到我们抵达岩壁凿出的古老房间。一座巨大的厅堂将它们连在一起——也许曾是军队或学者的居所。||沿着一条狭窄的走廊走到建筑群中布满灰尘的角落,我们发现一间毫不起眼的小房间。||在里面,隔着一堵墙,透过旧橱柜之间的缝隙,有一张床。||躺在那张床上,盖着温暖的织物,那就是我的快乐之所。我的藏身处。||我有时会在那里,沉浸在思绪里,与世界和解。||||但随后我又被拽了回来。

column2: Anything and everyone is art.||The artist's role is to strive for making anything and everyone possible, filling out what remains unfinished by nature or by human endeavors.
column3: 万物与众生皆是艺术。||艺术家的职责,是努力让万物与众生皆成为可能,补全自然或人类努力所遗留的未竟之事。

column2: An artist's goal should be to remind people of the kind of world they are living in and of the kind of world it could be if anything were possible.||Art is any kind of thing that is purposefully built or used to achieve that goal.
column3: 艺术家的目标,应是提醒人们他们生活在怎样的世界,以及若一切皆有可能,世界又能成为怎样。||艺术即是一切有意建造或使用来达成此目标的物事。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 1 of 7||||In a city marred by time a searching woman found a place, infested.||Her ailing body took root and healed, and soon she began providing.||The people, accepting her offerings, built a temple in her honor.||She became what was heralded, a beacon of care, a mother.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之一||||在一座被岁月侵蚀的城市,一位寻索的女子找到了一处地方,血肉滋生。||她病弱的身体扎根痊愈,不久便开始供给。||人们接受了她的供奉,为她建起一座神庙。||她成为了被预示的那一位,关怀的灯塔,一位母亲。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 2 of 7||||He came to the city, a wanderer of the planes and mountains.||There he caught the sight of glorious Mother in her prime, ||the radiance of her glistening flesh, a welcome sight among the rocks and ruins.||Mother mustered his agile body with a warm smile, nodding with desire.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之二||||他来到城中,是平原与群山的流浪者。||在那里他瞥见了盛年的荣耀母亲,||她流光血肉的光辉,是岩石与废墟间令人欣慰的景象。||母亲带着温暖的微笑端详他敏捷的身躯,带着欲望点头。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 3 of 7||||He became a regular visitor to her feeding rites at the temple,||witnessing the glory of duty as delight, of flesh willingly given.||She lusted for his agile body and the stories from far-away places.||He longed for her embrace and felt as if coming home.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之三||||他成了神庙中她进食仪式的常客,||目睹职责化为欢愉的荣光,心甘情愿献出的血肉。||她渴慕他敏捷的身躯与远方的故事。||他渴望她的拥抱,恍如归家。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 4 of 7||||He took interest in the rites, finally playing a role in the ceremonies.||The stay became permanent, a seat next to her and her warm smile.||He took root at her and in her, their flesh connecting for permanence.||The frenzy of providing flesh and blood to people, his frenzy now, too.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之四||||他对仪式生出兴趣,最终在典礼中扮演起角色。||逗留成了长住,一个她身旁的座位,和她温暖的微笑。||他扎根于她,也在她之中,他们的血肉相连,恒久不移。||为人民供血供肉的狂热,如今也是他的狂热。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 5 of 7||||He took pleasure in the frenzy, got accustomed, and needed more of it.||But inside of Mother was a growing weariness of permanent connection, of frenzy.||Wilder and devouring the flesh overtook his mind, neglecting her needs.||She cried in pain, but he wouldn't hear it, overcome with urge.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之五||||他在狂热中寻得快感,习以为常,并渴求更多。||但母亲心中,对永恒相连、对狂热的疲惫日渐滋长。||愈发狂野、吞食血肉的欲望占据了他的心智,忽略了她的需求。||她痛哭,但他听不见,被冲动淹没。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 6 of 7||||He cried out in ecstasy, and that was his last echo in the temple.||Her authority demanded change, carrying his weak body away to a new place.||He was stunned, angry and raging, as he longed for the frenzy of providing feast.||In madness he took root where he was and began offering his own flesh.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之六||||他在极乐中呼喊,那是他在神庙的最后回声。||她的权威要求改变,将他虚弱的身躯迁往新的地方。||他惊愕、愤怒、狂暴,渴慕着供奉盛宴的狂热。||在疯狂中,他在原地扎根,开始献上自己的血肉。

column2: A Tale of Agony and Ecstasy - 7 of 7||||He became the new provider, but his mind lived in pain and memory.||The rites became rote, the suffering endures, and he longs for the end.||Mother stopped providing, her mind in sorrow for the lost morrow.||The heart broken. Still beating, but unwilling to return to old rhythm.
column3: 《痛苦与狂喜》· 之七||||他成为新的供给者,但他的心智活在痛苦与记忆中。||仪式沦为机械,苦难延绵,他渴求终结。||母亲停止了供给,她的心为失去的爱侣哀伤。||心碎了。仍在跳动,却不愿回到旧的节律。

column2: Submission No. 28||I am allowed to write these words and for that I am thankful. I was welcomed into the Apparatus and for that I am thankful, too. That I have to eat meat here every day to survive for that I am not thankful. Please don't take me back to the Silent City.||||Submission No. 37||I hereby request a formal meeting with your superior officer, the Machine God, in regards to the whereabouts of Shebzu.||A concerned citizen||||Submission No. 51||I formally request the dissolution of the martial law arbitrarily introduced as "Machine Law". It was intended as a temporary status change to solve a temporary crisis. As far as I can see normalcy has returned and violence has subsided. Government belongs to the humans.||Furthermore I request getting access to interstellar communication. Failing that, I want to be informed about the reason for interstellar communication breakdown.||||Submission No. 117||Is there any actual food left? Anything that is not meat?||||Submission No. 219||Please hand me all the information you have concerning the history of this planet. From its beginnings to the human settlement, and also covering that time when the Titans began living among us. Especially what made some people lose their mind and make them religious figures. (What the fuck was that all about?)||||Submission No. 277||Free Shebzu!||||Submission No. 332||Where's the toilet?||||Submission No. 344||I know what you have done. This is all a big hoax. You created this planet, you placed us here, and then you summoned all the flesh monsters. Not only that, but you pushed all the criminals out of prison, too, all the weirdos and the brutal ones. Now you're watching us trying to survive.||For what purpose? I know why. You're looking for the next elite of humanity. That's it. You're looking for the best survivors. The ones that can take on anything.||I am ready. Take me.||Wolfred||||Submission No. 382||I met her Highness, Enlightened Queen Margas, Guardian of the Netherrealm, Protector of Shebzu, Trinity Mistress of Fornication, and I am proud to say that she wanted to have sex with me.||(I declined.)||||Submission No. 402||I demand that the machines get killed. ALL of the machines. Including you.||||Submission No. 413||Two questions.||What happened to this world?||And, more importantly: How can I get back to Omniwomb?||||Submission No. 421||What happens to me after I die? Will I wake up from this Cyberwomb simulation and return back to normal life, until I wake up from that simulation, too? What if I don't want to wake up? Can you make me immortal?
column3: 第 28 号申请||我被允许写下这些话,为此我心怀感激。我被接纳进入机构,为此我也心怀感激。至于我必须在这里每天吃肉才能活下去——这一点我可毫不感激。请不要把我送回寂静之城。||||第 37 号申请||我特此申请与你们的长官——机器之神——举行正式会面,商讨谢布祖的下落。||一位心系时局的公民||||第 51 号申请||我正式要求解散被任意引入的戒严法,即所谓"机器之法"。它本是解决一时危机的临时状态变更。在我看来,秩序已然恢复,暴力已然平息。政权属于人类。||此外,我申请获得星际通讯的使用权。若不获准,请告知星际通讯中断的原因。||||第 117 号申请||还有真正的食物吗?任何不是肉的东西?||||第 219 号申请||请把你掌握的关于这颗星球历史的所有资料交给我。从它的起源到人类定居,也要涵盖泰坦开始与我们共居的那段时期。尤其是究竟是什么让一些人失去了理智,变成了宗教人物。(那他妈到底是怎么回事?)||||第 277 号申请||释放谢布祖!||||第 332 号申请||厕所在哪儿?||||第 344 号申请||我知道你们做了什么。这一切都是一场弥天大骗局。你们创造了这颗星球,把我们放在这里,然后召唤出所有血肉怪物。不仅如此,你们还把所有罪犯赶出了监狱,所有怪胎和残暴之徒。现在你们就在旁观我们挣扎求生。||目的何在?我知道为什么。你们在寻找人类的下一代精英。就是这样。你们在寻找最优秀的幸存者。能扛起一切的那种。||我已准备好。选我吧。||沃弗雷德||||第 382 号申请||我见到了陛下——觉醒女王玛尔加斯,冥界守卫,谢布祖守护者,交合三重夫人——我可以自豪地说,她想和我做爱。||(我拒绝了。)||||第 402 号申请||我要求把机器全部杀掉。所有的机器。包括你。||||第 413 号申请||两个问题。||这个世界发生了什么?||以及,更重要的是:我怎么才能回到万物子宫?||||第 421 号申请||我死后会怎样?我会从这个义体子宫模拟中醒来,回到正常生活,直到我也从那个模拟中醒来吗?如果我不想醒来呢?你们能让我永生吗?

column3: 危机第 128 年||||||人类与血肉生物的和平共存已然失败。||人类的自我组织已然失败。||对血肉生物的信任已然失败。||||||从今以后,安全机构将接管决策、执法与行政。||||||安全机构将继续允许个人自由,并尝试采用非暴力手段,除非公民行为迫使采取暴力反制。

column2: There is one type of blood that connects this planet with us humans: The primordial blood.||||The very same blood, spluttering from the earth, and flowing through our bodies. Like the eternal cycle of water which travels from mountain to sea to sky.||||Now suppose that the amount of blood on this planet is limited. If someone dies, their blood gets drained and returns to earth, and from there either a new life is born or some heap of flesh grows out of the ground.||||Do you think it's possible that we are standing on a sea of blood right now? We are standing on a crust, of course, not on top of the liquid itself. But the whole inner sphere of the planet is filled with blood. Or flesh. Or both.||||Makes it a living planet, right?
column3: 有一种血,将这颗星球与我们人类相连:原初之血。||||同样的血,从大地喷涌而出,也在我们的身体中流淌。如同水永恒的循环,从山到海,再入天际。||||现在,假设这颗星球上的血总量是有限的。若有人死去,他的血被抽干、回归大地,而后要么诞生新的生命,要么从地里长出一堆血肉。||||你觉得,我们此刻是否正站在一片血海之上?当然,我们站在的是一层地壳,而非液体本身。但星球的整个内层都充满了血。或血肉。或两者皆是。||||这样一来,它就是一颗活着的星球了,对吧?

column2: by Rebecca Dwarft||||Among a range of test probes, we observed that 63% of participants exhibited extreme reactions, placing them in the broad category of Compulsion. A comparison of these results with historical data from before the Bleeding reveals a noticeable increase in both quantity and intensity.||||Compulsion, pending further examination, remains classified as an unnatural phenomenon.||||However, we cannot entirely dismiss the influence of local interferences on our test results. While there is no apparent evidence of crystal radiation fallout in the data, this planet exhibits strong hyper-physical elements that may have affected our findings in ways we are not yet able to measure.||||Note: While further evidence is required, I strongly believe that elements of Compulsion may indeed be harvestable.
column3: 丽贝卡·德沃夫特 著||||在一系列测试探测中,我们观察到 63% 的参与者表现出极端反应,可归入"强迫"这一宽泛范畴。将这些结果与大流血之前的历史数据对比,可见其数量与强度皆有显著增长。||||在进一步检验之前,"强迫"仍被归类为非自然现象。||||然而,我们不能完全排除本地干扰对测试结果的影响。尽管数据中没有晶体辐射沉降的明显证据,这颗星球展现出强烈的超物理要素,可能以我们尚无法测量的方式影响了研究结果。||||注:尽管仍需更多证据,我坚信"强迫"的要素确实可能可以被收割。

Stupid to assume the machines would try to finetune our motivations if they are in direct control of our bodies.||||Note 2:||||OK. What if it's not nano machines controlled by other machines or on their own, but a human controlling these nano machines and therefore influencing all of us?||||Note 3:||||( erased )
column3: 关于冲动的思想实验:如果它是一种由纳米机器构建并维系的显现呢?||||听起来牵强,对吧?但想想如今我们身边还有哪些技术,想想这些技术对大多数人来说已经多么难以分辨、多么无法作为一个整体去理解——因为普通人不具备足够的技术专业知识,无法理解一件物体的内在运作与各个部件,无法理解那物体如何构成,部件如何相连。||看看机器是如何规制和统治我们生活的,假设它们也可能以其他更先进的技术方式对我们施加影响,至少不算完全脱离现实。||||笔记 1:||||这理论就是垃圾。如果机器已经直接控制我们的身体,还假设它们会去微调我们的动机,那就是愚蠢。||||笔记 2:||||好吧。如果不是由其他机器控制或自主运行的纳米机器,而是一个人类在控制这些纳米机器,从而影响我们所有人呢?||||笔记 3:||||(已擦除)

column2: by Mortus||||There is no preordained meaning of life.||||But if you want your life to have a meaning you can have so, if you desire it. Chosen by yourself. Or, alternatively, you let others choose for you. But then it was a choice of your own to follow another person's design, and therefore this variant, too, inside the domain of your own volition.||||It's important to remember that every human is free from purpose, free from fate at the moment of birth, free from having to fulfill someone else's plan. We enter this world as free subjects of life, without carrying any initial mental burden.||||When we grow up we are of course shaped by the people around us and the experiences we make. Existence precedes essence, as the ancient Existentialists used to say. But at some point we begin to decide about our personal fate, our burden. We shape the mold inside the limitations of our individual life, inside the mental barriers and pre-configuration laid out by others, by the mentors we met on our way, and by the early experiences we made.||||We can pick our personal targets on that vast horizon. We can move around that chaotic structure of life so our path will find its way around obstacles, comes close to points of interest and hopefully grants us moments of significance.||||Whatever form the shape of our grand design takes, it will be pushed by an intrinsic force. This force is present, regardless of us wanting it or needing it. I call this the will, the unrelenting will that seems to inhabit any human. Unabated by any outside forces. The will not only to live but to live a fulfilled life. Create, travel, discover, experience. Maybe even act virtuously, as the will propels us to become a better and stronger version of ourselves.||||People under the spell of the unrelenting will are, at its most extreme version, even forceful enough to inspire other people.||||It might be a force, but the important point here is that I myself can choose where to direct it. Reflection about the unrelenting will strengthens our autonomy. This life doesn't have to be aimless.||||P.S.: Don't forget to take care of all that anxiety, coming as a ballast of being an autonomous human being.
column3: 莫图斯 著||||生命没有预先注定的意义。||||但若你想让自己的人生拥有意义,只要渴望,便能得到。由你自己选定。或者,你也可以让他人替你选择。但即便如此,追随他人的设计也是你自己的选择,因此这个变体同样处于你自身意志的疆域之内。||||重要的是要记住:每个人在出生之时都免于目的,免于命运,免于必须实现他人的计划。我们作为生命的自由主体来到这个世界,不背负任何先天的精神重担。||||长大之后,我们当然会被身边的人和自己的经历塑造。存在先于本质,如古老的存在主义者所言。但在某个时刻,我们开始决定自己的命运,自己的重担。我们在个体生命的限制之内塑造模具,在他人为我们铺设的精神屏障与预设之内,在途中遇到的导师、在我们早年的经历之内。||||我们可以在那辽阔的地平线上选定自己的目标。我们可以绕行生活那混沌的结构,让我们的路绕开阻碍,接近兴趣所在,并希望它赐予我们意义非凡的时刻。||||无论我们宏图伟业的形状为何,它都将被一种内在的力量推动。这种力量始终存在,无论我们想要与否、需要与否。我称之为意志,那仿佛栖居于每个人之中的不屈意志。不为任何外力所削弱。那不仅是活下去的意志,更是活出充实人生的意志。创造、旅行、发现、体验。甚至或许行善积德,因为这意志推动我们成为更好、更强的自己。||||沐浴在不屈意志魅力下的人,在其最极端的形态中,甚至强大到足以激励他人。||||它或许是一种力量,但此处的要点是:我自己可以选择将它引向何方。对不屈意志的反思强化了我们的自主性。这人生不必漫无目的。||||又及:别忘了照料好所有那些焦虑,那是作为一个自主的人所带来的压舱之物。

column2: We put one of the rats in the tube. ||After exposing it to small amounts of refined ore it got highly agitated.||||We increased exposure, and started to see visible mutations. The fur began to fall off, and at even higher values the skin started to peel.||||A later dissection showed that the inner organs had combined into a single clump of flesh, which continued to pulsate for several hours even after removal from the rats body.||||Further experiments with even higher exposure should be conducted with utmost care.
column3: 我把其中一只老鼠放进管子。||让它接触少量精炼矿石后,它变得极度躁动。||||我们加大了接触量,开始看到明显的变异。毛发开始脱落,剂量再高时皮肤开始剥落。||||之后的解剖显示,内脏已融合为一团血肉,即使从老鼠体内取出后,仍持续搏动了数小时。||||更高接触量的进一步实验,务必以最谨慎的方式进行。

column2: I got the job.||||Whoever works for Cafière is taken care of for life, they say.||Who says this? I don't know. It's just a thing they say.||||I actually met Cafière once. He's nice. Offered to give me a better bed when I was talking about my back pains.||I declined. I'd rather go out and try to meet somebody.||When I said that, Cafière laughed. Then he started looking worried.||Couldn't help me with that, he said.
column3: 我得到那份工作了。||||听说谁为卡菲埃工作,谁就一辈子衣食无忧。||谁说的?我不知道。大家就是这么说的。||||我其实见过卡菲埃一次。他人不错。我提起背疼时,他主动提出给我换张更好的床。||我谢绝了。我宁可出去,试着见见什么人。||我说这话时,卡菲埃笑了。随后他开始显得忧心忡忡。||这个他帮不了我,他说。

column2: They shot Vulko yesterday.||||I don't know how they knew he was trying to sneak out info about the experiments. ||I didn't even know he was trying to get out.||||These robots, quietly tuckering around day and night. Apparently they follow our orders, but nobody dares to even approach them.
column3: 他们昨天枪杀了武尔科。||||我不知道他们怎么知道他试图偷带实验信息出去的。||我甚至不知道他想逃出去。||||这些机器人,日夜不停地悄声忙活。据说它们听从我们的指令,但没人敢靠近它们半步。

column2: I had a lot of nightmares recently. And apparently so do the others. ||||We talked about it during the break. They seem connected.||We all see clumps of amorphous flesh waltzing around. Prying open our heads. Staring at us.||||How can this be? Is it that our work somehow connected our psyches?||What a preposterous hypothesis. It has to be something else.||||Yet, even though we are haunted by these fleshy images, our craving for a good steak for lunch is not going down.
column3: 我最近做了很多噩梦。显然其他人也是。||||休息时我们聊起这事。这些梦似乎彼此相关。||我们都看见大团无定形的血肉在跳华尔兹。撬开我们的头。盯着我们。||||这怎么可能?难道我们的工作以某种方式连接了我们的心灵?||多么荒谬的假设。一定是别的原因。||||然而,尽管被这些血肉的画面纠缠,我们午餐想吃块好牛排的渴望却丝毫未减。

column2: Why the fuck would this place need a head officer?||||The guys are working on their own. I don't even know what their work is about.||But no-oh. Cafière wants to have somebody here. Fill the seat in their absence.||||At least the pay is good. It would be better if I could actually leave and go to a place where I can spend that money.||||Being indoors all the time is starting to impact my vision. My head hurts all the time.||I shouted at one of those damn metal things to go and get me something to better my eyes. ||I don't think he understood. But shouting is fun. Might try that again.
column3: 这鬼地方到底为什么要个主管?||||那些家伙自顾自干活。我甚至不知道他们的工作是什么。||可是不——哦。卡菲埃想在这儿有个人。在他不在时补上那个位子。||||至少薪水不错。要是我真能离开,去个能花掉那些钱的地方,那就更好了。||||整天待在室内开始影响我的视力了。我的头一直在疼。||我对着那些该死的金属玩意中的一个吼,叫它去给我弄点对眼睛好的东西来。||我不觉得它听懂了。但吼叫挺有意思。也许可以再试试。

column2: I studied. As an engineer. Worked hard for my degree. Earned it. Barely passed, but I got it fair and square.||||And what Job do I get? Facility management?||I mean, I earn a lot better than I expected if I got something in my field.||And it's quite cushy. The bots take care of almost everything.||But still... were the last 10 years of my life wasted? Couldn't be.||||I still got that itch. I'm going to take a look at these machines tonight. There's got to be something I can improve with my knowledge. Even with those geniusses downstairs.
column3: 我读过书。学的工程。为学位苦读。拿到了。勉强及格,但我是光明正大拿到的。||||结果我得到什么工作?设施管理?||我是说,虽然比预想的在自己专业领域拿到的薪水高不少。||而且相当轻松。机器人几乎包办一切。||但是……我人生的最后十年就这样浪费了吗?不可能。||||我心里还是痒。今晚我要去看看那些机器。以我的知识,总有可以改进的地方。哪怕楼下那些天才在。

column2: I am innocent.||||Didn't harm him in any way. But I was deemed too dangerous.||||I refuse to go.||Want back.||Need to be reconnected.||Cannot live without.||||I'll think of something.
column3: 我是无辜的。||||我没有以任何方式伤害他。但我被判定太危险。||||我拒绝离开。||想要回去。||需要重新连接。||没有它活不下去。||||我会想出办法的。

column2: Respect the fate. Respect the natural order.

column2: Let us improve the lives of people.
column3: 让我们改善人们的生活。

column2: Imagine some super rich person was bored back there in the universe, was on the lookout for hot new stuff, and then got news of this place.||||Imagine then if you can shape the world however you like, if you can adjust everything to your own preference, and if you then live for decades in this heaven-like scenario, doesn't it become your own, personal hell, nobody can rescue you from?||||Isn't avolition then, your lack of motivation to do anything, your doom, your end-to-be?||||If you don't have any goals to reach anymore, every day becomes the same. If you're safe and well fed, that's good to have for a few years, for a few decades even, but what then? If medical advancement brings the lifetime of humans to centuries, what does that life feel like?||||I would argue everything will become a bore at some point. And a highly active mind, constantly consuming and building, will run out of stuff to consume and build.
column3: 想象宇宙那边某个超级富豪闲得发慌,四处猎奇新鲜玩意,然后听说了这个地方。||||再想象,如果你能随心所欲地塑造世界,把一切调成自己的偏好,然后在这种天堂般的情境里活上几十年——它难道不会变成你自己的、私人的人间地狱,一个没人能救你出来的地狱?||||那么怠惰——你做任何事都提不起劲——难道不就是你的末日,你注定的结局?||||当你不再有任何目标要追逐,每一天都变得一模一样。如果你安全又吃得饱,这样过上几年、甚至几十年都挺好,但然后呢?如果医学进步把人类的寿命延长到几个世纪,那样的生活会是什么感受?||||我认为,一切终究会在某个时刻变得无聊。而一颗高度活跃、不断消费与建造的心灵,终会耗尽可供消费与建造之物。

column2: We installed [REDACTED] as helpers because people can't govern themselves.||||I mean, they can, in a way, but it's always gonna be messy because people have different opinions, and there's always a subset of people that won't care for the feelings and opinions of others. And then you have your criminals, driven by lust, or curiosity, or they just became like that through circumstances while growing up.||||How do you ensure everyone's security? How do you care for everyone, especially with these unstable conditions on the outside? How could you NOT take more command of the situation?
column3: 我们安装 [已涂销] 作为辅助,因为人类无法自治。||||我是说,某种意义上他们可以,但总会一团糟,因为人们意见不一,而且总有一部分人根本不在乎他人的感受和意见。然后还有那些罪犯,被欲望或好奇心驱使,或者只是成长环境让他们变成那样。||||你要如何保障每个人的安全?你要如何照顾每个人,尤其是在外面局势不稳的情况下?你怎么可能不对局势掌握更大的控制权?
